videos.overview: The police explain their reasons for raiding the roadside hawkers. Feeling bad about the situation, Mahila Mandal comes up with a solution that helps all the parties.

videos.title: Permission For Stalls
videos.overview: The hawkers reach Gokuldham Society to set up their stalls. However, they need permission from Bhide, the society's secretary, before doing anything.

videos.title: Permission Granted
videos.overview: Bhide, after consulting everyone, grants the hawkers permission to set up their stalls. Tapu Sena assures Bhide that they will take care of the security arrangements.

videos.title: Tapu Sena On High Alert
videos.overview: The shopping fiesta begins at the Gokuldham Society. Tapu Sena catches a pickpocket, who tries to run away with a lot of valuable items.

videos.title: Ahmedabad Se Surprise
videos.overview: Sundar arrives at Jethalal’s house and tells him that he has brought a surprise from Ahmedabad. When Goli tells his father about the kachori, he wishes that he could have some as well.

videos.title: Kachori Delivery
videos.overview: Goli tries to deliver his mother's handmade kachori to Iyer's house, but faces multiple hurdles along the way.

videos.title: Jethalal - The Cricketer
videos.overview: Goli distributes kachoris to everyone in Gokuldham Society. Jethalal talks to Bapuji about his shop’s interior work. Meanwhile, the kids are playing cricket downstairs and Jethalal flaunts his cricket skills in front of Babita.

videos.title: Renovation At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Taarak steps in and saves Jethalal from getting embarrassed in front of Babita. Jethalal, worried that his business is affected by the renovation, seeks Taarak's help again.

videos.title: Iyer Trips And Falls
videos.overview: Taarak asks Jethalal to stay calm and ask his contractor for a deadline. Iyer trips on a banana peel and breaks his cell phone.

videos.title: Pyaar Ki Kala
videos.overview: When Bhide finds that Tapu has ordered footwear worth five thousand rupees, he scolds Jethalal for pampering Tapu. Jethalal reaches his shop to find that the contractor hasn't arrived for the meeting.

videos.title: Jethalal Se Vasooli
videos.overview: Jethalal sends Bagha to a local mobile repair show for fixing Babita's phone. Bhide has to deal with three guys who are adamant about taking 2 lakh rupees from Jethalal.

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Office Aye Gunde
videos.overview: The goons, who believe that Jethalal owes them money, reach his office and demand money. Jethalal, still confused, tries to figure out who they are and how does he owe them money.

videos.title: Searching For Santosh Contractor
videos.overview: Jethalal frantically looks for his contractor Santosh. He ends up calling multiple numbers but fails to get in touch with him. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer wait for Jethalal to come back with her phone.

videos.title: Finding Babita's Phone
videos.overview: Iyer calls Bagha and asks him about Babita's phone. Jethalal calls the vasooli agents and tries to get the phone back.

videos.title: Retrieving Babita's Phone
videos.overview: Jethalal calls the goon who has Babita's phone and begs him to give the phone back to him. However, the goon doesn't budge and asks for his money. What compromise does Jethalal need to do to get the phone back?

videos.title: Jethalal's Lies Get Caught
videos.overview: Iyer and Babita arrive at Jethalal's godown and find that he has been lying about Babita's phone all along. Jethalal turns to Taarak to help him find a solution.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Deal
videos.overview: Jethalal gets jumped on by other members of Gokuldham for being irresponsible with Babita's phone. Taarak helps Jethalal to set up a meeting with the vasooli agents.

videos.title: Paise Do Phone Lo
videos.overview: Sodhi gets ready to take on the vasooli agents with Babita's phone. Jethalal sets up a meeting with the agents in the hopes of returning Babita's phone.

videos.title: Jethalal Arrested
videos.overview: Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi are arrested by the police and taken to the station. They get happy to see Inspector Pandey on duty but, he refuses to treat their case in a partial manner.

videos.title: Jethalal And Gang In Lock-Up
videos.overview: Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi get locked up in Inspector Pandey's station. They keep requesting Inspector Pandey to show them some leniency.

videos.title: Jethalal Retrieves Babita's Phone
videos.overview: Jethalal requests Inspector Pandey to drop him, Taarak and Sodhi at Gokuldham Society. Bapuji finds out the story of Jethalal's arrest through Bhide.

videos.title: Chappal Exchange
videos.overview: Babita thanks Jethalal for repairing and returning her phone safely. Jethalal argues about exchanging the footwear that Tapu ordered online.

videos.title: Popatlal Ko Laga Jhatka
videos.overview: Popatlal gets angry at Bhide for being carefree about the accidents at the Gokuldham Society. How will the members of Gokuldham solve this new issue?

videos.title: Madhvi Ki Keemti Saree
videos.overview: Madhvi informs Bhide that her brother, Vinayak, will be coming over with his family. Bhide gets distracted and burns Madhvi's saree by accident.

videos.title: Bhide Gets Caught
videos.overview: Bhide is in a hurry to leave, but the people of Gokuldham keep coming in his way. Bhide has to hide as he runs into Madhvi and Sonu at the market.

videos.title: Bhide Looks For A New Saree
videos.overview: A tailor suggests to Bhide that the best option he has is to buy the same saree. Bhide asks Taarak to help him find the saree.

videos.title: Bhide Goes Saree Shopping
videos.overview: Bhide tries to find the same saree at the shops in the mall. Meanwhile, Madhvi calls Bhide, asking him about her saree.

videos.title: Bhide Gets The Saree
videos.overview: Bhide buys a replica of Madhvi's Saree from a shop. He sneaks in with the saree and hides it in the cupboard.

videos.title: Mama Mami Ka Swagat
videos.overview: Bhide and his family finally welcome Madhvi's brother to their house. Everyone notices that Madhvi's saree is different. Will Bhide come clean?

videos.title: Bhide's Confession And Punishment
videos.overview: Sonu recites the poem she wrote for her Mama and Mami. Bhide confesses that it was him who burned Madhvi's saree.

videos.title: An Invitation From Big B
videos.overview: Big B calls Asit Kumarr Modi and invites every member of the Gokuldham Society to play KBC. Asit relays the message to Bhide so he can inform everyone to get ready.

videos.title: Gokuldham Ke Liye Khushkhabri
videos.overview: With Asit Kumarr Modi arriving in Gokuldham Society, what news is he bringing along with him, that has the interest of all the members?

videos.title: KBC Se Invitation
videos.overview: Asit Ji announces that Gokuldham Society members have been invited to participate in Kaun Banega Crorepati. The society members can't control their excitement at the thought of participating in such a huge show and meeting Big B personally.

videos.title: Yuva Unstoppable Foundation At Gokuldham
videos.overview: The members of the Gokuldham Society return home after their gameplay on the hot seat and congratulate each other. Everyone welcomes the people from Yuva Unstoppable Foundation.

videos.title: Gokuldham's Eligible Partner
videos.overview: Shubh Mangal Marriage Bureau tells Popatlal that after his appearance on KBC, he has become the most eligible bachelor in the country. Abdul calls Popatlal to inform him that someone is coming over to see him.

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Do Rishte
videos.overview: Popatlal takes it upon himself to disinfect his house so he can meet Gungun. He gets in trouble when another family stops him on his way to Bhide's house.

videos.title: Do Rishton Mein Phasa Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal drops the second family at Dr Hathi's house and meets Gungun, who is waiting at Bhide's house. Popatlal has to juggle between the two families before coming to a decision.

videos.title: Popatlal Meets Sneha And Gungun
videos.overview: Popatlal uses a ladder to get up and down Bhide's balcony to meet both families. Who will Popatlal choose, Sneha or Gungun?

videos.title: Gungun's Father Faints
videos.overview: It appears as Popatlal has made up his mind to marry Sneha, but when he declines Gungun's proposal, Gungun's father loses consciousness. How will this change Popatlal's selection criteria?

videos.title: No Shaadi For Popatlal
videos.overview: Both families leave Gokuldham Society, revealing that they just wanted to invite the members of the Gokuldham Society to Sneha and Gungun's wedding. A furious Popatlal is calmed down by the Mahila Mandal with their optimism.

videos.title: Toofani Astrologer
videos.overview: Popatlal, already on the edge, sends a family home, who genuinely came with a marriage proposal. Fuming with anger, he calls his boss and asks him about the astrologer who works for their paper.

videos.title: Popatlal Meets A Vastu Expert
videos.overview: Popatlal explains to Bhide, Madhvi and Komal the reason for his happiness. Popatlal welcomes Sanjana, a Vastu expert, to the Gokuldham Society.

videos.title: Giving The Sherwani Away
videos.overview: Popatlal, happy about getting rid of his cursed sherwani, is surprised by his pandit, who delivers his sherwani back to him. Popatlal appoints Tapu Sena to gift his sherwani to an unmarried guy.

videos.title: Getting Rid Of The Sherwani
videos.overview: All the members of the Gokuldham Society get angry at Popatlal for throwing his sherwani on Bhide. When Bhide calls to confront him about his behaviour, Popatlal asks Bhide to get rid of the sherwani.

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Sherwani Hai
videos.overview: Popatlal reveals that it was his sherwani, which angers other members of the society. Taarak throws a badminton challenge to Anjali hoping to eat the best street food.

videos.title: Anjali Finds The Bills
videos.overview: Jethalal brings a hot breakfast for his friends and invites them to his house. Anjali finds a hotel bill amongst Taarak's things and seeks Babita's help to find answers.

videos.title: Goli's Secret Mission
videos.overview: After feeling betrayed, Anjali decides to spy on Taarak. She bribes Goli to click a picture of Taarak eating in a hotel during his lunch break. Will Goli, the spy, accomplish his mission?

videos.title: Khiladi Diet Plan
videos.overview: Anjali takes the help of Mahila Mandal with her husband's diet problem. Babita takes Anjali to a reputed dietician, who suggests a 'Khiladi Diet' for Taarak.

videos.title: Diet Plan Shuru
videos.overview: After having a delicious meal cooked by Anjali, Taarak meets his friends at the soda shop. The next day Anjali surprises Taarak and Jethalal with a special halwa.

videos.title: Taarak Doesn't Like His Surprise
videos.overview: Anjali reveals her surprise and gets into a fight with Taarak in Jethalal's presence. Goli feels responsible for the fight between the Mehtas and meets Taarak to apologise to him.

videos.title: Taarak's Special Tiffin
videos.overview: Jethalal asks for more time when Taarak calls him seeking help to quench his appetite for delicious food. Taarak's boss forces him to exchange tiffins so he can get out of eating diet food.

videos.title: Taarak Gets Tired Of His Diet
videos.overview: Taarak tries to seek everyone's help to find better food without Anjali finding out about it. Anjali gets worried when Taarak does not return home in time.

videos.title: Taarak Found In A Kabristan
videos.overview: All members of the Gokuldham Society put their heads together to find Taarak. Taarak arrives late in the night in a rickshaw from a cemetery. What was he doing at the cemetery?

videos.title: Karele Wali Ki Jaan
videos.overview: Taarak comes to his senses when he hears the mention of 'karela'. He narrates the story of the 'karela wali' he met on his way home.

videos.title: Karele Ka Bhoot
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal joins forces to help Anjali take care of Taarak. An eerie vibe takes over Gokuldham as everyone starts having visions of a ghost in the society.

videos.title: Gokuldham Mein Bhoot Ka Darr
videos.overview: Everyone leaves for their home after Taarak has a good homecooked dinner and takes his medicine. The ghost story told by Taarak gives birth to fear in everyone's mind. How will the members of Gokuldham Society overcome their fears?

videos.title: Taarak Celebrates With Tapu Sena
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal, worried about Taarak, asks Anjali to give him his favourite delicacies till he gets better. Taarak celebrates with Tapu Sena after their plan succeeds.

videos.title: Karele Ka Kuan
videos.overview: Tapu Sena and Taarak enjoy their moment of victory by having some delicious food. As Anjali prays to god to help her family, Taarak worries that soon his lies will be caught.

videos.title: Taarak's Day Off
videos.overview: Anjali calls Taarak's boss and asks him to give her husband the day off. The dietician arrives at Gokuldham Society to check on the Mehtas.

videos.title: Psychiatrist For Taarak
videos.overview: Taarak sees a cart carrying 'karela' into the Gokuldham Society and loses his composure. Dr Hathi calls a psychiatrist to help with Taarak's condition. What is wrong with Taarak?

videos.title: Meeting For Taarak's Health
videos.overview: All members of the Gokuldham Society meet to find a solution for Taarak's condition. After the psychiatrist fails to help, Babita suggests taking help from a Baba.

videos.title: Taarak Fears The Shock Treatment
videos.overview: Tapu Sena tries to convince Bhide and Bapuji to stop the Baba from coming to Gokuldham. The Mahila Mandal visits the Mehtas to support them by getting some food for Taarak.

videos.title: Baba Bhagayega Bhoot
videos.overview: Bhide lies to his customers, neighbours and students to keep the news of Taarak's 'bhoot' coming out. Choodi Wala Baba makes his preparations to help exorcise the ghost inside Taarak.

videos.title: Baba Ki Rasmein
videos.overview: The 'Choodi Wale Baba' performs his rituals to exorcise the ghost inside Taarak. Taarak and Tapu Sena struggle to find a way out from the mess they have gotten themselves in.

videos.title: Bottle Khul Chuki Hai
videos.overview: The Baba claims that Madhavi is now hosting the spirit of Suryamukhi. He later explains to everyone how he is going to exorcise the ghost inside Taarak.

videos.title: Taarak's Scam
videos.overview: Taarak sends everyone in shock when he reveals that he has been acting all along. Bapuji accuses Jethalal of being an accomplice in Taarak's drama. Taarak apologises to everyone for fooling them over the last few days.

videos.title: Anjali Is Heartbroken
videos.overview: The Choodi Wale Baba reveals that it was just an act that he performed as directed by Anjali. The members of the Gokuldham Society help Taarak and Anjali to solve their diet problem.

videos.title: Taarak Makes Things Right
videos.overview: To redeem Gokuldham's image, Popatlal tells everyone that he wants to publish the truth about Taarak. Anjali reminds her husband that he has to deal with his boss, whom he spooked earlier.

videos.title: Preparation For A Potential Client
videos.overview: Bagha helps Jethalal get rid of the stiffness in his body by helping him stretch. They decide to decorate the godown, to make it presentable for hosting an important client meeting.

videos.title: Jethalal's Sleepless Night
videos.overview: Anxious about his client meeting, Jethalal has trouble falling asleep. He takes his father's blessings and meets his Gokuldham friends before leaving for his godown.

videos.title: Godown Ki Chaabi
videos.overview: Bagha and Jethalal arrive at the godown early in the morning only to realise that they do not have the keys to the door. Jethalal reaches home and finds out that Bapuji isn't there. Will Jethalal reach his godown in time?

videos.title: Bapuji Aur Jethalal Ka Miscommunication
videos.overview: Jethalal reaches his godown to find that Bapuji is waiting with the keys in the Gokuldham Society. Bhide agrees to help by offering to drive Bapuji to the godown.

videos.title: Sakharam Gets Stopped By The Police
videos.overview: Bhide and Bapuji get in trouble when a lady gets hit by Sakharam. Jethalal starts getting anxious as he can't enter the godown, and the time for his meeting ticks closer.

videos.title: Harr Disha Se Museebat
videos.overview: Bapuji fails to find Bagha in the meeting spot and goes looking around for him. Bagha finds Bhide, who gets fined again for breaking the traffic rules while searching for Bapuji.

videos.title: Bapuji Welcomes The Client
videos.overview: Jethalal and Bhide rush back to Gokuldham to check if Bapuji returned home. Jethalal comes back to the godown to find Bapuji and his client having a good time.

videos.title: Order Mila Bapuji Ki Wajah Se
videos.overview: Mr Goyal gets extremely happy to spend time with Bapuji and tells Jethalal that he will be given all the orders. The men of the Gokuldham Society meet at the soda shop and discuss who amongst them should leave the society.

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Important Email
videos.overview: Bagha calls Jethalal to inform him that they failed to read their work emails today. However, Bagha fails to relay the message which makes Jethalal lose his mind.

videos.title: More Orders For Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Babita informs Jethalal that her friend will visit his shop later. Jethalal promises his friends a party after he finalises a new deal that is coming his way.

videos.title: Jethalal's Party Confirmed
videos.overview: Bagha calls Jethalal to the godown early, so nothing goes wrong in their meeting. With time in their hands, Jethalal, Taarak and Sodhi decide to have a lavish breakfast.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Imandari
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham, worried about Jethalal, call to check on him. Jethalal's meeting with the Wow Resort's manager goes south when he puts forward an unreasonable demand.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki A1 Soch
videos.overview: Wow Resort's manager reveals that he was testing the kind of businessman Jethalal is and finalises the deal. Jethalal takes all his friends on a conference call to give them the good news.

videos.title: Party Kab Aur Kaha Hogi
videos.overview: Jethalal and Bagha prepare the godown to welcome his Gokuldham friends. Soon, everyone arrives at the godown to discuss when and where to organise Jethalal's success party.

videos.title: Party Location Fixed
videos.overview: Popatlal agrees to host Jethalal's success party at his flat but puts forward a condition. Everyone tries to find a way to convince their wives to allow them for a boys' night out.

videos.title: Jethalal's Mission Permission
videos.overview: Jethalal returns to the society early so he can take permission from Komal and Madhvi for the party. Will he manage to convince them to allow their husbands for a night out?

videos.title: Mission Permission Ka Teesra Padhav
videos.overview: Jethalal calls Bhide to tell him that Madhvi has permitted him to have a night out. However, everyone gets worried as Jethalal has to request Roshan and Babita, who are known to be very strict. Will mission permission be a success?

videos.title: Mehfil-E-Jaam Mein Jaane Ki Ijaazat
videos.overview: Jethalal returns to his godown being the bearer of bad news that Anjali has denied Taarak permission to attend the party. Taarak decides to call his beloved wife to get her permission in a different way. Will Jethalal and the gang get to celebrate his success together?

videos.title: Party Sharty Ki Taiyari
videos.overview: With everyone's wives permitting them to join the party, Jethalal orders an expensive bottle for them to enjoy. Now, the only thing that remains is Bapuji's permission.

videos.title: Bapuji Is Fed Lies
videos.overview: Jethalal lies to Bapuji and leaves for Popatlal's home to attend the party. However, Bapuji catches Jethalal in the society with the bottle of alcohol. Will the boys be able to party in peace?

videos.title: Party Ka Maza
videos.overview: Jethalal manages to sneak into Popatlal's house so they can begin their party. The Mahila Mandal sends an important video message to their husbands, who decided to party separately.

videos.title: Party Ka Popat
videos.overview: The men get excited and share poetry to get their party started. All their hopes go down the drain when Jethalal drops and breaks the bottle. Will they have the party that they worked so hard for?

videos.title: Yeh Chappal Jethia Ki Chappal Jaisi Hai
videos.overview: Champaklal confronts the male members of the society after hearing the commotion caused by Sodhi and Popatlal. With nowhere else to go for the party-sharty, Sodhi comes up with an idea, but will this plan work out?

videos.title: Aur Risk Nahi Le Sakte
videos.overview: The men of Gokuldham Society flee their party set up on the pavement when they hear the siren of a police car. The dejected men return to join the Mahila Mandal at their party.

videos.title: Bagha's Attempt To Create A Diversion
videos.overview: All the male members of the Gokuldham Society remain disheartened because of their failed plans. Later, Champaklal is on the verge of finding out about Jethalal's party sharty.

videos.title: Bhide Aur Popatlal Ki Ladai
videos.overview: Popatlal and Bhide argue with each other over garbage issues in society. Bhide plays a prank on Popatlal which angers him and he decides to take his revenge.

videos.title: Popatlal Apologises To Bhide
videos.overview: Popatlal apologises to Bhide in order to seek help regarding his KYC. Later, inspite of being asked to return home early by his mother, Goli takes several detours with Gogi.

videos.title: A New Tappu Sena Member
videos.overview: Gogi and Goli find a lost and homeless kitten in the park. With no other option in mind, they decide to take the kitten home for its safety. What will happen now?

videos.title: House For Kitty
videos.overview: Tapu Sena struggles to find a house for Kitty. They contemplate taking it to their house but are worried about how their parents will react. Will they find a house for Kitty?

videos.title: Bad News Hain
videos.overview: Goli's parents do not allow keeping Kitty at their house. Tapu and Sonu go to Popatlal's house with hopes. Will he keep Kitty at his house?

videos.title: Tapu's Plan For Kitty
videos.overview: Tapu Sena is looking for Kitty, but she is nowhere to be found. Tapu comes up with a plan to keep Kitty in the society, which involves convincing Bhide. Will Bhide get convinced?

videos.title: Billi Ne Kiya Nuksaan
videos.overview: Bhide and the other society members get annoyed at the fact that a cat was causing destruction to property in the colony and they look for the elusive cat. Meanwhile, the children of the society decide to let Kitty go before the adults get angry.

videos.title: Box Hil Raha Hai
videos.overview: Tapu scares Bhide, who entered the clubhouse while Goli, Gogi and Sonu try to sneak out a few items from their respective houses for Kitty. Will Tapu Sena succeed in hiding Kitty?

videos.title: Abdul's Hunt For The Kitten
videos.overview: Bhide questions Goli, Gogi and Sonu as they return to the clubhouse. Later, Goli tries to keep Abdul deviated, as he searches the clubhouse for the cat. Will Abdul find out about Pom Pom?

videos.title: Abb Ladka Dekhne Nahi Jaa Sakte
videos.overview: With Abdul on their side, Tapu Sena celebrates Pom Pom staying at the clubhouse. Later, the family that arrives at Gokuldham Society, to meet Popatlal, refuses to step any further after Pom Pom crosses their path.

videos.title: Billi Ka Problem
videos.overview: A worried Abdul tells Taarak and Anjali that Pom Pom, the kitten, has scared away Popatlal's guests. Tapu Sena hides her at their clubhouse. What will happen when Popatlal finds out?

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Andar Ka Sher
videos.overview: In the light of recent events, Popatlal forces Bhide to resign from the post of secretary. Everyone tries to calm Bhide and Popatlal, who won't stop fighting.

videos.title: Bapuji's Cat Allergy
videos.overview: With Popatlal hell-bent on getting rid of the cat, Tapu Sena comes up with a plan to save her. Popatlal suggests that they use Bapuji as a cat detector to find Pom Pom.

videos.title: Billi Ka Darr
videos.overview: Everyone at Gokuldham society is worried about the situation caused by the cat. Goli sneaks out in the middle of the night to check on Pom Pom.

videos.title: Bhide Bhagayega Billi
videos.overview: Dr Hathi and Komal wake up to realise that Goli is missing from the house. Abdul prevents Bhide from entering the clubhouse where Pom Pom is kept hidden by Tapu Sena.

videos.title: Bhide Wants The Box
videos.overview: Sonu calls Tapu to inform him that her father is on his way to get the box in which Pom Pom resides. Everyone believes Abdul's lie that Gokuldham is now cat-free. What will Tapu Sena do when their lies are caught?

videos.title: Apshagun Kuch Nahi Hai
videos.overview: Popatlal shows his appreciation for Bhide's quick action to make the society cat-free. Abdul and Tapu Sena worry about their situation after lying to the members of Gokuldham.

videos.title: Chasing Pom Pom Around
videos.overview: Tapu Sena frantically chases Pom Pom around Gokuldham Society. Pom Pom, who is in a playful mood, sneaks into one flat after another. Will it get caught?

videos.title: Billi Ne Dilaya Sodhi Ko Gussa
videos.overview: Pom Pom enters Sodhi's house and breaks his bottles, and eats Roshan's cupcakes. He gets furious and confronts Bhide and Abdul about the cat. Will Tapu Sena's lies get caught?

videos.title: Billi Gokuldham Mein Hi Hai
videos.overview: Everyone gets shocked when Popatlal informs them that his guests will soon arrive. Tapu Sena finds out that Pom Pom has made its way to Popatlal's house through the terrace.

videos.title: Pom Pom In Popatlal's House
videos.overview: With Popatlal out to find a bouquet for his guests, Pom Pom wreaks havoc in his house. Tapu Sena enlists Abdul's help to get into Popatlal's house to retrieve Pom Pom. Will they manage to hide Pom Pom before Popatlal returns?

videos.title: Ladkiwalo Ka Swagat
videos.overview: Popatlal asks Bhide to join him in welcoming his guests to the Gokuldham Society. Tapu Sena runs into multiple problems while looking for Pom Pom. Will Popatlal's meeting go smoothly?

videos.title: Rishta Nikla Haath Se
videos.overview: Popatlal's guests get furious when they spot Pom Pom and leave Gokuldham in anger. Popatlal feels betrayed and is out to get his revenge. Will Tapu Sena come forward with the truth?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ki Billi
videos.overview: Tapu Sena tells everyone about how they adopted Pom Pom. Popatlal realises his anger is misdirected and expresses his gratitude to everyone for saving him from a superstitious family.

videos.title: Pom Pom Ka Parivar
videos.overview: The Gokuldham family band together to find Pom Pom so they can welcome her to the society. However, they find Pom Pom with a group of other cats and decide to let them be together.

videos.title: Permission For Lonavala Trip
videos.overview: Sonu gets scared to ask her father for permission to visit Lonavala with Tapu Sena. The men of the Gouldham Society meet at Abdul's shop and talk about Tapu Sena's absence from the society.

videos.title: Bapuji Talks To Himself
videos.overview: The men of the Gokuldham Society sit at the soda shop and discuss their lives. Bhide and Madhavi spot Bapuji talking to himself on his balcony.

videos.title: Bapuji Ka Jigri
videos.overview: Bapuji's childhood friend calls him out of the blue and invites him for a night out. Popatlal invites Jethalal, who will be alone, to his house for dinner.

videos.title: Busy Day At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Bagha declines Babita's call on Jethalal's phone as he was preoccupied with a client call. Popatlal and Babita put Jethalal in a spot where he has to decide at whose house will he have dinner. Who will Jethalal choose?

videos.title: Bapuji Goes Out To Party
videos.overview: Jethalal comes home early to return Babita's mixer grinder and see Bapuji off. Jethalal and Popatlal enjoy a lavish feast together.

videos.title: A Walk To Matka Shop
videos.overview: Everyone takes an evening walk to visit a kulfi store after their dinner. Sodhi returns from his party and is desperate to tell Jethalal what he saw.

videos.title: Sodhi Ka Sachh
videos.overview: After Sodhi tells everyone what he saw, Jethalal refuses to believe him. Sodhi narrates everything that happened and tries to convince them.

videos.title: No One Believes Sodhi
videos.overview: When no one believes his story, Sodhi convinces everyone to sniff Bapuji to find out the truth. After finding no trace of alcohol from Bapuji, the members of the society force Sodhi to apologise.

videos.title: Party Sharty Ke Lakshan
videos.overview: Bapuji complains about a headache and acidity to Jethalal. All the men of Gokuldham Society gather at Jethalal's house to take care of Bapuji.

videos.title: Bapuji Gets Left Alone
videos.overview: Jethalal has to leave Bapuji alone as he has to visit Pune for a client meeting. Bapuji forces him to stay in Pune for the night. What could Bapuji be up to?

videos.title: Following Bapuji
videos.overview: To prove he is right, Sodhi and Popatlal decide to follow Bapuji. After witnessing Bapuji's actions, Sodhi and Popatlal refuse to believe their eyes.

videos.title: Bapuji Doing Party Sharty
videos.overview: Sodhi and Popatlal follow Bapuji into a bar. They call everyone so that they can see the truth with their own eyes.

videos.title: Recording Bapuji's Actions
videos.overview: Sodhi and Popatlal tell everyone what they saw at the bar. They hide in the garden and record Bapuji entering the society in a drunken state.

videos.title: Proof Against Bapuji
videos.overview: The men of Gokuldham worry about how to break the news of Bapuji's night out to Jethalal. Jethalal returns from his meeting and suspects that all his friends are hiding something from him.

videos.title: Toofaan Aa Gaya Hai
videos.overview: Jethalal returns from his client meeting in Pune to discover that Bapuji is still unwell. Taarak gathers everyone at Popatlal's house so they can plan and break the news of Bapuji's nightly escapades to Jethalal.

videos.title: Beta Baap Ko Kaise Toke?
videos.overview: Jethalal gets shocked when he finds out about Bapuji's drinking habit. Everyone discusses how they can help Bapuji get rid of his addiction.

videos.title: Jethalal Fails To Confront Bapuji
videos.overview: Jethalal struggles to confront Bapuji about his drinking habit. He goes back to his friends, seeking help for the same.

videos.title: Sodhi Ka Secret Plan
videos.overview: Sodhi locks Jethalal in a room and comes up with a secret plan to confront Bapuji. The Mahila Mandal gets shocked when they find out about Bapuji's activities.

videos.title: Sodhi's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Bapuji introduces his childhood friends to the Purush Mandal and comes clean about his actions. All of Jethalal's friends try to keep Bapuji away from a drunk Jethalal.

videos.title: Jethalal In Trouble
videos.overview: Bapuji clears all the confusion about his newfound habit. However, the issue of a drunk Jethalal still persists. Can Jethalal's friends get him out of this mess before Bapuji finds out?

videos.title: Jethalal Back To His Senses
videos.overview: Dr Hathi gets medicine for Jethalal that will bring him back to his senses. Bapuji gets extremely angry at the Purush Mandal for handling the situation poorly. How will everyone manage to calm Bapuji?

videos.title: Bapuji's Social Service
videos.overview: Bapuji clears everyone's misunderstanding about his nightly escapades. The Purush Mandal apologises to Bapuji for accusing him of drinking without confronting him.

videos.title: Godown Mein Chori
videos.overview: Sonu returns from her Lonavala trip bearing gifts for her parents. Jethalal tells about his eventful day to his friends while sipping soda at Abdul's shop.

videos.title: False Alarm
videos.overview: Jethalal apologises to Inspector Pandey for the misinformation he had, due to which he had to call the police. To bring about some change, Jethalal decides to prepare soda for his friends by himself.

videos.title: Bhangaar Wala Aya
videos.overview: Everyone at Gokuldham is dealing with the problem of having too much old stuff at home. Bhola Bhai comes to the rescue to collect the 'Bhangaar' from everyone's homes.

videos.title: Amulya Virasat
videos.overview: Bhide stops Madhavi from giving away his prized possession to the 'bhangar wala'. When Jethalal brings Bhide's old music system for repair, Bagha gets worried about the situation.

videos.title: Sargam Orchestra Repaired
videos.overview: Bagha tells Jethalal how he managed to repair Bhide's tape recorder. Bhide asks Abdul to gather everyone at the clubhouse so they can enjoy some old music together.

videos.title: The Tape Recorder Works
videos.overview: When Bhide tries to turn on his music system, it does not work. Bagha uses all his skills to figure out the problem so everyone can sing and dance to old Bollywood music.

videos.title: Golden Memories
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham Society continue to enjoy old Bollywood songs at the clubhouse. Everyone appreciates the soulful music of that era.

videos.title: Dancing To Old Songs
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham Society continue to sing along and dance to their favourite old songs. They reminisce and talk about the famous singers and songwriters of the yesteryears.

videos.title: Music Ka Dose
videos.overview: All members of the Gokuldham Society thank Bhide for a memorable musical night. Everyone returns home in a happy and fun mood.

videos.title: Nimbu Ki Keemat
videos.overview: Bapuji watches the news to find out that the price of lemons has shot up. Meanwhile, Bhide receives an order for lime pickles. How will Bhide manage to complete this order?

videos.title: Life Gives No Lemons
videos.overview: Bhide reaches a dead end while trying to procure the money that his clients owe him. Meanwhile, everyone at Gokuldham society struggles to find lemons. Will Bhide and Madhvi manage to fulfil the order?

videos.title: Bappa Ki Delivery
videos.overview: Bhide, under immense stress, almost runs over Popatlal with his Sakharam. Later, a mysterious delivery van drops three sacks at Bhide's residence. What could it be?

videos.title: Lemons For Bhide
videos.overview: Jethalal advises Bhide to get rid of the lemons before he gets in trouble with the police for hoarding them. Madhvi realises that the delivery of the lemons was meant for them.

videos.title: Nimbu Wali Lottery
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhvi decide to sell the remaining lemons at a lower price. They fail to find a suitable buyer for the large number of lemons they have left. Who will buy them?

videos.title: Nimbu Ka Kya Karein?
videos.overview: After Jethalal finds out that Bagha is planning to sell lemons, they quickly return them to Bhide before getting in trouble for hoarding. Bhide gets worried about what to do with the lemons. Will he find a solution?

videos.title: Finding Buyers
videos.overview: Bhide goes on a calling spree, trying to find a buyer for his lemons. However, most people either don't believe him or aren't interested in his offer. Will Bhide manage to get rid of the stock of lemons?

videos.title: Deal With A Jamakhor
videos.overview: As Bhide goes to meet the mysterious man who is interested in buying his entire stock of lemons, he gets stopped by the police. The police try to arrest him first but soon realise that the main culprit here is the 'Jamakhor' who called Bhide. Can they nab this public hoarder?

videos.title: Catching The Jamakhor
videos.overview: After Guddu Khatila dodges the police, he provokes Sodhi and Bhide. Guddu's men try to catch Sodhi and Bhide to get revenge on them for calling the police. Will Inspector Pandey arrive in time to save them?

videos.title: Thought Of The Day
videos.overview: The Purush Mandal enjoys a glass of lemon soda at Abdul's shop. Jethalal reminds Bhide about writing the thought of the day on the board.

videos.title: Madhvi Gets Upset
videos.overview: Bhide angers Madhvi with his antics. Popatlal arrives at Bhide's house and offers him to help cheer Madhvi up. However, Bhide refuses and decides to turn Madhvi's frown into a smile by himself.

videos.title: Group Shopping
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal shops for vegetables together at the cart in the morning. They get excited after hearing Bhide's plan to shop at the mall and try to convince their husbands to take them to the sale. Will the Purush Mandal agree?

videos.title: Notice For Bhide
videos.overview: All the couples of Gokuldham Society get together and set out to shop at the mall. A postman shows up at the society looking for Bhide. Will Bhide arrive in time to collect his letter?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Galat Information
videos.overview: Popatlal joins Babita and Iyer for breakfast. They find out that the marriage bureau had the wrong information about Popatlal. How will Popatlal handle the situation?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Toota Phone
videos.overview: Popatlal takes Bhide's help to rush to Jethalal's shop so he can get his phone repaired. Bagha helps with a replacement phone for Popatlal. Will Popatlal receive the call he has been waiting for?

videos.title: Waiting For Pratiksha
videos.overview: Popatlal gets tired of waiting for Pratiksha and asks the marriage bureau for her contact number. To kill time, Popatlal reads Pratiskha's bio with Tapu Sena.

videos.title: Pratiksha Ka Invitation
videos.overview: Popatlal gets an invitation from Pratiksha to meet her. He requests all his friends to get dressed in yellow and come along with him.

videos.title: Rishte Ka Dress Code
videos.overview: Popatlal convinces everyone at Gokuldham to get dressed in a dress code. Everyone wears yellow and gets ready to meet Pratiksha and her family.

videos.title: Searching For Pratiksha
videos.overview: Sodhi arranges a minibus for the Gokuldham members to travel together to Pratiksha's house. However, they face some difficulty in finding where she lives. Will they manage to find her?

videos.title: Meeting Pratiksha's Family
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members are greeted by Mr Puri's secretary. Everyone introduces themselves to Pratiksha's family.

videos.title: Popatlal Meets Pratiksha
videos.overview: Babita suggests that Popatlal and Pratiksha should talk to each other in private. Jethalal gives his phone number to Mr Puri before the Gokuldam family takes their leave.

videos.title: Popatlal Gets Anxious
videos.overview: Popatlal expresses his gratitude to everyone for accompanying him.  He has trouble falling asleep as he feels anxious about the Puri family's thoughts about him.

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Neend
videos.overview: Popatlal wakes Sodhi and Bhide as he is unable to sleep due to a dog barking. Sodhi arranges for a medicine that will help Popatlal to sleep.

videos.title: Popatlal Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: The colony members are excited to get Popatlal ready for his meeting with his to-be wife. Popatlal however, isn't opening his door nor is he answering his phone. Where could Popatlal be?

videos.title: Popatlal Gayab Hai
videos.overview: Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house to wait for Mr Puri's phone call. However, Popatlal is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

videos.title: Rishte Ke Liye Haan Hai
videos.overview: The Puri family calls Popatlal to tell him that they want Pratiksha to get married to him. However, they also reveal a shocking fact about Pratiksha's past. Will Popatlal look past it and accept the Puri family's proposal?

videos.title: Shagun Dene Ki Taiyari
videos.overview: All members of the Gokuldham Society get ready to meet the Puri family and give them the shagun. Sodhi arranges a bus for the Gokuldham family to travel together.

videos.title: Pratiksha Se Sawal
videos.overview: The Gokuldham family makes a grand entry into the Puri family's mansion. After Pratiksha shows up, Popatlal asks her an important question. What answer will Popatlal receive?

videos.title: Pratiksha Ka Pyar
videos.overview: Popatlal reveals that he knows who Pratiksha is in love with. He later asks Pratiksha to give her final decision. Will Popatlal receive the answer he wants to hear?

videos.title: Twist In The Tale
videos.overview: Popatlal gets in touch with Pratiksha's ex-husband and informs him about the wedding. What drama will unfold when Paresh lands up at the venue?

videos.title: Pratiksha Aur Paresh Ka Milan
videos.overview: With Popatlal and Bapuji's help, Pratiksha and Paresh reconcile their love. Babita and Anjali play a friendly game of badminton.

videos.title: Jethalal And Babita's Badminton Match
videos.overview: Jethalal and Babita's badminton match begins. Jethalal reaches home late and finds Bapuji sleeping on the couch.

videos.title: Bhide's Mango Consignment
videos.overview: Bhide receives a consignment of mangoes. He distributes it among his friends for everyone to enjoy.

videos.title: Rumours About Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Jethalal finds out that the daily newspaper did not get delivered in the morning. Later, he gets a piece of annoying news about his shop. What could it be about?

videos.title: Contractor Gives The Good News
videos.overview: Jethalal shares his worries about his shop with Sodhi, Bhide and Popatlal. Later, when Jethalal meets his contractor, he receives a piece of good news. What could it be?

videos.title: Meeting Pandit Ji
videos.overview: Jethalal invites a famous astrologer to help him find the most auspicious time to re-open his shop. What suggestions will this astrologer give?

videos.title: Inauguration Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: Jethalal invites friends and family over for the re-opening of his shop. Will everything go smooth for Jethalal?

videos.title: Sundar's Promise
videos.overview: Jethalal is excited about his shop's reopening and invites all his neighbours and friends. Meanwhile, Sundar promises to bring Daya back to the colony for the reopening.

videos.title: Kya Daya Ka Aana Cancel?
videos.overview: Sundar gets into a dilemma as he struggles to gather the courage and tell Jethalal that Daya won't be turning up for the inauguration. Meanwhile, a famous newspaper editor pays a visit to Gokuldham society.

videos.title: Mehmaano Ko Aamantran
videos.overview: Jethalal invites all his friends and asks them to get to the venue on time. Meanwhile, Bagha creates a special list for Jethalal to personally call and invite. Will they accept his invitation?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Liye Gift
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham try to think of a thoughtful gift for Jethalal on the occasion of his shop's reopening. What will they get him?

videos.title: Dukaan Ready Hogayi
videos.overview: Jethalal gives an invitation to all his friends for the reopening of his shop. Meanwhile, Sundar comes up with a plan to get Daya for the shop reopening. How will he manage that?

videos.title: Daya Bhabhi Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: Jethalal eagerly waits for his wife and can't contain his excitement. Can Sundar deliver his promise?

videos.title: Daya Ki Chitthi
videos.overview: Jethalal comes to know that Daya won't be coming to Gokuldham for the shop's reopening. How will Jethalal react to this heartbreaking news?

videos.title: Inauguration Ka Josh
videos.overview: The Gokuldham society members are elated and excited to be a part of the reopening of Gada Electronics. Will the event go as planned?

videos.title: Bapuji Hue Gayab
videos.overview: Bhide tells Jethalal that he is unable to find Bapuji in the temple. Jethalal decides to report to Inspector Pandey that Bapuji has gone missing. Where could Bapuji have gone?

videos.title: New Shop Opened
videos.overview: Bapuji inaugurates the renovated Gada Electronics shop in the nick of time as everyone celebrates Jethalal's happiness.

videos.title: New Shop New Beginning
videos.overview: Jethalal apologises to Inspector Pandey for failing to inform him that Bapuji wasn't missing. Jethalal and Bagha get excited to begin working in their new shop.

videos.title: Sundar's Business Proposal
videos.overview: Sundar gives Jethalal a business proposition. How will Jethalal respond to the proposal?

videos.title: Goli Ne Todi Jethalal Ki Khidki
videos.overview: Goli accidentally breaks Jethalal's window while playing cricket. Will Jethalal get consumed in anger or forgive Tapu Sena?

videos.title: Jethalal Surprises Tapu Sena
videos.overview: To cheer Tapu Sena after the accident in the morning, Jethalal surprises them with a thoughtful gift. They return the favour by treating Jethalal with his favourite savouries.

videos.title: Dost Ki Help
videos.overview: Jethalal's friend asks him for financial help, which he agrees to provide. However, Jethalal finds out that he does not have that money with him. How will he help his friend?

videos.title: Cheque Nahi Cash
videos.overview: Bagha collects five lakh rupees cash from Mr Deepak and gets it to the shop safely. However, Bapuji informs Jethalal that they have to leave early for a birthday party.

videos.title: Peti Ke Andar Peti
videos.overview: Bagha takes the help of Magan to secure the cash kept at the shop. However, Bagha's troubles get doubled as Jethalal gets stuck at a birthday party.

videos.title: Gada Electronics Mein Chor
videos.overview: Jaggu wakes Jethalal in the middle of the night to tell him that someone is trying to rob his shop. How will Jethalal save his shop?

videos.title: Pandey Ji Ka Case
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey makes sure that he has all the information before taking any action. Will he manage to solve the case?

videos.title: Nattu Kaka Ka Hukkum
videos.overview: The thief reveals that he was ordered by Nattu Kaka to help Jethalal. After Jethalal requests Inspector Pandey to let the thief go, Pandey Ji decides never to accept any case from the residents of Gokuldham Society.

videos.title: Naye Nattu Kaka Ka Swagat
videos.overview: The new Nattu Kaka is the first to arrive at the shop and makes a grand entry. Jethalal and Bagha welcome him to their family with open arms.

videos.title: Soda Ka Main Sponsor
videos.overview: Jethalal treats all his friends to a soda party at Abdul's shop. Popatlal catches Bhide for not being able to come up with a thought for the day.

videos.title: Bittu Kaun Hai?
videos.overview: Everyone discusses what should be an appropriate thought for the day. A mysterious boy enters the Gokuldham Society and claims to know Sodhi. Who could it be?

videos.title: Bittu Ki Mushkilein
videos.overview: Sodhi raises his concerns about Bittu's suspicious behaviour. Bittu opens up about the troubles he is facing at school and home. How will Sodhi deal with the situation?

videos.title: Bittu Ki Zimmedari
videos.overview: Bittu threatens to run away if he gets forced to continue studying. He later helps Sodhi at his garage. Has Bittu found his passion?

videos.title: Bittu's Day Out
videos.overview: Nattu Kaka comes up with a marketing plan to increase sales for Gada electronics. Meanwhile, Sodhi takes Tapu Sena and Bittu to a mall.

videos.title: Bittu Ka Future
videos.overview: Due to the rains, Bhide shifts the soda meeting to the clubhouse. Bhide convinces everyone to take responsibility for helping Bittu. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Bittu Ki Counselling
videos.overview: After Bittu runs away, Sodhi takes Goli's help to track and find him. Everyone sits with Bittu and tries to counsel him. Will he understand what the grown-ups have to say?

videos.title: Kya Bittu Ko Ayegi Samajh?
videos.overview: The colony members are worried about Bittu running away due to his hatred towards studying. Will Bittu be found and will he finally realise the importance of education?

videos.title: Bittu Ko Aayi Samajh
videos.overview: Bittu finally realises his mistakes and agrees to concentrate on his studies. Meanwhile, his parents come and are shocked to see the difference in their son.

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Gehne
videos.overview: The society members struggle to keep up with the rising cost of living in the city. Popatlal receives a call from the bank asking him to clear his locker and take his belongings before the branch shuts down.

videos.title: Locker Ki Talaash
videos.overview: Popatlal lives a paranoid life because of not having a locker for his jewellery. Can the Gokuldham residents find him a locker?

videos.title: Popatlal's Paranoia
videos.overview: Popatlal spends sleepless nights in his house thinking about his jewellery's safety. He finally comes to the conclusion that he must keep the box in one of his neighbour's houses.

videos.title: Sirf Ek Zimmedar Aadmi
videos.overview: Popatlal decides to keep the jewellery box at Bhide's house. However, Bhide later finds out that Popatlal is going out of town. Will Bhide be able to keep the jewellery safe?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Amanat
videos.overview: Bhide gets paranoid after getting Popatlal's jewellery and desperately looks for someone else to pass on the responsibility. Who will he find?

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Zewar Hue Idhar Se Udhar
videos.overview: Jethalal tries to pass on the responsibility of the jewellery by giving the box to Babita. Will Popatlal's jewellery get mishandled?

videos.title: Gehno Ki Zimmedari Kaun Le?
videos.overview: Babita passes on the responsibility of the jewellery to Anjali, as she and Iyer have to go somewhere. Will Anjali keep the box or will the exchange of hands continue?

videos.title: Kya Sodhi Sambhaal Payega Zewar?
videos.overview: Popatlal's jewellery ends up at Sodhi's house. However, due to an emergency, Sodhi has to rush to his garage. Will the box be safe at Sodhi's house?

videos.title: Popatlal Asks For His Amanat
videos.overview: Popatlal returns after finishing his work and thanks Bhide for keeping his jewellery safely. How will he react when he finds out the truth?

videos.title: Getting The Box Back
videos.overview: Everyone tries to get Popatlal's box back from the person they gave it to. Jethalal begins to get a bad feeling about the jewellery box. Will his fears come true?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Dabba Gayab
videos.overview: Sodhi and his wife realise that they have messed up and given away the box of jewellery to Abdul without informing him what's in it. Can the Sodhis recover the box?

videos.title: Society Mein Tension
videos.overview: All the residents of Gokuldham society panic as they start blaming each other for the missing Jewellery box. Can they manage to find the box and return it to Popatlal?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Darr
videos.overview: Bhide panics at the thought of Popatlal finding out that he has lost his jewellery box, but the society members reassure him that they all will take responsibility for the mistake. Will they find the jewellery or face Popatlal's wrath?

videos.title: Phas Gaya Bhide
videos.overview: Bhide and Jethalal make excuses in front of Popatlal to delay giving the box. Will Popatlal fall for their lies?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Sona
videos.overview: The society members are shocked to see Popatlal with Sodhi's party sharty bag with the jewellery in it. How did Popatlal get his hands on it?

videos.title: Dabba Khali Hai
videos.overview: After everyone finds the empty jewellery box, they call Bhide to ensure it contains jewellery. How will the members of Gokuldham find the jewellery?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Distracts Popatlal
videos.overview: Jethalal and Sodhi take Tapu Sena's help to distract Popatlal. The members of Gokuldham meet Inspector Pandey and tell him about the theft.

videos.title: Gehno Ke Saath Kho Kho
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham Society give Inspector Pandey a list of suspects in the robbery. The police are quick to respond and round up the suspects. Will they find Popatlal's jewellery?

videos.title: Sabke Ghar Ki Talashi
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey's investigation reveals that the suspects are not guilty of the theft. He insists on checking every household of the Gokuldham members. What will he find?

videos.title: Jethalal Pakkda Gaya
videos.overview: Jethalal gets arrested when Popatlal's jewellery is found at his house. Everyone apologises to Inspector Pandey and requests him to let Jethalal go.

videos.title: Locker Ka Intezaam
videos.overview: Tapu Sena is surprised to hear about the gold being recovered at Jethalal's home. Meanwhile, Jethalal arranges a locker for Popatlal.

videos.title: Bhide Ke Liye Cheque
videos.overview: Bhide receives a piece of good news early in the morning. He decides to surprise his family and take Sodhi's help.

videos.title: Goli Spoils Bhide's Surprise
videos.overview: Goli tells Tapu Sena about Bhide's plan to buy a car. When Sonu does not believe the news, they plan to put on a disguise to follow Sodhi and Bhide to find out the truth.

videos.title: Bhide Ki Choices
videos.overview: Sodhi takes Bhide to a used car shop to look at all the cars that fall into his budget. Goli and Pinku follow them around to find the truth. Which car will Bhide choose?

videos.title: Surprise Bani News
videos.overview: Sonu does not believe Goli when he tells her that Bhide has bought a car. Goli also lets Popatlal know about Bhide's surprise. How will Popatlal react?

videos.title: Surprise Hua Fail
videos.overview: Everyone gathers at Popatlal's house to discuss Bhide's surprise. Jethalal returns home and lets Bapuji in on the news.

videos.title: Har Ghar Tiranga
videos.overview: Bhide can't wait to surprise his family with the new car, but how will his family react to this? Meanwhile, Tapu Sena plans on putting the 'Tiranga' in every house.

videos.title: Gadi Ka Welcome
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham Society make preparations to welcome Bhide's new car. Bhide and Sodhi get shocked when they see the car enter the society. What could have gone wrong?

videos.title: Bhide Reveals His Surprise
videos.overview: Bhide shocks everyone by telling them that he was only helping a friend buy a car. Soon, Bhide reveals his real surprise for his wife and daughter. Later, the members of Gokuldham gather to celebrate 75 years of independence.

videos.title: Roshan Out Of Town
videos.overview: Roshan goes out of town to meet her family but warns Sodhi not to do 'party-sharty' at home. Will Sodhi go behind her back and break the rules?

videos.title: Celebrating Nowruz
videos.overview: The Gokuldham society members get together and celebrate Nowruz with Roshan. Meanwhile, Sodhi and his friends contemplate their 'party-sharty' plan.

videos.title: Sodhi Ki Party
videos.overview: Sodhi plans a party with his friends in Roshan's absence. Will he get caught?

videos.title: Nowruz Ki Khushiya
videos.overview: Roshan finally gets to know about Sodhi's elaborate plan and how everyone was involved in it. Later, the entire colony prays for each other's well-being.

videos.title: Gokuldham Ki Janmashtami
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham society make preparations to celebrate Janmashtami. Will everything go smooth?

videos.title: Dahi Handi Time
videos.overview: The members of the Gokuldham colony are excited to start the 'Dahi handi' proceedings. Will everything go smooth?

videos.title: Govinda Aala
videos.overview: Things get competitive in the Gokuldham colony as all the participants try to break the Handi. Who will win the competition?

videos.title: Goli Ka Prank
videos.overview: Bapuji is starving and asks Jethalal to order food for him, but Jethalal informs him that Komal would be sending them breakfast. However, when the breakfast arrives, Jethalal gets shocked to see the contents.

videos.title: Khush Khabri For Jethalal
videos.overview: Jethalal gets frustrated with Bagha and Nattu Kaka when they delay giving him some good news. What's waiting in line for Jethalal?

videos.title: Jethalal's USA Trip
videos.overview: Jethalal is excited about the opportunity of going to the United States of America. Will he be able to leave on such short notice?

videos.title: America Jane Ki Khush Khabri
videos.overview: Jethalal shares his happiness with all the colony members. Meanwhile, Bhide is still upset about Popatlal's taunts

videos.title: America Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: Jethalal prepares for his journey to the United States of America. Will Jethalal's trip be successful?

videos.title: America Ki Packing
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham colony visit Jethalal with various requests, before he leaves for America. How will Jethalal react to this?

videos.title: Jethalal Chala America
videos.overview: All the neighbours come to see off Jethalal before his departure for America. However, they are worried if Bapuji will be okay while living alone.

videos.title: Bapuji Ka Khayal
videos.overview: The society members call for a meeting to work out a plan on how to take care of Bapuji during Jethalal's absence.

videos.title: Ghar Pe Akele Bapuji
videos.overview: As Jethalal leaves for the United States, Bapuji becomes lonely at home. Will he be okay during his time alone?

videos.title: First Night Alone
videos.overview: All the neighbours come to support Bapuji as she spends his first night alone.

videos.title: Bapuji Ka Plan Chowpat
videos.overview: Bapuji makes a plan to meet his childhood friend for breakfast, but knowing how the Gokuldham colony is, will he make it on time?

videos.title: Gokuldham's First Priority - Bapuji
videos.overview: Everyone in the colony goes out of their way to take care of Bapuji. Will everything go smooth?

videos.title: Bapuji Kidhar Hai?
videos.overview: Bapuji doesn't open his door or answer his phone and sends the entire colony into panic mode. Is Bapuji alright?

videos.title: Bapuji Hue Gussa
videos.overview: Bapuji gets fed up with his neighbours being over-enthusiastic about taking care of him. Will they be understanding and take a step back?

videos.title: Welcoming Bappa
videos.overview: The Gokuldham Colony members are excited about welcoming Bappa. Will everything go according to plan?

videos.title: Gokuldham Colony Mein Aaye Bappa
videos.overview: Gokuldham colony welcomes Bappa with an open heart. How will they celebrate this auspicious occasion?

videos.title: Bappa Ke Aane Ki Khushiyan
videos.overview: The members of the Gokuldham colony celebrate Bappa's arrival but Anjali expresses her concerns about Taarak not being with her on this auspicious occasion.

videos.title: Taarak's Gift
videos.overview: Anjali is upset about Taarak not being around during Ganpati but will his gift make up for it?

videos.title: Taarak Returns
videos.overview: The entire colony is surprised to see Taarak return for the Ganpati celebrations. Meanwhile, Sodhi, Popatlal and Hathi want to know Bhide's questions in advance.

videos.title: Rangarang Karyakram Ka Excitement
videos.overview: The entire colony prepares for the Rangarang Karyakram. Will everything go smooth during the function?

videos.title: Rangarang Karyakram Ke Special Guest
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents begin the Rangarang Karyakram and invite a special guest to host the entire program. Who will the special guest be?

videos.title: Bharat Ke Prasiddh Mandir
videos.overview: Sugandha plays a fun quiz with the Gokuldham residents about the famous temples of India. Who will score the most points and win the game?

videos.title: The Country Of Miracles
videos.overview: The Rangarang Karyakram continues as Sugandha quizzes Babita, Madhavi and Bhide about the famous heritage sites in India. Will they be able to answer all the questions correctly?

videos.title: Hindustan Ki Pehchaan
videos.overview: Sodhi, Popatlal, and Anjali are next in line to participate in Sugandha's quiz. Will they be able to answer all the questions correctly?

videos.title: Bharatiya Sanskriti Ki Khaasiyat
videos.overview: Tapu Sena, Iyer, and Taarak take on the challenge of answering all the quiz questions correctly. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Rangarang Karyakram Ki Charam Seema
videos.overview: Abdul delivers a surprise performance for the Rangarang Karyakram. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha are next in line for the quiz.

videos.title: Shradh Ki Zimmedari
videos.overview: Anjali catches Taarak eating samosas with Tapu Sena. Meanwhile, Taarak gets the responsibility of holding Shradh for his late father. Will Taarak be able to perform this important ritual properly?

videos.title: Shradh Ki Taiyaari
videos.overview: Taarak and the society members prepare for his father's Shradh. Will everything go smooth?

videos.title: Kauwe Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Taarak is worried as he can't find crows to eat his offerings. Gogi, Pinku, and the others offer their help to make the Shradh successful. Will things go in Taarak's favour this time?

videos.title: Shradh Specialist
videos.overview: Taarak finally finds a few crows to eat the Shradh food, but Sodhi unknowingly scares them away. When Taarak is about to lose all hope, Abdul comes up with a unique solution. Will Abdul's idea work?

videos.title: Maha Daan
videos.overview: Taarak and the others make their way to a park to look for crows. However, things take a turn for the worse when a thief steals Taarak's phone. What will he do now?

videos.title: Jethalal Kab Aayega?
videos.overview: Jethalal's family and friends are eagerly waiting for him to return from his USA trip. However, no one has spoken to him in the past two days. Will Jethalal return home safely?

videos.title: Jethalal Returns
videos.overview: Jethalal returns to India without informing about his arrival to any of the society members. Will he return home safely?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Bura Naseeb
videos.overview: After returning from the USA, three thieves rob Jethalal and steal all of his belongings. What will he do now?

videos.title: Jethalal Behind Bars
videos.overview: Jethalal tries to file a complaint at the police station about the robbery. But Chalu Pandey refuses to take his complaint and locks him up instead. What will happen now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Ghar Wapsi
videos.overview: Chalu Pandey lets Jethalal, and the others go after listening to their explanation. Jethalal reaches Gokuldham and decides to surprise Bapuji.

videos.title: Gifts From Jethalal
videos.overview: Jethalal brings a special shirt for Bapuji from his US trip. However, Jethalal is unaware that someone has mistakenly replaced the shirt with a frock. What will happen now?

videos.title: Dosti Ki Bhasha
videos.overview: Jethalal calls Taarak at his office, which puts Taarak's job at risk. How will he handle this situation?

videos.title: Excitement For Navratri
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are eagerly waiting for the Navratri celebrations to begin. Meanwhile, Jethalal finds it difficult to fit into his old Garba dress.

videos.title: Society Ki Permission
videos.overview: Jethalal wants to perform the first aarti of Navratri to pray for Daya's return. However, Bhide says that he has to take permission from all society members first. Will the society members accept his request?

videos.title: Jethalal's Meeting
videos.overview: Jethalal gets the opportunity to perform the first aarti of Navratri. However, he gets called to Lonavala for an important meeting. What will happen now?

videos.title: Jethalal Matlab Musibat
videos.overview: Everyone begins to worry, as Jethalal is getting late for the aarti. Will Jethalal be able to get back in time?

videos.title: Nav Durga Ke Darshan
videos.overview: Jethalal manages to reach on time and performs the first aarti of Navratri. Later, all the Gokuldham residents play Garba together.

videos.title: The Last Film Show In Gokuldham
videos.overview: Asit Modi brings the star of Chhello Show, Bhavin Rabari and the director, Pan Nalin, to meet all of their favourite Gokuldham residents.

videos.title: Bachat Mantra
videos.overview: Bhide shares his mantra for savings with Tapu Sena. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha remind Jethalal about submitting his maintenance cheque.

videos.title: Maintenance Ka Cheque
videos.overview: Bhide celebrates when Jethalal brings the maintenance cheque on time. However, a silly mistake by Jethalal quickly spoils the celebration.

videos.title: Gokuldham Ki Shaan
videos.overview: Bhide finds out that Tapu is about to return to Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Nattu Kaka about spoiling his maintenance cheque.

videos.title: Doctor Hathi Ki Dawa
videos.overview: Jethalal brings Bapuji to Dr Hathi's clinic to treat his stomach ache. Meanwhile, Gokuldham society members are worried about the moss build-up in the society compound.

videos.title: Gokuldham Mein Bhookamp
videos.overview: Dr Hathi slips and falls in the society compound because of the moss build-up. Will the society members be able to lift him up?

videos.title: Sodhi Ka Idea
videos.overview: Sodhi comes up with a unique solution to lift Dr Hathi up from the ground. Will his plan work?

videos.title: Contractor Kaha Milega?
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham society decide to repaint the colony but Bhide struggles to find a contractor who is ready to do the job before Diwali. Can a solution be found?

videos.title: Contractor Ki Khoj
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham society interview multiple contractors and ask for their budget for repainting their colony. Will a suitable contractor be found on time?

videos.title: Patakho Ki Testing
videos.overview: Tapu Sena helps Abdul test the new firecrackers at his shop. Meanwhile, the committee members gather at the clubhouse to finalize a contractor.

videos.title: Contractors Ki Meeting
videos.overview: Society members sit down for a meeting to select the best contractor out of the top four. Will they be able to make a sound decision?

videos.title: Contractors Ki Ladai
videos.overview: After interviewing all the contractors, the society members decide to shortlist one. Who will be the one to get the job?

videos.title: Painting Ka Kaam Shuru
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents decide to give the contract for painting the society to Raju Chamke. Will things go according to plan?

videos.title: Bhide Ka Sabse Bada Darr
videos.overview: The painting job in Gokuldham begins in full zest. However, Bhide is anxious about things going wrong. Will all of his worries come true?

videos.title: Diwali Ki Excitement
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are excited to celebrate Diwali in the newly painted society. But will the contractor be able to complete the work on time?

videos.title: Bad News For Bhide
videos.overview: The contractor gives Bhide the bad news and tells him that the painting job won't get finished on time. What will Bhide do now?

videos.title: Saving Diwali
videos.overview: Bhide is ready to face everyone's anger when the painting job gets delayed. However, he gets a surprise once he steps out of his house.

videos.title: Gokuldham Ki Diwali
videos.overview: After the painting job gets completed, all Gokuldham residents celebrate Diwali together. The next day, Huma Qureshi and Sonakshi Sinha arrive at Gokuldham to meet Dr Hathi.

videos.title: Bapuji Ki Treat
videos.overview: Bapuji treats Tapu Sena with pizzas to reward them for saving the Diwali celebrations. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to penalize Jethalal if he doesn't pay the maintenance cheque on time.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Penalty
videos.overview: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about giving the maintenance cheque. However, Bhide arrives at Jethalal's house and his lie comes out in front of everyone.

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Cheques
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka request Jethalal to sign some cheques. Later, Babita shows up at Jethalal's shop with some of her friends.

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Sabak
videos.overview: Jethalal apologises to Bhide for not submitting the maintenance cheque on time. However, Bhide is adamant that if Jethalal doesn't pay the penalty, he will resign from the secretary post.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Tarkeeb
videos.overview: Bhide agrees to accompany Jethalal and Taarak to the medical store. But he is unaware that it was all a trick to give him the maintenance cheque. What will Bhide do when he finds out the truth?

videos.title: Cheque Ka Hungama
videos.overview: Madhavi tells Bhide that she accidentally washed the kurta that the cheque was in. What will happen when Jethalal finds out about this?

videos.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti Ki Badhaiya
videos.overview: Sodhi and his family celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti with all Gokuldham residents. Meanwhile, Goli is scared as he spills chutney on Sakharam. What will Bhide do when he finds out?

videos.title: Guru Nanak Ji Ki Anmol Seekh
videos.overview: Sodhi and his family continue to celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti and spread happiness among Gokuldham residents.

videos.title: Tapu Sena's Dinner Plan
videos.overview: Tapu Sena decides to take Bapuji out for dinner. Will their dinner plan be successful?

videos.title: Dinner With Bapuji
videos.overview: Bapuji wants to go out for dinner with Tapu Sena, but Jethalal is worried about this plan. How will things pan out?

videos.title: Restaurant Pahuchne Mein Deri
videos.overview: Problems keep piling up one after another, which causes a delay in the dinner plans. Can Tapu Sena and the others reach the restaurant in time?

videos.title: International Client
videos.overview: Jethalal scolds Bagha when a customer complains about him. Later, an important client from abroad contacts Jethalal about a big contract.

videos.title: Taarak's Important Task
videos.overview: Jethalal decides to bring Taarak along with him for the meeting with the international client. However, Taarak refuses as he gets assigned an important task by his boss. What will Jethalal do now?

videos.title: Office Se Chutti
videos.overview: Taarak decides to make an excuse to dodge office work and attend the meeting with Jethalal. Will this plan work?

videos.title: Taarak's Lie
videos.overview: Taarak decides to lie to his boss and help Jethalal instead of going to the office. Will Jethalal get into trouble because of this?

videos.title: International Client's Arrival
videos.overview: Taarak arrives at Jethalal's shop, and all of them await the international client's arrival. Will the business deal go as planned?

videos.title: Taarak In A Mess
videos.overview: Things get complicated for Taarak as his boss reaches Gada Electronics. Will his boss find out that Taarak lied to him about his injury?

videos.title: A Surprise For Taarak
videos.overview: Taarak finds out that his boss is headed to his home to surprise him. Taarak rushes back before his boss finds out that he lied about his injury.

videos.title: Bhide And Abdul's Plan
videos.overview: Bhide and Abdul try to think of excuses to stop Taarak's boss from entering the society. Meanwhile, Taarak and Jethalal encounter a lot of problems on their way home.

videos.title: Doctor Hathi To The Rescue
videos.overview: Doctor Hathi stalls Taarak's boss and takes him to his home. Meanwhile, Taarak encounters even more problems while on his way to Gokuldham. Will Taarak's boss find out about his lie?

videos.title: Tapu Sena's Distraction Plan
videos.overview: Tapu Sena coaxes Taarak's boss to play cricket with them. Will they be able to buy Taarak enough time to return home?

videos.title: Efforts Gone In Vain?
videos.overview: Despite all the efforts from Gokuldham residents, Taarak's boss finally finds his way inside Taarak's house. What will happen when he finds out the truth?

videos.title: Sakharam Goes Missing
videos.overview: Taarak tells everyone how he safely made it back home. Later, Bhide gets a shock as Sakharam goes missing from the society compound.

videos.title: Bhide's Search For Sakharam
videos.overview: Bhide takes Taarak's help to look for Sakharam. Bhide thinks that Jethalal has played a prank on him by taking Sakharam away. Will his hunch prove to be true?

videos.title: Late For Work
videos.overview: Jethalal's tension begins in the morning as Nattu Kaka and Bagha get late for work. However, the tension seemingly goes away as Jethalal receives an order for two hundred TVs.

videos.title: Gambhir Mudda
videos.overview: Jethalal has to go to Daman for an important meeting, and he gives Bhide the responsibility of taking care of Bapuji. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call from the marriage bureau about a potential match.

videos.title: Disheartened Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal gets disheartened when things don't work out for him at the marriage bureau. Later, he eavesdrops on Bhide talking to someone about looking for a potential groom. Will Popatlal finally get a match?

videos.title: The Suitable Groom
videos.overview: Popatlal overhears Bhide's conversation and finds out that his uncle is looking for a suitable groom for his daughter. Will this be the opportunity to get married Popatlal was waiting for?

videos.title: Finding Vidya's Address
videos.overview: Popatlal takes help from Gogi and Goli to find Vidya's address and meet her in person. Will Popatlal's plan work?

videos.title: Shiv Ganga Village
videos.overview: Popatlal, Gogi and Goli travel to Shiv Ganga village to meet Vidya and propose to her for marriage. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to apologise to Popatlal for his behaviour.

videos.title: Popatlal And Vidya
videos.overview: Popatlal decides to meet Vidya at the school where she works as a teacher. Meanwhile, Gogi and Goli's parents begin to grow suspicious about their activities.

videos.title: Angry Sudhakar
videos.overview: Sudhakar is fuming with anger and decides to confront Bhide about Popatlal's actions. What will happen when Popatlal returns to Gokuldham?

videos.title: Bhide's Wrath
videos.overview: Bhide is furious with Popatlal for his actions and chases him all around the colony. What will happen when Bhide finally gets his hands on him?

videos.title: Popatlal Hides
videos.overview: Popatlal sneaks into Iyer and Babita's house to escape Bhide's wrath. But how long will it be before Bhide catches him?

videos.title: Search For Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal hides inside Taarak's house when Iyer refuses to help him. Meanwhile, Bhide looks everywhere around the society in search of Popatlal. What will happen when Popatlal finally catches up to him?

videos.title: Popatlal's Escape
videos.overview: Taarak tries to lure Bhide away so that Popatlal can escape from the society. Will Popatlal find a safe place to hide?

videos.title: Bhide Suspects Everyone
videos.overview: Bhide starts doubting everyone and thinks that they are helping Popatlal hide. Will someone slip up and reveal the truth?

videos.title: Bhide Confronts
videos.overview: Bhide is unable to find Popatlal and his friends tell him to leave the matter for now and confront him when he returns. What will happen next?

videos.title: Sudhakar Mama Warns Gokuldham Society
videos.overview: Sudhakar Mama arrives in Gokuldham society along with other people from his village to confront Bhide and Popatlal. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

videos.title: Bhide's Decision
videos.overview: Chalu Pandey agrees to find Popatlal on the condition that Bhide will not take the case back under any circumstance. What will Bhide do now?

videos.title: Police Complaint Against Popatlal
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are shocked when they learn that Bhide has filed a police complaint against Popatlal. However, Popatlal is still nowhere to be found. What will happen now?

videos.title: Finding Popatlal
videos.overview: Chalu Pandey reassures Bhide that they will find Popatlal in time. He thinks that Popatlal is hiding within the society compound and assigns a special agent to sniff him out.

videos.title: Truth Revealed
videos.overview: Everyone who helped Popatlal gets forced to reveal the truth in front of Bhide. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

videos.title: Will Popatlal be Caught?
videos.overview: Chalu Pandey and his canine look for Popatlal all over the colony. Can 009 find Popatlal's distinct smell and trace him?

videos.title: Inspector Pandey's Celebration
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey catches Popatlal and asks the rest of the members to back off. Will his celebration of catching the first criminal in Gokuldham Society last long?

videos.title: Sudhakar Mama Wants Popatlal
videos.overview: Sudhakar Mama arrives at Gokuldham along with a group of people from his village. Will Bhide and the others hand over Popatlal to them?

videos.title: The Eye Opener
videos.overview: The tables seem to have turned as Sudhakar and Vidya thank Popatlal for opening their eyes. Will Popatlal's wish of getting married finally be fulfilled?

videos.title: Unlucky Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal proves to be unlucky once again, as he finds out that Vidya loves someone else. Meanwhile, Chalu Pandey is adamant about arresting Bhide, as per their deal.

videos.title: Sonu Ke Special Guests
videos.overview: Sonu prepares breakfast for the special guests that are coming to her house. Bhide and Madhavi are puzzled by the change in her behaviour. Who will the special guests be?

videos.title: Year End Sale At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Bhide tells Jethalal and Bapuji about the events that transpired between Popatlal and Sudhakar Mama. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka come up with an innovative offer for increasing sales before the New Year.

videos.title: New Year Ki Party Ka Rang
videos.overview: Tapu Sena takes Bhide's help to plan a party for New Year's Eve. They decide to let everyone draw chits with a random colour that they would have to wear at the party.

videos.title: Gokuldham Welcomes The New Year
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents come together to celebrate the New Year together. However, Taarak is worried that something might go wrong. Will Taarak's fears come true?

videos.title: Naye Saal Ka Naya Suvichar
videos.overview: Bhide kicks off the new year by writing the thought of the day in Sanskrit. However, many Gokuldham residents are puzzled by the meaning behind the thought. Who will be able to decipher its true meaning?

videos.title: Bharat Ki Pracheen Bhasha
videos.overview: Jethalal tries to decipher the meaning behind the thought written in Sanskrit. Meanwhile, Bagha brings good news for Jethalal in the morning.

videos.title: Naye Saal Ki Khushkhabri
videos.overview: Jethalal finds out that the profits of Gada Electronics have increased by fifty per cent over the past year. Meanwhile, Bagha rushes to meet Bawri, who has just returned from Kanpur.

videos.title: Bagha Ka Toota Dil
videos.overview: Bagha gets worried as Bawri gets late for their date. He goes to Bawri's house to check on her but finds that her house is locked.

videos.title: Bagha Ki Tragic Love Story
videos.overview: Bagha gets depressed when Bawri refuses to talk to him. Will Nattu Kaka and Jethalal be able to cheer up his mood?

videos.title: Badey Order Ki Tension
videos.overview: Jethalal is anxious as he receives a large order, but Bagha is in no condition to work. Meanwhile, Jethalal seeks Taarak's help to find a solution to this problem.

videos.title: Bagha Bhaag Gaya
videos.overview: Bagha runs away from home and is not picking up his phone. Meanwhile, Jethalal gets tensed about completing the order on time.

videos.title: Bagha Ho Gaya Seedha
videos.overview: Jethalal and the others find Bagha inside a bar, drinking away his sorrow. What will happen when Bagha drinks too much?

videos.title: Party Sharty Ka Nateeja
