videos.overview: Bagha creates a ruckus in the society, and no one is able to handle him. What will Gokuldham residents do now?

videos.title: Bagha Ki Zidd
videos.overview: Taarak and Anjali come up with a plan to get Bagha to step down from the balcony. Will their plan work?

videos.title: Nashe Mein Bagha
videos.overview: Bagha's drunk antics become a problem for the entire colony. Can a solution be found?

videos.title: Bawri Vapas Aa Gayi
videos.overview: Bagha finally takes a sigh of relief when the real Bawri comes in front of him. However, Jethalal is still worried about completing the order on time.

videos.title: 50 TV Ki Delivery
videos.overview: Jethalal is worried that he has to deliver fifty TVs, but Bagha and Nattu Kaka are not picking up his calls. What will Jethalal do now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Angoothi
videos.overview: Jethalal loses his ring in the society compound. Will Bhide be able to help him find his ring?

videos.title: Bawri's Surprise
videos.overview: Madhavi tells Bhide that the neighbouring society has experienced some ghostly activities. Meanwhile, Bawri arrives at Gada Electronics to surprise Bagha.

videos.title: Employee Aur Boss Ka Rishta
videos.overview: Nattu Kaka and Bagha ask Jethalal to increase their salary. Meanwhile, Taarak gets in trouble with his boss for trying to skip work.

videos.title: Taarak Gives Anjali A Surprise
videos.overview: Jethalal gets worried when Taarak does not answer his calls. Later, Taarak calls Anjali to give her a piece of good news.

videos.title: Taarak Ki Good News
videos.overview: Taarak calls Jethalal to his house to tell him some good news. What will the good news be?

videos.title: Yellow Shirt Ki Problem
videos.overview: Taarak burns his yellow shirt while ironing it. He asks his fellow Gokuldham society members for their help.

videos.title: Taarak Ki Akhri Ummeed
videos.overview: Taarak borrows Dr Hathi's yellow shirt, and Anjali helps him alter it. Will Taarak's problem finally get solved?

videos.title: Taarak Ka Luck
videos.overview: Iyer lends his yellow shirt to Taarak, which fits him perfectly. Gokuldham residents wish him luck for the meeting. Will things go in Taarak's favour?

videos.title: Taarak Phas Gaya
videos.overview: Taarak gets into an accident in the morning, which spoils his yellow shirt. Everyone blames Jethalal for putting Taarak in that situation. What will happen now?

videos.title: Taarak's Green Shirt
videos.overview: Bapuji decides to go and talk to Taarak’s boss. Later, when Taarak and Bapuji arrive at the office, everyone is shocked to see Taarak’s green shirt.

videos.title: Badey Guru Ji Ke Darshan
videos.overview: Taarak arrives at the office, and his boss sees him in a green shirt. Will Bapuji's plan work out?

videos.title: Badey Guru Ji Ki Advice
videos.overview: Taarak gives the presentation in front of the clients. However, the clients are not satisfied with his presentation. What will happen now?

videos.title: Bapuji Ki Jaadui Chhadi
videos.overview: Taarak shares the good news with all the Gokuldham residents and tells them about Bapuji's brilliant idea. Meanwhile, Anjali prepares for the Europe trip.

videos.title: Boss Ka Surprise
videos.overview: Taarak's boss decides to pay Taarak a surprise visit in the morning. What will Taarak do now?

videos.title: Surprise Gift For Taarak
videos.overview: Taarak's boss arrives at Gokuldham, and Taarak receives him at the society gate. Meanwhile, Jethalal and Sodhi look for him in the park.

videos.title: Bade Guruji
videos.overview: Taarak’s boss sees Champaklal and says he wants to meet Bade Guruji. Everyone tries to stop him, but he doesn’t listen.

videos.title: Jhoot Ka Jaal
videos.overview: Bapuji explains how he managed to hide from Taarak's boss. Later, Taarak unboxes the gift his boss gave him.

videos.title: Tapu Sena's Request
videos.overview: Tapu Sena requests Bhide to buy new games for the society clubhouse. Will Bhide approve their request?

videos.title: Bagha Ki Laparvahi
videos.overview: Bhide is curious about Tapu Sena's surprise gift. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Bagha for talking to Bawri during working hours.

videos.title: Bagha's Ghost Story
videos.overview: Jethalal gets angry when Bawri shows up at the shop to meet Bagha. Later, Bagha scares Jethalal with a ghost story.

videos.title: Mystery Box In Gokuldham
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents find mystery boxes outside their homes in the middle of the night. Who could be the one behind this prank?

videos.title: Prankster Of Gokuldham
videos.overview: Rest of the Gokuldham residents open their mystery boxes and find that they all have been pranked. However, Bhide has figured out who is behind this mischief. Will his hunch be correct?

videos.title: Bhide Ka Shak
videos.overview: Bhide begins to think that Goli is the one behind the prank. Will Bhide prove to be right this time?

videos.title: Toofan Aa Gaya Hai
videos.overview: The prankster writes a cryptic message on the society notice board. Gokuldham residents are scared and they think that a ghost is behind all of this. What will happen now?

videos.title: Bhoot Ka Hungama
videos.overview: Bhide, Popatlal and the others look for the ghost on the terrace. Meanwhile, Gokuldham residents find a speaker in the middle of the society compound.

videos.title: Prankster Ki Shart
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are scared and confused as the lights go off in the clubhouse. Meanwhile, the prankster places a very strange condition in front of the society members.

videos.title: The Prankster Returns
videos.overview: The prankster appears before the society member and he turns out to be none other than a member of Gokuldham. Who could this prankster be?

videos.title: Tapu Ka Dhamakedar Surprise
videos.overview: Tapu surprises everyone by coming back. Champaklal and Abdul say they helped Tapu in surprising everyone. Later, Tapu apologizes to everyone for scaring them.

videos.title: Tapu Brings Gifts
videos.overview: Tapu brings special presents for all Gokuldham residents, and he decides to gift them in the middle of the night. Is Tapu planning another prank?

videos.title: Tapu Ka Style
videos.overview: Tapu makes everyone happy with his thoughtful gifts. In the morning, Sonu decides to prepare a special breakfast for Tapu.

videos.title: Tapu Ka Result
videos.overview: Tapu shows his disappointing exam results to Jethalal. Later, Tapu decides to talk to Jethalal about joining Gada Electronics.

videos.title: Gada Pariwaar Ki Nayi Bahu
videos.overview: Tapu's college friend comes to Gokuldham to meet him. Jethalal and Bapuji think this girl could be Tapu's future life partner. Will their assumption prove to be correct?

videos.title: Bhide Ka Sar Dard
videos.overview: Sonu bursts Bhide's bubble and tells him that Missa is not Tapu's girlfriend. Meanwhile, Tapu celebrates his return by playing cricket with his friends in the society compound.

videos.title: Tapu Aur Champaklal Ka Dance
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Baga and Nattu kaka that Tapu is back. Tapu and his friends tell Champaklal they want to dance with him.

videos.title: Babita Needs Help
videos.overview: Babita wants to gift her cousin a TV which is high in demand. She asks Jethalal for his help in acquiring this TV. Will Jethalal accept her request?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Pratigya
videos.overview: Jethalal vows to shave his head if he is unable to fulfil his promise to Babita. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka find a customer for the TV.

videos.title: Profit Ka Dukh
videos.overview: Bawri calls Bagha to fix her scooter. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka is excited as he secured a profitable deal for the TV. What will Jethalal do when he finds out?

videos.title: Search For The TV
videos.overview: Jethalal throws a tantrum when he finds out that the TV has been sold. How will Jethalal fulfil the promise he made to Babita now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Baal Khatre Mein Hai
videos.overview: Jethalal is unable to find the TV anywhere, and he feels hopeless. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer arrive at Jethalal's shop, hoping to buy the TV from him. What will happen now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Promise
videos.overview: Jethlalal is stressed about the promise he made to Iyer. Bawri comes to Jethalal’s rescue. Will Jethalal keep the promise he made to Iyer?

videos.title: Holi Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: The kids of the colony are excited for Holi and begin their preparations for a memorable celebration. Will everything go according to plan?

videos.title: Holika Dahan In Gokuldham
videos.overview: Tapu Sena apologizes to Bhide for pranking him. Meanwhile, preparations for the Holi celebration continue in Gokuldham.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ke Holi Plans
videos.overview: Tapu Sena tells everyone about their Holi plans. However, Gokuldham residents are worried that something might go wrong as usual. What troubles will be waiting for them?

videos.title: Hungame Vaali Holi
videos.overview: Members of the Tapu Sena cover Bhide with Holi colours and drench him with water. Later, Bhide finds out that Tapu mixed itching powder with the colour. What will happen now?

videos.title: Tension Ke Rang
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are waiting for Dr Hathi to arrive and treat Bhide. Meanwhile, Inspector Chalu Pandey pays them a surprise visit.

videos.title: Khujli Powder Ka Sach
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey wants to arrest Tapu for throwing itching powder at Bhide. However, Dr Hathi arrives on time and decides to inspect the Holi colours. Will Dr Hathi prove Tapu's innocence?

videos.title: Aage Ki Soch
videos.overview: Babita and Iyer come to Jethalal's house with a problem, and Tapu gives them a solution. Later, Jethalal asks Tapu about his future plans.

videos.title: Baccho Ka Bhavishya
videos.overview: All the parents are worried that the kids are not focused on their life goals. Tapu comes up with an idea which will alleviate their tension and also ensure that the fun in their life never ends.

videos.title: Tapu Sena's New Mission
videos.overview: Taarak talks to the kids about their career goals. Tapu promises that all of them will come up with a plan to make their families proud.

videos.title: Baccho Ka Secret Project
videos.overview: Jethalal and the others ask for Bapuji's help to find out what Tapu Sena is up to. Meanwhile, the kids decide to present their secret project in front of everyone the next day.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ka Nimantran
videos.overview: Everyone is wondering what could be Tapu Sena's secret project. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena invites all the residents of Gokuldham to the clubhouse, where they will present their idea.

videos.title: Bhide Hai Pareshan
videos.overview: Bhide is worried and wants to find out what is Tapu Sena going to do at 8:30 pm and comes up with an idea. Will he be able to find out about their plan?

videos.title: Program Ka Chief Guest
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents arrive at the clubhouse for the special program. All of them are curious about the secret chief guest for their program. Who could it be?

videos.title: Suspense Khatam Hua
videos.overview: The secret investor turns out to be none other than Asit Kumarr Modi, who helped Tapu Sena put their entire project together. Only one question remains now, what is this secret project that the kids have been working so hard for?

videos.title: Manoranjan Ka Khazana
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents praise Tapu Sena for their innovative ideas and hard work. Later, Gokuldham residents celebrate Gudi Padwa together.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ki Safalta
videos.overview: Popatlal confronts Asit Kumarr Modi about not finding a suitable bride for him. Meanwhile, everyone enjoys the rhymes and mobile games created by Tapu Sena.

videos.title: Rickshaw Kahan Hain?
videos.overview: Jethalal and Babita cannot find an auto that is ready to take them to their destination. He then faces a group of angry auto drivers. Will Jethalal reach his shop in time with the important meeting inching closer?

videos.title: Nayi Scheme
videos.overview: Rustom from Ramsang company decides to put Gada Electronics on the blacklist for Jethalal's unprofessional behaviour. Jethalal sees Rustom running from Gada Electronics and assumes he is a thief. What will happen now?

videos.title: Gada Electronics Ki Scheme
videos.overview: Jethalal is excited about the new scheme that Gada Electronics has been selected for and wishes to see Babita benefit from it. Tapu is keen on marketing this scheme in the best possible way. Later, Jethalal tells the society members about the scheme at Gada Electronics.

videos.title: Popatlal Calls Out On The Scheme
videos.overview: Popatlal calls out schemes such as the one announced by Jethalal, to be fraudulent. All the society members look forward to making purchases to increase their probability of benefiting from the scheme.

videos.title: Scheme Ke Liye Excitement
videos.overview: The society members are excited and looking forward to making purchases under the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Bagha and Natu Kaka have made all the necessary preparations for the big day of the sale. How will Jethalal react?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ka Marketing Plan
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka ask Bawri to hide before Jethalal reaches the store. Tapu Sena presents their marketing plan for the scheme before Jethalal. Later, a crowd assembles outside Jethalal's shop but doesn't enter the premises. What is the matter?

videos.title: Jethalal Gets Concerned
videos.overview: All the society members are impressed with the promotional video made by Tapu Sena, for the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Jethalal shares his worries with Taarak about the probability of things not running smoothly. What will happen?

videos.title: Sale At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Jethalal gets anxious when he sees there are no customers at Gada electronics. Baga gets caps for the employees of Gada electronics. Will people turn up at Gada Electronics?

videos.title: The Day Of The Scheme
videos.overview: The society members assemble before setting out to make purchases under the scheme at Gada Electronics. Meanwhile, Jethalal's shop is packed with customers. Will the society members reach on time before the coupons run out?

videos.title: The Society Members Reach The Shop
videos.overview: Sunita reaches Jethalal's shop to make a purchase. While Jethalal and his team continue attending to various customers, the society members, except Babita, arrive at the shop. Will Babita reach in time?

videos.title: Chalu Panday Arrives At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Inspector Panday arrives at Jethalal's shop to shop under the scheme followed by Babita. All the society members make their purchases under the scheme and return to the society.

videos.title: Fantasies About Winning The Lucky Draw
videos.overview: Jethalal is happy about the day that it has gone well. The society members decide to sit together at the clubhouse to watch the results of the lucky draw. They fantasize about what they'd do if they won the car.

videos.title: Kaash Mujhe Car Mil Jae
videos.overview: Bhide interrupts Tapu Sena's enthusiasm for creating a ruckus in the compound. Later, the society members pray to their respective gods, asking god to make them win the car.

videos.title: Lucky Draw Ka Din
videos.overview: All the society members gather together in the clubhouse for the lucky draw's announcement hoping to win a car under the Ramsang company's scheme. Who will win the car?

videos.title: Popatlal Wins The Honeymoon Coupon
videos.overview: All the society members gear up for the announcement of the last two coupon prizes. With Popatlal having won the honeymoon coupon, who will win the car?

videos.title: Khushi Bhet
videos.overview: Jethalal, Bagha and Nattu Kaka recount the events that transpired during the lucky draw viewing at the clubhouse, for Champaklal. Later, an excited Babita decides to attend driving lessons.

videos.title: Coupon Kahan Gaya?
videos.overview: Babita gets a nightmare and calls Jethalal in the middle of the night to make sure that the coupon is safe with Jethalal. The following morning, Jethalal leaves for his shop with Babita, Bhide and Popatlal coupons.

videos.title: Taarak Warns Jethalal
videos.overview: Taarak warns Jethalal, asking him to be careful with the coupons because of his streak of bad luck when it comes to handling others' responsibilities. Meanwhile, Babita registers for driving lessons and Jethalal tries to speed up the process of Babita receiving the car earlier than customary.

videos.title: Is The Coupon At Risk?
videos.overview: Jethalal is ecstatic to inform Babita about her being able to receive the car on her preferred day. Later, Jethalal calls Taarak in agony, asking for help on a situation with the coupon. What is it regarding?

videos.title: Car Coupon
videos.overview: Rustom from Ramsung congratulates Jethalal and gives him a certificate of appreciation. Jethalal tells Rustom he doesn’t have the car coupon. How will Rustom react?

videos.title: Babita Ka License
videos.overview: Bagha uses Bawri’s idea to prevent Rustom and Babita from learning the truth. Mahila Mandal is very excited because Babita is getting a car. How will everyone react when they get to know about Jethalal's lies?

videos.title: Sihayi Hatane Ka Idea
videos.overview: Bagha asks Dolly from Ramsung about Babita’s car colour. Bagha suggests they should make a duplicate car coupon. Later, Taarak gives an idea to Jethalal on how to get the ink off the car coupon. Will this idea work?

videos.title: Taarak Ka Tedha Idea
videos.overview: Rustom makes it clear to Jethalal that if he doesn’t receive the car coupon before 6 pm, he won’t give the car to Babita. Taarak has an idea that he believes could help Jethalal with his problem, but his boss won’t let him out of his sight. How will Taarak help Jethalal now?

videos.title: Car Coupon Ka Sach
videos.overview: Jethalal decides to tell the truth to Rustom about the car coupon. How will Rustom react to the truth?

videos.title: Sachai Ki Raah
videos.overview: Taarak prepares Jethalal to tell the truth to Babita and Champaklal. Later, Babita along with Tapu Sena plans to surprise Iyer with the new car.

videos.title: Babita Ki Narazgi
videos.overview: Jethalal and Taarak arrive at Babita's house to tell her the truth about the car coupon. How will Babita react when she finds out what happened?

videos.title: Taarak And Jethalal Are Stressed
videos.overview: Taarak gets upset when Anjali asks him to welcome Babita’s new car with everyone. Popatlal calls Jethalal to Abdul’s soda shop, but Jethalal avoids his call.

videos.title: Jethalal Is Restless
videos.overview: Jethalal is not able to sleep because he is tense and decides to run away from home. Will he run away from the situation or face the situation and own his mistake?

videos.title: Dukh Dayak Samachar
videos.overview: Taarak acts irritable and asks Jethalal to talk to Babita. Babita asks Tapu to get a cake for Jethalal. Later, Jethalal writes a letter to Babita. What will happen next?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Khat
videos.overview: Jethalal asks Goli to give his letter to Babita. Babita loses the letter and calls Jethalal to ask about the letter. Will Jethalal tell her the truth?

videos.title: Iyer Ke Liye Surprise
videos.overview: Taarak asks Jethalal to tell Iyer the entire truth. Everyone is eagerly waiting for Babita’s car, and Tapu Sena prepares to surprise Iyer.

videos.title: Car Ka Golmol
videos.overview: Babita asks Jethalal to call Ramsung company and ask about the car. Jethalal tries to tell the truth to Babita in front of everyone when Bagha along with Rustom arrives in Gokuldham society. Will Babita finally learn the truth?

videos.title: Jethalal's Letter
videos.overview: The entire Gokuldham society cheers for Jethalal. Rustom asks Babita to send the car to his showroom for registration. Babita reads the letter Jethalal had written to her. What will be Babita’s reaction?

videos.title: Chamatkari Baba
videos.overview: Nattu Kaka and Bagha tell everyone that whoever took out the ink from the coupon has asked them not to reveal his identity. Who is this mystery man?

videos.title: Babita Ke Car Ka Sapna Hua Poora

videos.title: Surprise Gift
videos.overview: Champaklal decides to give a surprise gift to Tapu. Later, Bhide stops Tapu Sena from playing cricket at night. What will Tapu Sena do now?

videos.title: Bhide Gets Protective
videos.overview: Bhide scolds Tapu for calling Sonu inappropriately. Later, Bhide reads Tapu's messages on Sonu's phone and gets furious.

videos.title: Jasoos Bhide
videos.overview: Bhide follows Tapu and Sonu and spies on them. What will he find after following them?

videos.title: Tapu Ka Proposal
videos.overview: Bhide gets scared when he finds out his friend's daughter ran away with someone. Later, Bhide sees Tapu planning a surprise for Sonu and proposing to her. How will Bhide react now?

videos.title: Bhide Ki Sharamnak News
videos.overview: Bhide tells Madhavi about Tapu and Sonu, but she doesn't believe him. Bhide calls Jethalal and says he has a piece of very shocking news for him. How will Jethalal react to Bhide's news?

videos.title: Problem Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Everyone tries to find out what happened between Bhide and Jethalal. Later, Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house and waits for Bhide to come. What will Bhide do now?

videos.title: Bhide Ko Laga Jhatka
videos.overview: Tapu gives a surprise to everyone and a return gift to Champaklal. Later, everyone asks Bhide what he wanted to talk to Jethalal about.

videos.title: Bhide Ki Asli Baat
videos.overview: Champaklal decides to give everyone a dinner treat. Jethalal is curious about what Bhide wanted to tell him and asks for Taarak's help. Will Bhide tell Jethalal the truth?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Shaadi Ki Charcha
videos.overview: Anjali and Taarak talk about Popatlal's marriage. Later, the kids tell Champaklal about their new game.

videos.title: Hasi Khushi Se Raho
videos.overview: Madhavi gets extremely upset because she thinks Bhide doesn't like her food. Later, Gokuldham men meet at Abdul’s soda shop, and Taarak’s deep words impress everyone.

videos.title: Popatlal Is Hurt
videos.overview: Popatlal gets angry when Jethalal says girls refuse to get married to him. Later, someone plays the violin in the Gokuldham society, and everybody dances. Who is this talented person?

videos.title: Matchmaker Vinu Kaka
videos.overview: Popatlal finds out about Vinu Kaka and feels positive about his marriage. Later, Popatlal meets Vinu Kaka and asks him about his marriage. Will Popatlal get any good news?

videos.title: Kuch Pao Aur Kuch Kho
videos.overview: Popatlal says he needs some time to think about changing his name. Bhide gets worried when Viku Kaka sees Sonu’s hand and says she will get married to someone who lives nearby. Later, Popatlal goes to Jethalal and asks for his advice.

videos.title: Beheno Ka Decision
videos.overview: Bagha makes chits to solve Popatlal’s problem. Popatlal decides to let Mahila Mandal make the final decision about his name. Will Mahila Mandal solve Popatlal’s problem?

videos.title: P Se Naam
videos.overview: Everyone tries to find a new name for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal invites everyone to his party to celebrate his name-keeping ceremony.

videos.title: Name Voting
videos.overview: Everyone arrives at Popatlal’s name ceremony party except Jethalal and Champaklal. Later, Popatlal gives a speech to everyone.

videos.title: Choose One Name
videos.overview: Everyone from Gokuldham society votes for names that would suit Popatlal the most. Whose name will Popatlal choose?

videos.title: Unlucky Name
videos.overview: Jethalal suggests a few names from the letter P for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal finally finds the perfect name for himself but Iyer says it’s not the right name for him. What will happen now?

videos.title: Alvida Popatlal
videos.overview: Tapu Sena decides to give a gift to Popatlal. Popatlal’s relative’s ghost is angry because she doesn’t want him to change his name. What will he do now?

videos.title: Pyaarelal Ka Purse
videos.overview: A girl compliments Pyaarelal for his name and will marry someone with the same name. Pyaarelal’s editor is upset with him because he changed his name. Later, Pyaarelal gets into confusion with the police because of his name.

videos.title: Rishta Aa Gaya
videos.overview: Pyaarelal starts doubting his decision to change the name but Anjali informs him about a proposal that came for him. Later, Pyaarelal asks Taarak to take an off from the office and be with him, but his boss is in a bad mood. What will Taarak do now?

videos.title: Do Do Rishte
videos.overview: Taarak convinces his boss to give him leave from the office for half a day. Pyaarelal asks Anjali about Sapna. Later, Pyaarelal sets up a meeting with two different girls for marriage on the same day. What will happen now?

videos.title: Ek Ghante Ki Meeting
videos.overview: Everyone gets ready to meet Sapna and Kalpana. Pyaarelal gets happy when he meets Sapna. Will this meeting change Pyaarelal’s life?

videos.title: Sapna Ka Jawab
videos.overview: Sapna’s father asks questions to Pyaarelal. Sapna and Pyaarelal talk in private to get to know each other better. Will Sapna say yes to Pyaarelal?

videos.title: Sapna Ya Kalpana?
videos.overview: Pyaarelal and Sapna talk it out in person and seem to like each other. However, Pyaarelal is concerned about meeting Kalpana first before giving his decision. Who will he pick?

videos.title: Hum Dono Ki Haan Hai
videos.overview: Pyaarelal and Kalpana talk in private. Later, Sapna and Kalpana both agree to marry Pyaarelal. What will happen now?

videos.title: Pyaarelal's Dilemma
videos.overview: Pyaarelal gets into trouble when he says yes to both Kalpana and Sapna for marriage. How will he get out of this problem?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ka Idea
videos.overview: Champaklal asks Pyaarelal to refuse to marry either Sapna or Kalpana. Later, Pyaarelal tells Tapu Sena about his problem. Will Tapu Sena find a solution to his problem?

videos.title: Pyaarelal Under Pressure
videos.overview: Pyaarelal decides to meet Sapna and Kalpana once again. Later, Sapna’s family treats Pyaarelal like their son-in-law which makes the situation even more difficult for him.

videos.title: Pyaarelal Ke Bahane
videos.overview: Pyaarelal tells Sapna he has to leave to attend to a work emergency but instead goes to meet Kalpana. Will Sapna find out about this?

videos.title: Bohot Sara Khaana
videos.overview: Pyaarelal goes out with Sapna to get to know her better but soon leaves to meet Kalpana. Will Pyaarelal be able to choose one girl between Kalpana and Sapna?

videos.title: 6 Baje Wali Samasya
videos.overview: Kalpana and Sapna are head over heels in love with Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal is worried because he fixes a date with Kalpana and Sapna at the same time and same place. What will happen now?

videos.title: Yellow Or Blue?
videos.overview: Kalpana gets a tatto for Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal goes to Sapna while he is on a date with Kalpana. Police find Pyaarelal's behaviour suspicious and keep an eye on him.

videos.title: Pyaarelal Ka Shagun
videos.overview: Pyaarelal tells his dream to everyone. Kalpana’s father fixes a meeting with Pyaarelal to give him Shagun, and Sapna’s family also decides to come with Shagun to Pyaarelal’s house.

videos.title: Pyaarelal Ke Khushi Ka Din
videos.overview: Gokuldham society members prepare for Pyaarelal and Kalpana’s Shagun ceremony. Later, Kalpana comes with her family to Pyaarelal’s house.

videos.title: Kalpana Ka Final Decision
videos.overview: Kalpana and her family find out the truth about Pyaarelal's name and Kalpana decides to break up with him. Later, Jethalal and Taarak give good news to Pyaarelal. What is it?

videos.title: Yellow Shagun Ceremony
videos.overview: Pyaarelal calls and invites Bagha, Nattu kaka and Bawri for his Shagun ceremony with Sapna. Later, everyone welcomes Sapna and her family to Gokuldham society.

videos.title: Sapna Ki Love Story
videos.overview: A man named Swapnil loves Sapna, and Pyaarelal brings him to his Shagun ceremony and helps them get together with each other. Later, Pyaarelal decides to change his name back to Popatlal.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ki Outstation Trip
videos.overview: Tapu Sena visit Popatlal and helps cheer up his mood. Later, Tapu informs Jethalal that he is going outstation on a trip with all of his friends.

videos.title: Leave Ki Permission
videos.overview: Jethalal runs away to save himself from Anjali’s diet breakfast. Anjali reminds Taarak of their anniversary when they first met and asks him to take an off from the office. Will Taarak be able to convince his boss to take a leave for a day?

videos.title: Bagha Ka Idea
videos.overview: Taarak is worried because he doesn’t know how to take leave from his office and decides to ask Jethalal for advice. Taarak shares his problem with Bagha. Will Bagha be able to help Taarak with his problem?

videos.title: Boss Ki Permission
videos.overview: Taarak tries to find out his boss’s mood and asks Bagha to call him. Later, Bagha reminds Taarak of the promise he made.

videos.title: Taarak Ka Special Day
videos.overview: Jethalal finds out that his dream company wants to meet him tomorrow for a meeting. Jethalal asks Taarak to take a leave from his office and attend the meeting with him. How will Taarak manage to help Jethalal and also spend time with Anjali on their anniversary?

videos.title: Important Meeting Ki Tyaari
videos.overview: Taarak suggests Jethalal to take Bagha and Nattu Kaka for his dealership meeting. Later, Taarak asks Jethalal to stay quiet during the whole meeting and let Bagha and Nattu Kaka speak. Will Jethalal get this dealership?

videos.title: Bagha Is Well Prepared
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Taarak that Mike Gatting has become his company’s manager. Bagha impresses Jethalal with his presentation and English. Will he be able to get the dealership for Gada Electronics?

videos.title: Hum Meeting Ke Liye Taiyyar Hain
videos.overview: When the guests from the company arrive, they get a little confused seeing Jethalal with a 'Mon Vrat'. The dealership employees walk out as they only want to speak to Jethalal. Will Jethalal get the dealership?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Priya Mitra
videos.overview: Champaklal unknowingly exposes Jethalal and Taarak lying in front of the dealership employees. Later, Jethalal books a table for Anjali and Taarak at his friend’s restaurant.

videos.title: Jethalal Ne Baati Mithaiyaan
videos.overview: Jethalal joyfully distributes sweets to all the members of society to commemorate the successful acquisition of a new dealership.

videos.title: Wakeel Ka Number
videos.overview: All the society members get ready for the monsoons as they run their chores. Meanwhile, Taarak gets called into his boss' cabin. Will he be in trouble?

videos.title: Bagha Bana Vakeel
videos.overview: Tarak's boss asks him to share his lawyer's number which makes him nervous. He confirms with Bagha and asks him to pretend to be a lawyer. Will he get caught?

videos.title: Mall Ke Daam
videos.overview: Tapu Sena accidentally hurts Bhide. Later, Sunita sells vegetables to Mahila Mandal at a higher rate. What will Mahila Mandal do now?

videos.title: Daya Ki Yaad
videos.overview: Bhide asks Tapu Sena to stop playing video games. Later, everyone asks Jethalal when is Daya coming back and he starts missing her.

videos.title: Sundar In Trouble
videos.overview: Jethalal gets a call from the police station to inform him that they have arrested Sundar. How will Jethalal help him now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ko Mila Bhoot
videos.overview: Jethalal gets a call from the police station. Sodhi gives a lawyer’s number to Jethalal. Later, Jethalal and his friends have an encounter with a ghost on their way to the police station.

videos.title: Bin Bulaye Mehman
videos.overview: Sundar tells Jethalal that he won a challenge because of him and Jethalal asks for his commission. Sundar tricks Jethalal into making tea for him and his friends.

videos.title: Ghost Show
videos.overview: Inspector Panday is furious with Jethalal for calling him to the police station in the middle of the night for no reason. Later, Sundar and his friends try to scare Inspector Panday by dressing up as ghosts.

videos.title: Sundar's Friend's Loan
videos.overview: Champaklal apologizes to Inspector Panday on behalf of Jethalal. Sundar tells Jethalal that he has a surprise for him. Later, Sundar wakes up Champaklal and Tapu in the middle of the night.

videos.title: Ek Bhayanak Sapna
videos.overview: Sundar tells his problem to Champaklal and asks him to come to Ahmedabad with him. Later, Sundar plans a surprise for Jethalal. What is the surprise?

videos.title: Surprise Ka Secret
videos.overview: Anjali forces Taarak to drink healthy juice. Jethalal wants to know what surprise Sundar is planning for him. Later, everyone gathers at the clubhouse to find out about Sundar’s surprise.

videos.title: Sundar Ka Start Up
videos.overview: Sundar asks Jethalal to do the inauguration of his stall. Everyone enjoys food from Sundar’s stall. Later, Sunday tells everyone that he has one more surprise for Jethalal.

videos.title: Jethalal Tries To Run
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka try to convince Jethalal to take up Sundar’s offer to join his food business. Jethalal fears that he might have to pay for the lights and decorations. Later, Tapu tells Sundar about the games Tapu Sena has made.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Doosri Shaadi
videos.overview: Sundar leaves for Ahmedabad but Jethalal tries to stop him. Taarak asks Jethalal to get re-married. Later, Taarak tricks Sundar and forces him to return to Gokuldham society.

videos.title: Doosri Shaadi Ke Sapne
videos.overview: Taarak tells Sundar that Jethalal is thinking about getting married again. Later, Champaklal finds out about Jethalal’s intentions and gets angry at him. What will happen now?

videos.title: Daya Ke Wapas Aane Ki News
videos.overview: Sundar says he knew that everyone was acting when they said Jethalal is getting married again. Later, Sundar decides to tell Jethalal when Daya is returning to Gokuldham society.

videos.title: Iyer Ki Good News
videos.overview: All the Gokuldham men are very happy to sit and have soda together. Iyer gets angry with Jethalal for pulling his leg. Later, Iyer says he has good news for everyone. What is it?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Worng Guess
videos.overview: Bhide’s morning quote triggers Popatlal. Later, Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Iyer's good news is not what he was thinking about. What will happen now?

videos.title: Jethalal Bribes Goli
videos.overview: Taarak and Jethalal ask Goli to go to Iyer’s house and find out about his good news. Will Iyer tell the good news to Goli?

videos.title: Bazigar Iyer
videos.overview: Jethalal is afraid of losing while everyone waits for Iyer to come and give the good news. Later, Champaklal learns about Jethalal and Iyer’s bet. Who will win this bet?

videos.title: Car Ki Tamanna
videos.overview: Jethalal congratulates Babita on her new car. Everyone in Gokuldham society wishes they also had a car. Later, Iyer and Babita meet Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Bawri to give them sweets.

videos.title: Toofani Din
videos.overview: A big storm hits Mumbai, and Anjali asks Taarak not to go to the office. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka reach the shop and wait for Jethalal to come.

videos.title: Barsat Mein Pareshani
videos.overview: Everyone gets a day off from work because of the heavy rains. Bhide plans to spend a romantic day with Madhavi but one of his students shows up. How will Bhide's day go?

videos.title: Haso Hasao Divas
videos.overview: Iyer plans to watch a movie with Babita at home while Tapu Sena is getting bored and decide to make everyone laugh and entertain them. What will Tapu Sena do now?

videos.title: Bade Bhi Bane Bacche
videos.overview: Tapu calls the rest of the Gokuldham members outside in his unique style to have fun with them and celebrate the ‘Haso Hasao Divas’.

videos.title: Bhagwan Krishna Ki Gokul Nagri
videos.overview: Taarak’s boss scolds him for playing outside instead of working. Inspector Panday also celebrates ‘Haso Hasao Divas’ with Gokuldham members. Later, Lord Krishna gives his blessings to the Gokuldham society.

videos.title: Khushiyon Ke 15 Saal
videos.overview: Gokuldham Society celebrates 15 years of 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah' by reminiscing beautiful memories of the show.

videos.title: Champaklal Plays Pool
videos.overview: Goli and Tapu have a pool competition which Goli tries to win by cheating. Tapu Sena decides to teach Champaklal how to play pool. Later, Mahila Mandal plans a trip to enjoy the lovely weather.

videos.title: Mehenge Tamatar
videos.overview: Anjali tells Mahila Mandal that Taarak gave a polythene full of fresh tomatoes to the garbage man. Later, Sunita explains why she has increased the price of all the vegetables.

videos.title: Tamatar Ka Achar
videos.overview: Madhavi tells Bhide that she forgot to make Mr Nayar’s order of tomato pickles. Champkalal explains to Bhide the importance of respecting customers in business. Later, Bhide and Popatlal get into an accident.

videos.title: Tamatar Milna Hua Mushkil
videos.overview: Bhide struggles to find 40 kilos of tomatoes in one place. Bhide goes to Gada Electronics and sees a lot of tomatoes there. What will Bhide do now?

videos.title: Tempo Mein Tamatar
videos.overview: Bhide calls his uncle in Nashik who has a farm and asks him if he can give him tomatoes. Later, Taarak tells Bhide that a tempo full of tomatoes was looted on its way to Mumbai from Nashik. What will happen now?

videos.title: Tamatar Ne Badhai Tension
videos.overview: Baliya is Bhide's last hope for getting his hands on tomatoes in time. Taarak explains why the price of tomatoes has increased drastically. Meanwhile, the Bhide family passes their time by playing a game of cards and watching a movie together.

videos.title: Tamatar Ki Chori
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi get very happy when they see tomatoes. They are not able to bring all the tomatoes to their flat so Bhide decides to stay down with the tomatoes. Later, the tomatoes get stolen.

videos.title: Kon Hai Tamatar Chor?
videos.overview: Bhide thinks Tapu Sena is messing with him by hiding the tomatoes while Iyer blames Jethalal. Gokuldham society members try to figure out who could’ve stolen the tomatoes while Bhide calls Inspector Panday for help.

videos.title: Nau Do Gyaara
videos.overview: Inspector Panday thinks someone from Gokuldham society has stolen Bhide’s tomatoes. Later, Inspector Panday sends his men to catch the rickshaw driver whom Abdul saw running away from the society.

videos.title: Padosi Ne Ki Padosi Ki Madad
videos.overview: Nobody is ready to believe that Popatlal is a thief, but Inspector Panday decides to arrest him. Later, Popatlal tells everyone what actually happened. Will Inspector Panday believe him?

videos.title: Gas Bich Mien Hui Khatam
videos.overview: Madhavi starts making tomato pickles for her customer while the gas cylinder at Bhide’s house gets over. What will happen now?

videos.title: Independence Day Plans
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal there has been a robbery in their village and ask for their salary in advance. Later, Tapu Sena makes plans for going for an outing instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone.

videos.title: Bhide Vs Tapu Sena
videos.overview: Bhide teaches his tuition kids about Independence Day. Later, Tapu Sena asks Bhide if they can go on a picnic to Khandala instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone. Bhide asks Champaklal to teach the kids a lesson.

videos.title: Saare Bhartiya Bhai Bhai
videos.overview: Bhide thanks Champaklal for guiding him in the right direction while Taarak writes a poem for Independence Day. Later, everyone gathers to celebrate Independence Day.

videos.title: Long Drive Ke Sapne
videos.overview: Taarak, Bhide and Jethalal decide to go to the office together while Jethalal gets a chance to ride with Babita in her car.

videos.title: Chintamani
videos.overview: Dr Hathi’s patient, Chintamani, tells Dr Hathi that there is something wrong with him. Mahila Mandal meets for a kitty party while Goli gets ready to go to a medical camp.

videos.title: Namune Customers
videos.overview: All men from Gokuldham society gather to drink soda and talk about the kinds of customers they have to deal with.

videos.title: Champaklal Is Sick
videos.overview: Bhide writes a good message on the society board. Champaklal catches a cold while Tapu tells Jethalal about maps on the phone.

videos.title: All The Best Goli
videos.overview: Popatlal gets ready to go to somebody’s wedding, but Bhide drops green chutney on Popatlal’s new clothes. Tapu and Sony try to get the stain off his clothes. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Chintamani Piche Padh Gaya
videos.overview: Chintamani gets all his health tests done and shows his reports to Dr Hathi. Tapu takes Champaklal to Dr Hathi because he is not well. Will Champakal feel better after consulting Dr Hathi?

videos.title: Danger Bhai
videos.overview: Dr Hathi tells his friends that he is fed up with Chintamani. Dr Hathi gets to know that Chitamani has fainted and is admitted to a hospital. Later, a man named Danger bhai comes to Gokuldham and looks for Dr Hathi.

videos.title: Dr Hathi Ki Talaash
videos.overview: Sodhi gets into a fight with Danger Bhai. Danger Bhai asks Bhide about Dr Hathi’s house. Later, Danger Bhai decides to give an injection to Dr Hathi that would make him unconscious. What will happen now?

videos.title: Khoj Jaari Hai
videos.overview: The goons look for Dr Hathi but are unable to find him but Danger Bhai is not ready to give up. Later, Danger Bhai’s men tell him that they couldn't search Champaklal’s house because he didn’t open the gate. Is Dr Hathi hiding there?

videos.title: Iyer Ne Saath Chodha
videos.overview: Champaklal tries to explain to Danger Bhai that Dr Hathi is a good doctor. Danger Bhai threatens all the men of Gokuldham society to get them to speak the truth. What will happen now?

videos.title: Gokuldham Vs. Danger Bhai
videos.overview: Iyer locks up Danger Bhai and his men inside the clubhouse and they try to break down the door. Later, Champaklal asks everyone to get things from their house that can be used as weapons. Who will win this fight?

videos.title: Inspector Panday Stops Danger Bhai
videos.overview: Inspector Panday and his team arrive on time and save Champaklal from Danger Bhai’s injection. Later, Danger Bhai asks Inspector Panday to arrest Dr Hathi also for giving wrong medicine to his brother. What will happen now?

videos.title: Galat Dawai Ki Kahani
videos.overview: Abdul tells everyone how he hid Dr Hathi from Danger Bhai and called Inspector Panday to save Dr Hathi. Later, Dr Hathi tells Inspector Panday what actually happened with Danger Bhai’s brother, Chintamani. Will Danger Bhai forgive Dr Hathi?

videos.title: Soch Acchi Rakho
videos.overview: Chintamani’s kids tell everyone that Chintamani is okay and get to know that Dr Hathi had nothing to do with Chintamani fainting. Later, all Gokuldham members talk to Chintamani and give him hope.

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Peeth Piche Hua Drama
videos.overview: Jethalal comes back to Gokuldham society and Bhide tells him what happened in the society when he was not there. Later, Chintamani comes to the Gokuldham society with another health problem. What will Dr Hathi do now?

videos.title: Bhagwat Geeta Ka Shlok
videos.overview: Sonu makes Bhide’s tension go away and asks him to write a shlok from Bhagwat Geeta on the society board. Bhide decides to test Tapu Sena. Later, Bhide and Tapu get into a fight.

videos.title: Tapu Ki Maafi
videos.overview: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight when Bhide tells Jethalal that Tapu insulted him. Tapu apologises to Bhide for talking back to him and tells him that Tapu Sena won’t do Dahi Handi this year. What will happen now?

videos.title: Iccha Purti Matki
videos.overview: A monk comes to Gokuldham society’s temple and gives Tapu Sena an Iccha Purti Matki and says whoever breaks it on Janmashtami his wishes will come true. Who will get to break this matki?

videos.title: Emergency Society Meeting
videos.overview: Madhavi tells Mahila Mandal about the Iccha Purti matki while Popatlal gets angry because no one told him about the society’s emergency meeting. Later, everyone gets excited about Iccha Purti matki.

videos.title: Matki Phodne Ka Decision
videos.overview: Champaklal tells Jethalal about Iccha Purti matki. Later, everyone gathers for the emergency meeting and waits for Bhide. What is taking Bhide so long?

videos.title: Gokuldham Society Janmashtami Mahotsav
videos.overview: Gokuldham Society members unanimously agree to let Popatlal break the Iccha Purti matki on Janmashtami and wish for a happily married life. However, Popatlal decides to do something else with the matki. What is he planning?

videos.title: Iccha Purti Matki Ke Rules
videos.overview: Gokuldham society celebrates Janmashthami. Later, each family can put down only one name from their family for Iccha Purti matki. Who will get this golden chance?

videos.title: Ek Pareshaan Parivar
videos.overview: Everyone is excited to know who will break the Iccha Purti matki. Later, a couple comes to Gokuldham society and tells everyone that their son has only a few days left to live.

videos.title: Sabne Chintan Ko Chuna
videos.overview: Everyone asks Chintan to break the Iccha Purti matki. Tapu Sena helps him break the matki but he keeps falling down. Will he be able to break the matki?

videos.title: Sabka Bhala Socho
videos.overview: Chintan reveals that he didn’t pray for his good health while breaking the matki. Later, all the Gokuldham men sit and chat at the clubhouse, but Jethalal is missing. Where is he?

videos.title: B.K. Su
videos.overview: Gokuldham men talk about business. Jethalal tells Champakal that Tapu is still young to join the business. Later, Jethalal doesn’t agree with Bhide’s message on the society board. What does the message say?

videos.title: Paryushan Ki Shuruaat
videos.overview: Tapu tells Champaklal that he wants to take him to Palitana. On arriving at his shop, Jethalal is happy to see it full of customers but short-staffed. Later, Bagha makes a mistake while accepting a payment. How will Jethalal react?

videos.title: Imaandari
videos.overview: Bagha tells Bawri that Gada Electronis lost ten thousand rupees because of his mistake and Bawri decides to help them. Later, Nattu Kaka finds out something suspicious in the office account. What is it?

videos.title: Workload Se Pareshaan
videos.overview: Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Dhanraj Seth has not given other people’s money either. Later, Taarak gives advice to Jethalal to keep a manager in his shop to divide the workload. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha react to this?

videos.title: Manager Naam Ki Tension
videos.overview: Jethalal's friends urge him to keep a manager for the shop. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka says that he will leave his job at Gada Electronics if Jethalal hires a new manager. What will happen now?

videos.title: Badla Bartav
videos.overview: Jethalal is looking for a manager for his shop while Nattu Kaka’s behaviour changes towards Jethalal. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal they will leave their jobs if he keeps a manager. What will happen now?

videos.title: Bawri Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Jethalal imagines what it would be like if he hired Bawri as a manager. Later, Jethalal asks Bawri to give a test so he can decide if she’s fit to become a manager or not. Will Bawri pass the test?

videos.title: Payment Mila Ya Nahi?
videos.overview: Bagha eagerly waits for Bawri to return with the payment. Later, Bawri tells everyone that she didn’t get the payment from Dhanraj Seth. What will happen now?

videos.title: Freelancer Bawri
videos.overview: Bawri tells Jethalal she doesn’t want to work at Gada Electronics and that she can do freelancing whenever Gada Electronics needs her. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka apologise to Jethalal for their behaviour.

videos.title: Kharab Speaker
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Bagha and Nattu Kaka that he doesn’t like the mega bumper sale written outside Gada Electronics. Later, Tapu Sena takes Gokuldham’s speaker to Gada Electronics to get it repaired.

videos.title: Secret Decoration
videos.overview: Bhide scolds Tapu Sena for buying a new speaker without knowing that it’s a gift from Jethalal. Later, Tapu Sena helps set up the mandap for Ganesh Chaturthi.

videos.title: Celebrating Ganesh Ji
videos.overview: All Gokuldham members share their tea with Taarak. Later, they celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi in full swing.

videos.title: Sonu Ki Surprise Performance
videos.overview: Bhide wants Sonu to tell him about her Ganesh Chaturthi performance while everyone is excited about Sonu’s surprise performance. What is Sonu’s surprise?

videos.title: Mani Brothers Ki Surprise Visit
videos.overview: Sonu impresses everyone with her magnificent performance. Later, Danger Bhai and Chintamani visit Gokuldham society and give gifts to everyone.

videos.title: Bhagwan Ke Abhushan Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Sodhi, Abdul and Tapu Sena decide to stay near the pandal to protect the jewels while a family hides from them to go inside the mandap. Are they here to steal or do they have some other motive?

videos.title: Parivar Ke Bhes Mein Chor
videos.overview: Bhide has a very scary dream that all the precious jewels get stolen. Tapu Sena, Sodhi and Abdul find Bhakti’s parents near the mandap. What were they doing?

videos.title: Anghoti Mil Gayi
videos.overview: Bhakti doesn’t sleep at all in the night. Gokuldham members look for Bhakti’s father’s ring in the morning. Later, Tapu discloses that Anjali and Babita are going to do aarti nritya.

videos.title: Anjali And Babita's Dance
videos.overview: Bhakti’s parents try to find an excuse to go to Gokuldham society. Anjali and Babita are excited about their performance. What will happen next?

videos.title: Ganpati Ki Param Bhakt
videos.overview: Dr Hathi checks Bhakti while Bhakti’s parents are worried about Gokuldham members finding out the truth. Later, Gokuldham members ask Bhakti’s parents why they don’t want to leave Gokuldham society. Will they tell the truth?

videos.title: Bhakti Ka Vachan
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are unable to decide whether they should let Bhakti stay in the society or not. However, Bhakti is not willing to leave without playing Garba with Ganpati Bappa. Will her wish come true?

videos.title: Zidd Ya Bhakti?
videos.overview: Bawri asks Komal if she can sing Stuti Bhajan with her in the evening. Bhakti refuses to eat or drink anything. Later, Gokuldham members meet to find a solution for Bhakti.

videos.title: Bhakti's Wishes
videos.overview: Gokuldham members find a way to make Bhakti’s wishes come true. Later, Gokuldham members gather and wait for Bhakti to arrive. What will happen now?

videos.title: Goli Ka Naya Roop
videos.overview: Bawri sings beautifully. Bhakti asks Gokuldham members to leave because she thinks Ganesh ji wants to dance only with her. Later, Goli dresses up as Ganesh ji.

videos.title: Bhakti Ka Sapna Hua Pura
videos.overview: Bhakti gets very happy and gets emotional when she sees her god with her own eyes. Later, Bhakti calls Gokuldham members to meet her god. Is this Goli in God's clothes or someone else?

videos.title: Goli Ka Confusion
videos.overview: Goli celebrates with Bhakti and dances with her. Goli gets stuck in traffic and gets confused when he finds out someone has replaced him during the celebration. What will happen now?

videos.title: Gokuldham Is Blessed
videos.overview: Gokuldham members feel blessed by god and they all thank Bhakti for it. Later, everyone gets the same dream about a god. What is the dream?

videos.title: Babita Ki Dost
videos.overview: Jethalal bumps into Champaklal and Champaklal gets angry. Popatlal meets Babita’s friend and tries to impress her. Will she be impressed by Popatlal?

videos.title: Chai Ne Bigadi Deal
videos.overview: Jethalal orders tea and accidentally spills it on his client, Vicky, who gets angry and insults Jethalal. Later, Jethalal finds out that Vicky is Babita’s friend’s husband. What will happen now?

videos.title: Babita Bani Mediator
videos.overview: Jethalal and Vicky start fighting in front of Babita and Nisha. Babita tries to resolve the issue between Jethalal and Vicky. Will she succeed in doing so?

videos.title: Vicky Ka Cheque
videos.overview: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak and tells him about his big deal and how everything went smoothly. Later, Nattu Kaka tells Jethalal that there’s some issue with Vicky’s cheque that he gave Jethalal. What will Jethalal do now?

videos.title: Shiny Dandiya Sticks
videos.overview: Jethalal thinks there’s a ghost in his house. Tapu shows his glow in the dark dandiya sticks to Jethalal but Jethalal feels these sticks can be risky. Later, Jethalal scolds Bagha and Bawri when he overhears their conversation.

videos.title: Ziddi Box
videos.overview: Bhide protects his clothes from getting ruined as he’s meeting Amit for a new order. Later, Popatlal asks everyone to open a box, but no one is able to open it. What is in the box?

videos.title: Navratri Ke Liya Budget Nahi Hai
videos.overview: Gokuldham men open Popatlal’s box and end up spilling everything that was inside the box. Bhide tells Tapu Sena they don't have a budget to celebrate Navratri this year. What will happen now?

videos.title: Sabse Pehele Aya Jethalal
videos.overview: Jethalal arrives at the meeting spot before everyone else and decides to hide and hear what Bhide says behind his back. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal to prove that he is the first one to arrive for the meeting.

videos.title: Bina Budget Ki Navratri
videos.overview: Bhide gets angry when Popatlal asks him what he does with the society's budget. Tapu Sena comes up with a solution to Navratri on zero budget. Later, Bhide wants to know about Tapu Sena’s surprise.

videos.title: Artists Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Tapu Sena welcomes all the Gokuldham members in their own unique style to Gokuldham’s Navratri function. Everyone is waiting for the artists to come and perform at the function. Will they reach the society on time?

videos.title: Cheque Pass Hoga Ya Nahi?
videos.overview: Taarak and Jethalal are worried about whether Jethalal will get his money from Babita’s friend on time or not. Later, Anjali gets angry when she finds unhealthy food in Taarak’s bag. What will happen now?

videos.title: Payment Ki Tension
videos.overview: Babita's friend Vicky tears the cheque in front of Jethalal. Meanwhile, a phone call from Jethalal gets Taarak into trouble with his boss.

videos.title: Gift Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Jethalal is confused about what to gift Babita. Later, Jethalal gets a bouquet for Babita but Iyer is allergic to flowers. What will Jethalal gift Babita?

videos.title: The Perfect Gift
videos.overview: Jethalal is in distress as he struggles to find the right gift  and consults all his neighbours. Will he find the right gift?

videos.title: Babita Ka Mushkil Gift
videos.overview: Anjali gets upset with Taarak for not giving her gifts while Jethalal dreams about Babita’s gift. Later, Jethalal asks Sundar about Daya.

videos.title: Chand Par Zameen
videos.overview: Sundar tells Jethalal that he’s getting a piece of land on the moon at a very small price and asks Jethalal to give him the money for the same. What will Jethalal do now?

videos.title: NASA Se Call
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell customers about their festive special offers. Later, Jethalal gets a call from NASA. What is this call about?

videos.title: Moon Residential Program
videos.overview: Bagha urges Jethalal to buy land on the moon as a good investment opportunity. Will this be a wise decision for Jethalal?

videos.title: Chand Par Padosi
videos.overview: Chand Bhai convinces Jethalal to buy three plots on the moon. How will Babita and Gokuldham members react when they find out about this?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Zabardast Surprise
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Babita he has a big surprise for her and asks everyone to come to the clubhouse in the evening. How will everyone react when they find out about Jethalal’s surprise?

videos.title: Babita Ke Liye Best Gift
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Babita about his surprise in a very special way. How will everyone react to this?

videos.title: Sapna Reh Gaya Sapna
videos.overview: Jethalal realises he had slept and he dreamt about buying land on the moon. Jethalal goes to the Moon Residential Program office. Will he buy land on the moon now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Sapna Toota
videos.overview: Jethalal asks Popatlal not to tell anyone that he wanted to buy land on the moon. Jethalal is upset because he couldn’t fulfil Babita’s wish. What will he do now?

videos.title: Jethalal's Surprise Gift
videos.overview: Jethalal finally brings a surprise gift for Babita with Taarak's help. Will Babita like the gift?

videos.title: Diwali Ki Tayariyan
videos.overview: Sodhi plays a prank on Bhide and steals society’s notice board. Gokuldham members want Daya to come back and make their Diwali even more special. When is Daya coming back?

videos.title: Diwali Ka Maahol
videos.overview: Bhide gets angry at Tapu for throwing water at him. Bhide goes to stop Tapu Sena from wasting water but falls down. Later, Taarak surprises Anjali with a present.

videos.title: Surprise Dham
videos.overview: Mahila Mandal goes to Jethalal’s house to find out when is Daya coming back while Champaklal’s friend pulls Champaklal’s leg. Will they find out the exact date when Daya is coming back?

videos.title: Sundar Ko Phone Lagao
videos.overview: Jethalal meets a customer who’s in a similar problem as him as his wife is also not coming home. Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Jethalal try to contact Sundar to ask about Daya. Will they get in touch with him?

videos.title: Jethalal Gets Impatient
videos.overview: Jethalal talks to Daya’s acquaintance and asks him to go to Daya’s house and make him talk to her. Later, Jethalal and Bagha try to call Sundar from an unknown number. Will he pick up the call now?

videos.title: Sundar Ka Vaada
videos.overview: Jethalal is worried that Sundar may not keep his promise. He makes plans to travel to Ahmedabad himself, along with Taarak, to bring Daya back.

videos.title: Apradhi Jethalal
videos.overview: Tapu books tickets for Jethalal and Taarak for Ahmedabad to bring Daya back home. Later, police arrive at the Gokuldham Society to arrest Jethalal. How will Jethalal go to Ahmedabad now?

videos.title: Jethalal Ne Kara Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Police come to arrest Jethalal while he talks in his sleep. Later, everyone wants to know what crime Jethalal has committed.

videos.title: Reason Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Inspector Panday is not telling anyone why he’s arresting Jethalal and Gokuldham members protest against it. What will happen now?

videos.title: Humne Kisko Dhamkaya?
videos.overview: Mahila Mandal prays for Jethalal while Jethalal finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka in jail. Why are they in jail?

videos.title: ACP Ki Biwi Ko Di Dhamki
videos.overview: Inspector Panday informs Jethalal that he has been accused of threatening ACP Prithvi's wife, Jagruti, from Ahmedabad. Jethalal denies these allegations. What will happen next?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Khilaaf Complaint
videos.overview: Gokuldham Society members arrive at the police station to convince Inspector Panday to let Jethalal go. Will Inspector Panday listen to them?

videos.title: Misunderstanding Clear Karo
videos.overview: Jethalal explains to ACP Prithvi that his messages were intended for Sundar, not Jagruti, and apologizes for any misunderstanding. Surprisingly, ACP Prithvi and his wife are revealed to be Daya's family friends. Will they withdraw their complaint against Jethalal?

videos.title: Kiski Galti Hai?
videos.overview: Gokuldham men tell Mahila Mnadal what happened at the police station while Jethalal finally gets to talk to Sundar. What will Sundar say now?

videos.title: Daya Ke Aane Ki Khushi
videos.overview: Everyone is excited when they hear Daya is coming back. Jethalal, Champaklal, and Tapu joyfully engage in garba to celebrate her homecoming. However, amidst the happiness, Taarak is anxious, fearing that something untoward might occur during Diwali.

videos.title: Sundar Ka Vaada
videos.overview: Taarak is worried if Sundar will fulfil his promise. Later, everyone celebrates Diwali in Gokuldham society. When is Daya coming?

videos.title: Sundar Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: Tapu Sena challenges Goli to snatch sukdi from Champaklal's hand. Tapu contacts Sundar to inquire about his location. Is Daya really coming with him?

videos.title: Swagat Samaroh Hua Flop
videos.overview: Jethalal and other Gokuldham members gather to welcome Daya. However, they are shocked to find that Daya is not with Sundar. What will happen now?

videos.title: Daya Bhabhi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: All the colony members are upset that Sundar didn't get Daya Bhabhi with him. How will the colony members react to this?

videos.title: Daya Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: Jethalal and all the colony members are sad when they don't see Daya with Sundar. However, Sundar passes on the message that Daya sent for Jethalal and lights a diya on her behalf.

videos.title: Khush Rehne Ka Secret
videos.overview: It's a happy vibe in the Gokuldham society as everyone is in a good mood post-Diwali. What new adventures will they be up to?

videos.title: Sakharam Ko Lagi Chot
videos.overview: Bhide gets angry at Tapu Sena for playing badminton near Sakhram. Later, Roshan receives a piece of good news.

videos.title: Sodhi's Anniversary
videos.overview: Jethalal gets yelled at by his father for delaying a payment. Meanwhile, Sodhi tells everyone that tomorrow is his marriage anniversary.

videos.title: Anniversary Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: Sodhi and his friends are excited about his anniversary. Meanwhile, the men of the colony try to figure out what gift to give Sodhi and his wife.

videos.title: Sodhi Parties With His Friends
videos.overview: Sodhi gets convinced by his friends to party. The male members of the society decide to confront Sodhi as to why they weren't invited for the same. Will Sodhi forget to wish Roshan at twelve while busy partying?

videos.title: Museebat Ne Yaad Kiya Hai
videos.overview: All the men of Gokuldham society help Sodhi clean up after he parties with his friends. Soon, Abdul calls to tell them that Roshan has just entered the society. Will Sodhi get caught?

videos.title: Roshan Returns To Gokuldham
videos.overview: While Roshan enters her house, Sodhi and his friends hide on the balcony and make their way to Bhide's balcony. How long will Sodhi hide from Roshan?

videos.title: Planning Sodhi's Escape
videos.overview: The male members of the society come up with an elaborate plan to hide Sodhi at Popatlal's house. Will Sodhi succeed in lying to Roshan?

videos.title: Kya Sodhi Ka Jooth Pakda Jayega?
videos.overview: While Sodhi lies to Roshan over the phone about being on his way back, his friends who left earlier return to party with him. Meanwhile, Roshan finds the keys to Sodhi's car.

videos.title: Bhide Ki Chinta
videos.overview: All the men are worried about Sodhi's truth coming out in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Roshan arrives at Bhide's house to ask about Sodhi. Will she find out the truth?

videos.title: Sodhi Ka Jhooth Pakda Gaya
videos.overview: Bhide tries to assure Roshan that Sodhi is not at fault, while Sodhi lies to her. Later, Roshan visits Popatlal’s house to catch Sodhi red-handed. What will happen now?

videos.title: Sodhi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Roshan visits Iyer's house, inquiring about Sodhi's whereabouts. Later, she checks Taarak's house but can't find him there either. Where could Sodhi be?

videos.title: Jethalal Bhi Hai Gayab
videos.overview: Gokuldham men apologize to Champaklal for their deception regarding Sodhi. Meanwhile, Jethalal is discovered missing from his bedroom, leading everyone to speculate that he and Sodhi might be hiding together.

videos.title: Roshan Ghar Chor Kar Mat Jao
videos.overview: Jethalal declares his ignorance about Sodhi's whereabouts to everyone. Despite exhaustive efforts, Sodhi remains untraceable, leading to Roshan's decision to depart from Gokuldham society and stay with her parents.

videos.title: Sodhi Aur Roshan Ki Sulha
videos.overview: Sodhi offers a sincere apology to Roshan, mending their differences. Afterwards, the men of Gokuldham question Bhide about his actions, wondering why he went behind their backs.

videos.title: Anniversary Ki Mithas
videos.overview: Sodhi and Roshan distribute Kada Prasad among all their friends and invite them to their anniversary party. Will things go smoothly for them this time?

videos.title: Sodhi Aur Roshan Ki Party
videos.overview: Everyone celebrates at a party held in honour of Roshan and Sodhi, making a grand entrance. Later, Champaklal decides to go on a trip with his friends.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ka Idea
videos.overview: Tapu tells Tapu Sena what they should organize for the society's party and requests Bhide to invite everyone to the clubhouse, but Bhide refuses. What unfolds next in this situation?

videos.title: Meeting Ka Reason
videos.overview: Gokuldham members gather in the playhouse for a meeting, yet they remain curious about its purpose. Later, Tapu unveils his plan. What exactly is Tapu's strategy?

videos.title: Fine Dena Hoga
videos.overview: A debate ensues over the ideal fine for an unpopular gift, prompting everyone to brainstorm diverse and thoughtful gift ideas later on. Whose gift will be the worst?

videos.title: Chit Uthao
videos.overview: Tapu Sena visits each house, inviting everyone to draw a chit from a bowl, determining the recipient of their gift.

videos.title: Secret Gift Ka Confusion
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents contemplate their gift ideas for the Secret Santa. Will they be able to make the right decision before the party?

videos.title: Santa Collects Gifts
videos.overview: Nattu Kaka and Bagha dress up as Santa and go to everyone’s house in Gokuldham society and collect their gifts. Later, everyone gathers for the party.

videos.title: Gift Uthao
videos.overview: Bawri suggests a creative way for everyone to express their feelings about the gifts. The person with the least-liked gift will be subject to a fine.

videos.title: Acche Aur Bure Gifts
videos.overview: Gokuldham members continue picking up gifts. Are they liking their gifts or not?

videos.title: Kisne Diya Gift?
videos.overview: Anjali isn't fond of her gift, but Taarak encourages her to accept it graciously. Meanwhile, Bhide is delighted to discover that Madhavi is the one behind the thoughtful gift for Sonu. Who will pay the fine now?

videos.title: Pichle Saal Ke Events
videos.overview: Anjali and Taarak are happy with Tapu Sena’s idea and discuss all the events from last year. Later, Babita wishes Jethalal a happy new year.

videos.title: Naye Saal Ka Josh
videos.overview: Bhide asks Jethalal to give the maintenance cheque on time. Meanwhile, Champaklal returns to Gokuldham society and meets Tapu Sena.

videos.title: Jagah Kam Aur Saman Zyada
videos.overview: Bagha crafts a sales-boosting poem for Gada Electronics. Simultaneously, Bawri pitches a new scheme to Jethalal, Bagha, and Nattu Kaka. Bhide urges Madhavi to organize their home, leading her to decide to declutter by discarding unnecessary items.

videos.title: Purana Saman Pheko
videos.overview: Bhide insists on keeping his old belongings, explaining their sentimental value to Madhavi. Will Madhavi let him keep his old things?

videos.title: Madhavi Ko Pata Chala Sach
videos.overview: Abdul tells Bhide about garbage being dumped in the society office, in front of Madhavi. Later, Madhavi discovers the truth, realizing both Bhide and Sodhi deceived her.

videos.title: Goli's Wise Advice
videos.overview: Popatlal and Madhavi covertly sell Bhide's old items, intending to keep it a secret from him. Bhide confides in Goli about the situation, and Goli offers him wise counsel.

videos.title: Popatlal Maan Gaya
videos.overview: Bhide seeks Taarak's assistance to persuade Popatlal about the importance of his old belongings. Popatlal tries to buy Bhide's box, but the shopkeeper refuses to sell it. Later, Madhavi shares her diary with her friends.

videos.title: Bhide Ki Anmol Yaadein
videos.overview: Madhavi loses her old walkman, which makes her understand the attachment Bhide had to his old belongings. Madhavi and Sonu decide to go to the shop and bring Bhide's belongings back.

videos.title: Bhide Gets His Things Back
videos.overview: Bhide pretends to be upset about his old things, but Madhavi returns them, realizing their sentimental value. Meanwhile, Sukhi tells Sodhi that his car is lucky.

videos.title: Sodhi Ki Gadi Ruk Gayi
videos.overview: Bhide is urged to throw a party as Sonu triumphs over Tapu in badminton. Sodhi celebrates with soda, sharing stories about his lucky car. However, Sodhi's joy is short-lived as his friend informs him that the car has broken down. Now, what will Sodhi do?

videos.title: Sher Kharab Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Gokuldham men search for Sodhi's friend, Sukhi. They push the car and Sodhi tries to start it but it doesn't work. Later, Gokuldham ladies worry for them.

videos.title: Sher Ko Kara Repair
videos.overview: Sodhi plans to repair his car. Jethalal suggests getting a new car, but Sodhi chooses to repair the existing one. Later, Sodhi gets ready to drop Roshan at her relative's place and Tapu Sena at the mall. Will his car work fine now?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Helps Popatlal
videos.overview: Lost in the mall, Popatlal searches for Tapu Sena. He encounters an unmarried girl, and Tapu Sena seizes the opportunity to help Popatlal make a good impression on her.

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Date
videos.overview: Popatlal and Anokhi decide to go on a long drive together. Tapu Sena congratulates Popatlal, and they celebrate at the mall. Later, Sodhi offers to lend Popatlal his car for the long drive. Will everything go according to Popatlal's plan?

videos.title: Jethalal Has Jalebi And Fafda
videos.overview: Popatlal prays for his relationship at the temple, while Jethalal, craving jalebi and fafda, considers inviting Taarak and Babita. Jethalal invites Taarak for breakfast, and Taarak waits for Anjali to leave to visit Jethalal's house discreetly.

videos.title: Popatlal's Date With Anokhi
videos.overview: Popatlal prepares to meet Anokhi, and Sodhi enhances his car for a romantic evening for Popatlal and Anokhi. Champaklal informs Jethalal about attending a bhajan kirtan with Tapu Sena. Later, Popatlal takes Anokhi on a drive.

videos.title: Gaddi Band Ho Gayi
videos.overview: "Popatlal's meeting with Anokhi triggers memories for Anjali and Taarak. Anokhi suggests they get to know each other better before making commitments. Later, Popatlal's car stops, and he asks Anokhi for help pushing it."

videos.title: Gaddi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Popatlal angrily confronts Sodhi, blaming his car for ruining his date. He insults Sodhi and reveals he left the car in the jungle, angering Sodhi, but Popatlal refuses to disclose the exact location. What will Sodhi do now?

videos.title: Wrong Match For Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal wants his umbrella back, but Sodhi insists on knowing his car's location first. Popatlal tearfully shares the story of Anokhi leaving him due to Sodhi's car but refuses to disclose its whereabouts. Taarak suggests Anokhi may not have been the right match for him.

videos.title: Sher Ki Missing Complaint
videos.overview: Gokuldham men discover Sodhi's car missing, report it at the police station, and unintentionally disrupt Chalu Pandey's outing plans.

videos.title: Inspector Pandey Looks For Sodhi's Car
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey discloses Popatlal's involvement in the car theft, and Gokuldham residents vow not to interfere. Together, they join the inspector to search for Sodhi's car.

videos.title: Inspector Pandey Is Angry
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey wants to solve the case on his own. Gokuldham women debate informing Roshan about Sodhi's stolen car. Later, as Pandey gets crucial information about the car which makes him suspect that Gokuldham residents are making a fool out of him.

videos.title: Ek Aur Complaint
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey plans to arrest all Gokuldham men, bringing them to the society compound. Later, Inspector Pandey receives a call about two people filing a complaint about Sodhi's missing car, stirring confusion.

videos.title: Sodhi's New Car
videos.overview: Roshan surprises Sodhi with a new car, confessing the old one was never stolen. Inspector Pandey complains about Gokuldham residents causing trouble again.

videos.title: Sodhi Ke Naye Number
videos.overview: Taarak convinces Anjali to make a sweet treat. Tapu Sena asks Gogi for a treat as his father got a new car. Sodhi excitedly shares the news of his new car number in Gokuldham society.

videos.title: Permanent Number Ka Celebration
videos.overview: Sodhi shares sweets with everyone in Gokuldham to celebrate getting the permanent number for his new car. Later, Sodhi and Tapu Sena decide to have a party together.

videos.title: Sodhi Ki Nayi Gaadi
videos.overview: Sodhi celebrates his new car by taking all kids on a joy ride. However, he soon finds out that his car is not where he parked it. Where could it be?

videos.title: 4000 Episodes Ki Khushi
videos.overview: Sodhi learns there’s an issue with his car’s number plate while the community joyfully marks the milestone of 4000 episodes of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah.

videos.title: 4000 Episodes Ki Journey
videos.overview: The Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah family marks their 4000th episode with jubilant singing, dancing, and a festive cake cutting.

videos.title: Bhide Ke Liye Surprise
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents savour kulfi in celebration of finding Sodhi's lost car. Madhavi has a surprise for Bhide. However, Bhide misconstrues Madhavi and Sonu's actions, believing they are scouting for potential suitors for Sonu's marriage.

videos.title: Online Scams Se Bacho
videos.overview: Gokuldham men enjoy a soda session, but Popatlal feels left out. They discuss online shopping risks. Later, Bhide expresses interest in buying a gold chain for Sonu.

videos.title: Madhavi's Surprise
videos.overview: Madhavi is worried that Bhide will find out about her surprise from the passbook. Meanwhile, Bhide runs into Popatlal on his way to the bank, and both of them get into an argument.

videos.title: Madhavi Ko Scam Karne Ki Koshish
videos.overview: Bhide learns about Madhavi's 80,000 rupees and the truth about Sonu's gold chain. Scammers target Madhavi's account, and Mahesh offers to return Bhide's money, but he hesitates due to concerns about leaving Sonu and Madhavi alone.

videos.title: Madhavi Ka Parcel
videos.overview: Madhavi and Anjali eagerly await Madhavi's parcel, but Madhavi is taken aback by the size of it. Despite having paid online, the delivery person requests payment upon arrival. Is this a potential scam?

videos.title: Madhavi Takes Cyber Crime Unit's Help
videos.overview: Madhavi and Sonu discover the delivery boy's scam. The bank manager advises Madhavi to involve the police and seek the Cyber Crime Unit's help, while Tapu Sena steps in to assist Sonu.

videos.title: Madhavi Lies To Bhide
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey asks Abdul to recall any distinctive details about the fraudulent delivery boy. Although Inspector Pandey gets busy with other crucial tasks which upsets Madhavi. Subsequently, Madhavi fabricates a story to Bhide, asserting that she purchased the chain as a gift for Sonu.

videos.title: Fake Chain For Bhide
videos.overview: Madhavi doesn’t want to tell Bhide about the scam and Tapu Sena buys a fake gold chain. Later, Bhide asks Tapu Sena why there’s no jeweller’s name on the box.

videos.title: Search For The Scammer
videos.overview: Sonu and Madhavi decide to hide the scam from Bhide for the next two days. Tapu Sena approaches Popatlal, and he agrees to help them find the delivery boy who scammed Madhavi.

videos.title: Scammer Ko Pakadna Hoga
videos.overview: Tapu Sena and Popatlal plan to hide the gold chain truth from Bhide. Bhide claims he went to the temple for a new chain to spare Sonu's feelings. Later, they come up with a plan to catch the scammer.

videos.title: CCTV Shop Kaun Jayega?
videos.overview: Bhide discovers the soda shop empty, and Tapu Sena updates the Gokuldham men about Madhavi's scam. Later, Jethalal and Iyer plan to act as police officers to gather evidence against the scammer at the CCTV shop.

videos.title: Mahila Mandal Ko Chain Dekhni Hai
videos.overview: Bhide detects a secretive gathering unfolding without his knowledge, but Goli adeptly diffuses the situation with a clever explanation. The Mahila Mandal expresses interest in seeing Sonu's gold chain, leaving Madhavi anxious about potential doubts regarding its authenticity.

videos.title: Jethalal Ho Raha Hai Late
videos.overview: Jethalal suspects Iyer's plan to leave town and advises Bhide to gift something special to Madhavi. With Champaklal sensing a secret, the group eagerly awaits Jethalal's departure for his shop.

videos.title: Jethalal And Iyer Banne Police
videos.overview: Bawri comes to shop for a speaker at Gada Electronics. The Gokuldham men and Tapu Sena gather at Jethalal's shop, with Jethalal and Iyer donning police disguises. Later, everyone warns them to steer clear of CCTV cameras.

videos.title: Nakli Police Ka Mission
videos.overview: Some customers at Gada Electronics mistake Jethalal and Iyer for real policemen. The shopkeeper agrees to show them the recording and both of them find out more information about the scammer.

videos.title: Tattoo Wala Clue
videos.overview: The CCTV shop owner informs Inspector Panday about two individuals posing as police officers who had previously viewed the footage. Inspector Panday suspects their involvement in the scam. Jethalal and Iyer share the CCTV footage with everyone, revealing a small clue related to the scammer.

videos.title: Tattoo Artist Ki Help Chahiye Hai
videos.overview: The tattoo artist informs Jethalal and Iyer that the scammer has his tattoo design. With the scammer's phone number and name in hand, the Gokuldham members devise a plan to catch him and decide to seek the tattoo artist's help.

videos.title: Scammer Ko Diya Lalach
videos.overview: The tattoo artist lures the scammer, Babban, to his studio, claiming the tattoo design has won a prize. Inspector Panday learns about Jethalal and Iyer's fake police officer act at the CCTV shop. Now, everyone awaits the scammer's arrival at the tattoo studio.

videos.title: Scammer Pakda Gaya
videos.overview: Babban is caught at the tattoo studio, and the Gokuldham members plan to take him to Madhav for identification. Meanwhile, Bhide is left in the dark, and Inspector Panday learns about the Gokuldham members' strategy.

videos.title: Jethalal And Iyer In Danger
