videos.overview: Inspector Panday is furious seeing Jethalal and Iyer in police uniforms, planning their arrest along with the scammer. Later, Madhavi apologizes to Bhide. Will he forgive her?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Janam Din
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents prepare to celebrate Popatlal's birthday together. Popatlal takes a leave from work to celebrate his birthday. Will things go according to his wishes?

videos.title: Popatlal Akela Rahega
videos.overview: Popatlal daydreams of a birthday celebration filled with well-wishes for his swift marriage but he is determined not to be pitied so he resolves to steer clear of meeting anyone on his special day.

videos.title: Akele Mein Birthday
videos.overview: Despite the Tapu Sena's sincere attempt to wish him, Popatlal plays elusive, turning off his phone and celebrating in solitary splendour. Later, Popatlal overhears everyone talking about his marriage.

videos.title: Birthday Ke Din Gayab
videos.overview: Bhide wishes Popatlal on the society board but can't reach him. They ask Abdul about Popatlal's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Sodhi and Bhide plan a party, unknowingly overheard by Champaklal.

videos.title: Important Sting Operation
videos.overview: Taarak contacts Popatlal's boss but discovers he is not there either. Gokuldham residents believe Popatlal is engaged in a vital sting operation. Later, Popatlal receives an urgent office assignment, now faced with the task of leaving discreetly for the mission.

videos.title: Popatlal Ne Bhes Badla
videos.overview: Abdul gives Popatlal a disguise to go incognito outside Gokuldham. When he encounters Mahila Mandal, Abdul concocts a tale to conceal Popatlal's identity.

videos.title: Surprise Party For Popatlal
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents and Popatlal's colleagues kidnap Popatlal and take him to his surprise party. Popatlal tells everyone why he didn't want to celebrate his birthday with them.

videos.title: Popatlal Bachayega Paise
videos.overview: Abdul grapples with a customer's needs, and Popatlal voices his concern to Bhide about his management of the society. Later, Popatlal proposes a cost-saving idea to address the society's expenses.

videos.title: Asli Ya Nakli Delivery Boy
videos.overview: Popatlal and Bhide trap the delivery boy in the society office. Seeking help, Bhide contacts Sodhi. Later, the delivery boy tells Popatal that his relative works at a marriage bureau.

videos.title: Kiska Parcel Hai?
videos.overview: Anjali denies placing any online orders. The delivery boy joins Sodhi, Popatlal, and Bhide in a quest to find out who made the order. Whose parcel is it?

videos.title: OTP Chahiye Hai
videos.overview: Popatlal advises everyone to open the package and see what's inside, but the delivery boy won't give it to anyone unless they give him the delivery OTP first.

videos.title: Commissioner Se Panga
videos.overview: Bhide asks Inspector Panday’s boss to give him his OTP, but Panday’s boss thinks Bhide is trying to scam him. What will happen now?

videos.title: Adhunik Duniya Ke Nuksaan
videos.overview: Gokuldham Society members find out that the parcel belongs to Jethalal. Bhide insists that Jethalal performs two hundred situps for his wrong judgment. What will Jethalal do now?

videos.title: Taarak Ka Half-Day
videos.overview: Taarak chooses to write an article about Indian festivals while having a great half-holiday. Later, Tapu Sena questions Bhide about the arrangements for the Holi festival.

videos.title: Holi Par Bach Kar Raho
videos.overview: Mahila Mandal discusses their memories of Holi, while Tapu Sena purchases colours for the festival. Later, Tapu Sena receives a warning from two girls that some boys are throwing colours at everyone. What will Tapu Sena do?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ne Sikhaya Sabak
videos.overview: Tapu Sena watches as a group of boys taunt and throw colour at a girl. They teach them a lesson. Later, Sonu requests that Tapu Sena keep this incident from Bhide.

videos.title: Holi Celebration Ki Shuruat
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka give Jethalal plans to expand Gada Electronics' customer base. Later, when everyone gathers at the Gokuldham Society to celebrate Holi, a group of boys plan to take revenge from Tapu Sena.

videos.title: Gokuldham Wasiyo Ki Kavita
videos.overview: The Gokuldham residents recite poems during the Holi celebration, adding to the joy and laughter of the occasion.

videos.title: Guddu Ka Plan
videos.overview: Guddu wants to take revenge against Tapu and plans on causing trouble at the Holi celebration at Gokuldham. What will he do?

videos.title: Sonu In Danger
videos.overview: During the Holi celebrations at Gokuldham Society, Sonu is targeted by a group of boys who decide to put colour on her. Who will rescue her?

videos.title: Bawri Ke Parents Aa Gaye
videos.overview: Jethalal asks Tapu to apologize to Champaklal. Popatlal argues with an auto driver. Later, Bagha and Bawri request Jethalal to meet Bawri's parents.

videos.title: April Fool Banayenge
videos.overview: Champaklal and friends plan a gathering, while Jethalal and his friends scheme to play an April Fool's prank on the Gokuldham society members.

videos.title: April Fool Ki Planning
videos.overview: Anjali tricks Taarak with green juice, while Taarak pulls a prank on Goli. Later, the Gokuldham men plan their April Fool's Day prank and party venue.

videos.title: Sabke Alag Bahane
videos.overview: The men concoct fake excuses to leave and head to the clubhouse for an April Fool’s prank, but Bhide finds himself unexpectedly stuck at home, unable to join them.

videos.title: Clubhouse Mein Party Sharty
videos.overview: All the men try to sneak into the clubhouse, but the clubhouse is locked. Jethalal comes up with a plan to get Bhide out of his house. Will his plan work?

videos.title: Popatlal Ne Kari Complain
videos.overview: Abdul informs Popatlal that the Gokuldham men are partying without him due to his single status. Popatlal then reveals the truth to the ladies about their husbands' clandestine party.

videos.title: Champaklal Is Back
videos.overview: Popatlal and Mahila Mandal attempt to locate the Gokuldham men's party. Popatlal consults Abdul for information. Later, Purush Mandli's plans are disrupted by Champaklal's unexpected return.

videos.title: Sharbat Ya Sharab?
videos.overview: The Purush Mandali plans an April Fool's prank on the Mahila Mandal and Popatlal. Despite their efforts, Popatlal remains suspicious. Later, the Mahila Mandal tests a drink to determine if it's alcohol or juice.

videos.title: Prank Ulta Padh Gaya
videos.overview: Mahila Mandal and Champaklal pretend to be drunk to prank Purush Mandli, fooling Popatlal. Later, Purush Mandli gathers for soda and a discussion on global warming.

videos.title: AC On Or Off?
videos.overview: Bagha informs Jethalal about an upcoming company visit for a new product launch. Jethalal wakes up Champaklal and Tapu, disrupting their sleep due to Tapu's AC preference conflicting with Champaklal's comfort.

videos.title: Electrician Jethalal
videos.overview: Babita calls Iyer and complains about a fault in their AC. Jethalal offers to fix the AC when Iyer is unable to find a mechanic. Will he be able to fix the AC?

videos.title: Babita Ka AC Karna Hai Repair
videos.overview: Jethalal, unable to repair Babita's air conditioner, tries calling Bagha for help, but Bawri intercepts the call and prevents him from speaking to Bagha.

videos.title: Naya AC Lelo
videos.overview: Jethalal suggests Iyer and Babita to buy a new AC from his shop but Iyer is unsure about this. Will Iyer buy a new AC?

videos.title: Iyer Ka Mazak
videos.overview: Jethalal is very happy that he helped Babita with her AC problem. Iyer plans a prank on Jethalal. Later, Madhavi prepares Bhide’s favourite dish but Gokuldham kids eat it.

videos.title: Tapu Prepares Breakfast
videos.overview: Sonu decides to treat Tapu. Tapu pleasantly surprises Jethalal with his favourite breakfast. Later, Jethalal ends up ditching Taarak to accompany Babita instead.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Important Meeting
videos.overview: Tapu goes to Sonu's house for a homemade mango milkshake. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka and Bagha play the Bhide scooter game, earning a scolding from Jethalal. Later, Arjun from the Supervision company meets with Jethalal for business.

videos.title: Bawri's Apology
videos.overview: Jethalal's business meeting goes wrong due to Bawri and Bagha's antics. Bawri tries to apologise to Jethalal, but he is not willing to accept. What will happen now?

videos.title: Bawri Ki Entry Hui Band
videos.overview: Bawri offers an apology gift to Jethalal, but he refuses to accept it. Bagha warns Bawri not to come to Gada Electronics, but she vows to find a way to visit regardless of Jethalal's objections.

videos.title: Bawri In Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Taarak that if Bawri shows up at Gada Electronics today, he'll have to fire Bagha. Later, Bawri visits the store in disguise. Will Jethalal recognize her?

videos.title: Warehoue Mein Kon Hai?
videos.overview: Bagha learns that Bawri has disguised herself and come to Gada Electronics. They talk in the warehouse. Will Jethalal catch them there?

videos.title: Gokuldham Mein Hai Pooja
videos.overview: Bagha tells Bawri they can't meet secretly without Jethalal knowing. Taarak updates Anjali about Jethalal's concerns with Bawri and Bagha. Later, everyone assembles at Gokuldham society for the pooja.

videos.title: Bawri In Disguise
videos.overview: Bawri sneaks into the shop in a disguise to meet Bagha, trying to keep their love story hidden from Jethalal. Can their romance survive the challenge of staying hidden from Jethalal's sharp eyes?

videos.title: The Plan To Catch Bawri
videos.overview: Jethalal suspects that Bawri comes to the shop every day as a customer, and he plans to catch her red-handed. What will he do?

videos.title: Bawri's New Attempt
videos.overview: Bagha prays that Bawri doesn't come to Gada Electronics but Jethalal is all set to welcome her. Will Bawri take the risk and enter Gada Electronics?

videos.title: Jethalal Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Inspector Panday arrests Jethalal for misbehavior with a woman. Bagha tells Bawri it's because of her. Later, Taarak fakes illness at work to help Jethalal.

videos.title: Permission Mil Gayi
videos.overview: Jethalal tells Bawri she caused him to go to jail. Bawri asks for permission to visit Bagha at Gada Electronics during quiet times. Later, Iyer threatens to reveal Jethalal's jail incident to Champaklal.

videos.title: Husbands Ke Sath Shopping Jana Hai
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi get interrupted by Roshan during a sweet moment. Later, the wives discuss their husbands' food choices while buying vegetables and plan to go shopping together with their husbands.

videos.title: Taarak Ko Chhutti Nahi Mil Rahi
videos.overview: As the ladies get ready for a shopping trip with their husbands, Taarak faces difficulty getting time off work. He asks the other husbands to skip shopping to avoid upsetting Anjali. Will they agree to help him out?

videos.title: Taarak's Shopping Trip
videos.overview: Taarak arrives at the mall for the shopping trip. Later, Taarak's boss calls him to ask about the poem. What will Taarak do now?

videos.title: Taarak's Boss In The Mall
videos.overview: All the couples go shopping together. Sodhi jokes with Taarak about Taarak's boss being at the mall, not realizing that Taarak's boss is actually there. What happens when Taarak's boss sees him?

videos.title: Taarak Mall Mein Hai Ya Nahi?
videos.overview: Taarak's boss follows the Gokuldham men to ask about Taarak's whereabouts at the mall. The secretary suggests they may have seen someone else resembling Taarak. Later, Taarak's boss plans to send his secretary and a doctor to Taarak's house.

videos.title: Taarak Ki Sundar Kavita
videos.overview: Dr. Hathi tells Dr. Chaddha that Taarak has a headache from not eating Anjali's diet food. Taarak's boss shares that his wife loved the poem he wrote. Later, the Gokuldham men swap tales about their wives' shopping experiences.

videos.title: Traffic Bohot Hai
videos.overview: Jethalal and Bhide argue over a flowerpot. Champaklal asks Jethalal about his political views. Later, Iyer gives Jethalal and Taarak a ride, but they get stuck in traffic.

videos.title: Konsa Neta Better Hai?
videos.overview: Jethalal strategizes to maintain his friendship with Chana Kumar without upsetting Kurmura Kumar. He discusses with Chana Kumar the complexities of openly supporting him. Meanwhile, Sunita confides her stress to the Mahila Mandal.

videos.title: Chunaav Ka Mahol
videos.overview: Kurmura Kumar comes to Gokuldham for his election campaign. Popatlal tries to convince everyone to vote for Kurmura Kumar. Later, Sonu goes out of the house to make a delivery.

videos.title: Sodhi Ka Sapna
videos.overview: Sodhi dreams that Bhide becomes extremely rich. Champaklal asks Tapu Sena to help the birds. Later, Bhide gets upset with Tapu Sena.

videos.title: Summer Solutions
videos.overview: The members of Gokuldham society fight the summer heat together and get a brilliant idea to put water vessels all around for the animals and birds around.

videos.title: Zaruratmand Ki Madad
videos.overview: Goli suggests taking a rickshaw, but everyone prefers to walk to Gokuldham society. Along the way, they come across workers labouring in the sun without water. Moved by this sight, they decide to assist the workers. How will they lend a helping hand?

videos.title: Free Mein Buttermilk
videos.overview: Tapu Sena asks Roshan to make buttermilk for the workers, sparking Bhide's curiosity. Later, they set up a stall nearby and offer the buttermilk to the workers.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ke Acche Vichar
videos.overview: Roshan informs the Mahila Mandal about Tapu Sena's charitable efforts and offers assistance. A buttermilk vendor charges Popatlal for 30 glasses of buttermilk. Later, Taarak praises Tapu Sena's good deeds to Jethalal.

videos.title: Tapu Sena's Stall
videos.overview: Chana Kumar arrives at Gada Electronics and gives Jethalal more packets of Sing Chana to distribute. Later, the police reprimands Tapu Sena for setting up their stall without permission.

videos.title: Purush Mandli Ko Karni Hai Madad
videos.overview: The Tapu Sena receives praise for their good work and they pledge to continue their good work throughout the summer. Gokuldham members agree to share expenses for their buttermilk mission. Later, Purush Mandli brainstorm ways to contribute to the Tapu Sena's efforts.

videos.title: Bina Mewa Kare Sabki Seva
videos.overview: Kurmura Kumar plans to take credit for Tapu Sena's work. Jethalal encounters issues with Chana Kumar. Later, others get inspired by Tapu Sena's good deeds.

videos.title: Kurmura Kumar Ka Banner
videos.overview: Kurmura Kumar puts his party's banner at Tapu Sena's buttermilk stall, which worries Bhide as it may upset Chana Kumar and cause trouble. Removing the banner could also upset Kurmura Kumar. What will they decide to do next?

videos.title: Banner Ki Tension
videos.overview: A reporter credits Kurmura Kumar for Tapu Sena's buttermilk stall. Chana Kumar blames Jethalal for supporting Kurmura Kumar and asks him to remove Kurmura Kumar's banner from the stall.

videos.title: Kurmura Kumar Ki Pyaar Wali Dhamki
videos.overview: Chana Kumar asks Jethalal to convince the Gokuldham members to stop offering free buttermilk. Expecting Kurmura Kumar to oppose removing his banners, Chana is surprised by his unexpected reaction.

videos.title: Chana Kumar's Suggestion
videos.overview: Gokuldham residents are split about removing the banner from the stall after Kurmura Kumar's threat. Later, Chana Kumar gives the residents a suggestion to deal with the problem.

videos.title: Lemonade Vs Buttermilk
videos.overview: Kurmura Kumar’s man asks other Gokuldham members to not help Jethalal and Taarak with the lemonade stall. Gokuldham residents are torn between Chana Kumar and Kurmura Kumar. Later, Jethalal and Taarak struggle to set up their lemonade stall.

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Nimbu Paani Stall
videos.overview: Jethalal and Taarak call Bhide for help to find lemons. They struggle to find a rickshaw while Gokuldham members wait. Later, Jethalal sets up his lemonade stall.

videos.title: Gokuldham Ho Gaya Hai Divide
videos.overview: Sodhi gets angry at Chana Kumar and Kurmura Kumar. Iyer drops the lemons while Tapu Sena feels bad about not helping Jethalal. Later, Kurmura Kumar's aide scolds the Gokuldham members for assisting Iyer when lemon juice gets in his eyes.

videos.title: Dono Parties Mein Hua Jhagda
videos.overview: Kurmura Kumar urges Gokuldham not to close the buttermilk stall. Taarak's boss uncovers his lemonade sales lie. Tensions escalate as Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar's groups clash over the drinks, sparking a fight.

videos.title: Jethalal Under Arrest
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey intervenes to resolve the issue between the two parties but his investigation uncovers evidence against Jethalal, leading to his arrest. Will the residents of Gokuldham stop his arrest?

videos.title: Chana Kumar Ke Supporters
videos.overview: Sunita refuses to sell her vegetables in Gokuldham, as she is loyal to Chana Kumar. Meanwhile, a huge crowd gathers outside Gada Electronics, looking for freebies.

videos.title: Problems Se Kaise Bache?
videos.overview: Gokuldham members face problems due to Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar. They decide to shut down the lemonade and buttermilk stall, but Champaklal opposes this.

videos.title: Mission Paar Paar
videos.overview: Tapu Sena reviews the plan with everyone to avoid mistakes. Later, Bawri wishes them luck for "Mission Paar Paar," arousing the suspicion of Kurmura Kumar's and Chana Kumar's men.

videos.title: Ganda Paani Ka Istamal
videos.overview: Kurmura Kumar and Chana Kumar work at the buttermilk and lemonade counters for publicity. Later, food officials shut down Chana Kumar's lemonade counter due to polluted water.

videos.title: Kumura Aur Chana Fass Gaye
videos.overview: Two men drink buttermilk from the stall and faint. Rita reporter accuses Kurmura Kumar of using bad curd to make buttermilk. What will Kurmura Kumar do now?

videos.title: Anjali Ka Juice
videos.overview: Taarak urgently calls everyone over, announcing Anjali made juice for them. They all try to avoid tasting it. Later, Abdul gets scolded by Jethalal and Champaklal in front of his friend.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Duty
videos.overview: Abdul is busy running errands for the Gokuldham society members. Abdul's friend says that everyone is taking him for granted. Will Abdul listen to his advice?

videos.title: Cake Gir Gaya
videos.overview: Abdul's friend tries to talk to him, but Abdul is always busy. Popatlal drops a cake and angrily blames Bhide for the society's poor maintenance.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Value Nahi Hai?
videos.overview: Bhide scolds for not getting the pavement repaired. Later, Abdul’s friend tells him that he’s going abroad and tells him that Gokuldham members don’t value him.

videos.title: Abdul's Birthday
videos.overview: Abdul waits for birthday wishes, telling his friend the Purush Mandli will congratulate him at the office. Will they remember?

videos.title: The Forgotten Birthday
videos.overview: Abdul feels sad when no one wishes him a happy birthday. Will they finally greet him or will he lose faith in his friends?

videos.title: Poisoning Abdul's Mind
videos.overview: Abdul's friend tries to manipulate him, saying the colony uses him and nobody cares. Will Abdul fall prey to doubt and mistrust?

videos.title: Bawri's Phone Call
videos.overview: Abdul asks to borrow Bhide's iron. Meanwhile, Bagha is unable to do his job properly as Bawri keeps calling him.

videos.title: Bagha Needs A Holiday
videos.overview: Bawri asks Bagha to take a day off to celebrate their special day - the anniversary of the day they first met. But will Jethalal grant him a day off?

videos.title: Bawri Ka Mantra
videos.overview: Bagha tells Bawri he can't get a holiday because Jethalal's 18 lakh rupees are stuck with PK Daruwala. Bawri suggests an idea to help Jethalal recover the money.

videos.title: Daruwala Ka Phone Aa Gaya
videos.overview: Bagha is upset that Jethalal didn't give him a holiday. Mr. Daruwala, in Khandala, apologizes for the payment delay. Will Jethalal get his payment today?

videos.title: Cheque Collect Karna Hai
videos.overview: Bagha and Bawri go to collect Jethalal's cheque, leaving him anxious. They arrive at Mr. Daruwala's resort. Will they get the cheque?

videos.title: Cheque Ghum Gaya
videos.overview: Bagha and Bawri choose to celebrate their anniversary instead of heading back to Mumbai. Unfortunately, Bawri mistakenly misplaces Jethalal’s cheque. What's their next move?

videos.title: Bag Mili Ya Nahi?
videos.overview: Bawri suggests to Bagha that they should return to Mumbai and confess to Jethalal. They pray for guidance. What will happen next?

videos.title: Installments Pe Phone
videos.overview: Bagha worries about Jethalal seeing Bawri at his shop, but she goes along anyway. Later, Jethalal finds out his son bought a phone from his shop.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ko Mila Invitation
videos.overview: Tapu Sena's talents are recognized with an invite to a gaming and animation conference in Pune. While everyone's bursting with pride, will everyone be allowed to go to Pune?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Leaves For Pune
videos.overview: Tapu Sena heads to Pune for their conference, with parents and elders wishing them luck and safe travels. Popatlal wants to teach Bhide a lesson for leaving his scooter keys behind.

videos.title: Sakharam Ki Chori
videos.overview: Popatlal plans to teach Bhide a lesson for his absent-mindedness. He hides Sakharam, Bhide's beloved scooter, in a hidden corner of the colony.

videos.title: Pareshaan Popatlal
videos.overview: Gokuldham colony members are having fun at Abdul's shop when Popatlal arrives in a fancy car, looking worried and talking to a suspicious guy. Who could that mysterious man be?

videos.title: Police Look For Popatlal
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey is trying to take Champaklal to the hospital but the society members react otherwise. Later, the police are looking for Popatlal but he is nowhere to be found. Where is Popatlal?

videos.title: Popatlal Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey is on the lookout for Popatlal and searches for him everywhere. Will he be found?

videos.title: On Popatlal's Trail
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey and all the members of Gokuldham colony are on the lookout for Popatlal but he is nowhere to be found. Where could he be?

videos.title: Musibat Ki Jad - Popatlal
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey is searching for Popatlal in society while Popatlal is hiding in Bhide's house creating trouble for Bhide. What has Popatlal done and will Inspector Pandey find him?

videos.title: Tension Mein Popatlal
videos.overview: After a frantic search, Popatlal is finally discovered locked in his closet. When asked about his disappearance, he opens up about the overwhelming stress and tension that had been building up inside him.

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Rishta
videos.overview: Everyone is relieved to see Popatlal so happy and relaxed. And to add to the excitement, a potential wedding opportunity is on the horizon! Will Popatlal finally tie the knot and start a new chapter in his life?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Kundli
videos.overview: Popatlal grows increasingly impatient as he awaits a phone call from Inspector Pandey to find out if his horoscope matches the girl's. How will Popatlal handle the suspense?

videos.title: Big Day For Popatlal
videos.overview: Gokuldham colony waits for the bride's family to arrive. Will everything go well for Popatlal?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Kismat
videos.overview: Popatlal's wait may finally be over as he meets the girl and her family, accompanied by Inspector Pandey and his wife. Will this meeting seal the deal and lead to a long-awaited wedding?

videos.title: Ladki Ka Decision
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey thoroughly questions Popatlal on several matters before revealing the bride's decision.

videos.title: Last Chance For Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal's heart races as he prepares for his make-or-break meeting with his dream girl. He's determined to win her heart.

videos.title: Popatlal's Date
videos.overview: Popatlal finally clears the air with his potential bride, laying all his cards on the table. But will his honesty pay off?

videos.title: Popatlal Ko Kaise Sambhale?
videos.overview: The members of the Gokuldham Society are concerned for Popatlal since Madhubala has left him in limbo about her decision to marry him. How will they support him during this uncertain time?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Sagaai
videos.overview: Madhubala and her family meet with Popatlal and his friends to reveal their final decision on their potential union.

videos.title: Engagement Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: The entire colony is buzzing with excitement for Popatlal's engagement.

videos.title: Popatlal Gets Anxious
videos.overview: Popatlal is both thrilled and anxious about his engagement ceremony. Will he be able to keep his nerves in check and make it through the big day without a hitch?

videos.title: Popatlal's Engagement Day
videos.overview: It's Popatlal's engagement ceremony and everyone is excited. He hopes everything goes as planned. But will it all go smoothly, or will something unexpected happen?

videos.title: Popatlal's Engagement Ceremony
videos.overview: Popatlal's engagement ceremony is coming up and everyone is eager to welcome his beautiful bride into the family. But will the big day go off without a hitch?

videos.title: Popatlal Gayab Hain
videos.overview: Popatlal goes missing on his engagement day, and Inspector Pandey holds the Gokuldham members responsible. Where is Popatlal, and will he show up for his engagement?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Sagaai Tooti
videos.overview: Dr. Hathi drops a bombshell on Popatlal, revealing that he and Madhubala are both carriers of the rare genetic disorder, Thalassemia minor. The doctor warns that their marriage could lead to serious health complications.

videos.title: Celebrating Tapu Sena
videos.overview: Tapu Sena returns from Pune, eager to celebrate their award with the entire colony. However, they're concerned that Popatlal might still be upset about his cancelled wedding and wonder how to approach him.

videos.title: Kitty Party
videos.overview: The women of Gokuldham gather for a kitty party, eager to share laughter and conversation.

videos.title: Surprise Haircut
videos.overview: All the women in Gokuldham society decide to surprise their husbands with a fresh haircut. How will the husbands react to this unexpected change in their looks?

videos.title: Surprise For Bhide
videos.overview: Bhide receives a surprise from his wife and daughter as they unveil their new hair color. Later, Popatlal summons all the men of the colony to his house for an urgent matter.

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Meetha Sapna
videos.overview: Jethalal believes he is dreaming when Champaklal tells him to go back to sleep instead of waking up. How will Jethalal react when he realizes this might not be just a dream?

videos.title: Breakfast For Gokuldham
videos.overview: Dr. Hathi and his wife organize a grand special breakfast for the Gokuldham residents. They visit each house to ensure nobody eats before the surprise meal.

videos.title: Banarasi Breakfast
videos.overview: Everyone eagerly anticipates the special Banarasi Breakfast organized by Dr. Hathi on Sunday. Will everything unfold smoothly as planned for this exciting event?

videos.title: Bhide Looks For Popatlal
videos.overview: Bhide searches for Popatlal, convinced that Popatlal is playing a prank by hiding Sakharam.

videos.title: Goli Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Bhide searches for Sakharam and discovers that Goli has gone to get breakfast on Sakharam. Later, they find Sakharam crashed with no sign of Goli.

videos.title: Goli And Sakharam Return
videos.overview: The colony members express concern about Goli and Sakharam's whereabouts to Inspector Pandey.

videos.title: A Successful Breakfast
videos.overview: The colony members delight in the delicious breakfast organized by Dr. Hathi and celebrate Goli and Sakharam's return.

videos.title: Celebrating Sweet 16 Years
videos.overview: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 16 years of bringing laughter and joy to millions of viewers every day.

videos.title: Bhide Ne Rakhi Shart
videos.overview: Bhide makes a daring challenge to the children - if he wins, they can no longer play in the compound, but if he loses, they will never be interrupted again.

videos.title: Penalty Shoot Out
videos.overview: The colony members line up, each taking turns to shoot their penalty kicks, hoping to score the winning goal.

videos.title: Roshan Ki Maangein
videos.overview: Roshan demands that Sodhi take her out for a movie, shopping, and restaurant since it's been days since they went out. Meanwhile, Bhide is concerned that everyone will not pay the maintenance fee on time.

videos.title: Jethalal's Business Trip
videos.overview: Jethalal is getting ready for a work trip to Hyderabad and leaves the shop duties to his helpers. But, he tells Baagha to make sure Bawri stays away from the shop.

videos.title: Early Morning Flight
videos.overview: Jethalal is anxious about oversleeping and missing his morning flight. He reaches out to his neighbours for help and companionship. Will anyone come to his aid?

videos.title: Jethalal Needs A Ride
videos.overview: Jethalal thanks Iyer and Babita for their kindness and their decision to drive him to the airport for his flight. However, things take a sharp turn when he finds himself stranded with a punctured tire on a lonely street.

videos.title: Jethalal Misses His Flight
videos.overview: Jethalal is upset because he missed his flight and fears that Bapuji will scold him. What will he do now?

videos.title: Jethalal Returns
videos.overview: Jethalal returns to his shop after his flight is cancelled, surprising Nattu Kaka and Baagha.

videos.title: Everything Is Booked
videos.overview: Jethalal, Bapuji, Iyer, and Babita find out that the restaurant is full. They call other options, but they’re all booked too. Can they find a place to eat?

videos.title: Jal Hi Jeevan Hai
videos.overview: Bhide sets the quote of the day highlighting the importance of water. The question remains: will the colony members truly grasp the severity of the situation?

videos.title: Ziddi Nalka
videos.overview: Bhide and his family head out in a cab, while Popatlal is waiting for the plumber. He receives a call asking him to get to the office as soon as possible. How will Popatlal handle the situation?

videos.title: Tala Nahi Todne Denge
videos.overview: A plumber arrives at the colony, looking for Bhide, because he has forgotten his phone inside Bhide's house. However, the colony children refuse to let the plumber break the lock and instead, ask him to wait.

videos.title: Chaabi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: The plumber's frustration reaches a boiling point as the keys to the lock remain nowhere to be found in Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Taarak's boss faces a similar predicament, losing his keys as well.

videos.title: Chaabi Wale Ko Bulao
videos.overview: The situation in Gokuldha becomes chaotic as the plumber loses his temper and threatens to break Bhide's lock. However, Abdul suggests breaking the lock. Can the key maker resolve the issue?"

videos.title: Bholaram's Anniversary
videos.overview: Bholaram is distraught that his entire day has been ruined by searching for the keys. Meanwhile, his wife Sushma arrives in Gokuldham colony. Will the colony members be able to make amends and turn his day around?

videos.title: Ravivaar Ka Plan
videos.overview: Bhide is thrilled about his Sunday plan to enjoy Kothimbir Vadi with his family. However, a series of unexpected events throws a wrench in his plans.

videos.title: Abdul Kaha Hain?
videos.overview: Goli is eager to get some amchur powder, but Abdul's shop remains closed. Later, Tapu Sena informs the members of the society that Abdul hasn't shown up yet. Where could Abdul be?

videos.title: Paani Khatam
videos.overview: Popatlal is furious when the water stops mid-shower. He storms down and blames Bhide for the inconvenience.

videos.title: Abdul Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: The residents of Gokuldham colony are worried because Abdul is nowhere to be found. They search for him at his house and all the places he usually visits, but there is no sign of him.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Udhaari
videos.overview: The colony members find out that Abdul owes some people money, and they have come to collect it. Maybe that's why he has been hiding for a few days.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Waapsi
videos.overview: Everyone is expecting Inspector Pandey to find Abdul and bring him back. However, Pandey Ji is coming back empty-handed and Abdul is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Majboori
videos.overview: Abdul's return brings relief to the colony, but he keeps his financial struggles to himself. Despite his cheerful reunion, Abdul is secretly desperate and decides to sell his shop, abandoning his life in the colony.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Tension
videos.overview: Dr. Hathi mentions to all the men that Abdul has seemed different ever since he returned. What could be troubling Abdul?

videos.title: Abdul Ke Dukaan Pe Sale
videos.overview: Abdul, desperate for money and on the verge of selling his shop, offers a 50% discount to colony members without disclosing the true reason behind his sale.

videos.title: Abdul's Urgency
videos.overview: Jethalal checks in on Nattu Kaka and Baagha to ensure the shop is running smoothly in his absence. Meanwhile, Abdul is frantically trying to sell off all the goods to raise the money he desperately needs.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Investigates
videos.overview: Tapu Sena is intrigued by Abdul's mysterious behaviour and decides to get to the bottom of it. They confront him, demanding to know the real reason behind his sudden decision to sell everything at a whopping 50% discount.

videos.title: Spying On Abdul
videos.overview: The Tapu Sena installs a listening device to monitor Abdul's activities, but they feel uneasy about their decision.

videos.title: Abdul Ki Dukaan
videos.overview: The news that Abdul is attempting to sell his shop sends shockwaves through the colony, leaving all its members stunned and concerned.

videos.title: Abdul Ka Udhaar
videos.overview: Abdul opens up about his troubles to the members of the Gokuldham Society, who immediately offer to lend him money, but he graciously declines their help. How will Abdul manage to clear his debts on his own?

videos.title: Abdul's Last Janmashtami
videos.overview: The colony is reeling in disbelief as Abdul prepares to sell his shop and bid farewell. The thought of this being his last festival among them is unbearable. Will Abdul reconsider his decision?

videos.title: All Eyes On The Matki
videos.overview: Tapu Sena is confident that they will emerge victorious in the Dahi Handi celebrations and successfully break the Matki. However, the colony members are worried about their chances.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Find A Loophole
videos.overview: Tapu Sena is thrilled to participate in the Dahi Handi competition but faces disappointment when they're unable to register.

videos.title: Matki Kaun Phodega?
videos.overview: Tapu Sena is eager to participate in the competition, but their rivals mock them due to their lack of practice and experience. Can Tapu Sena prove their doubters wrong?

videos.title: Bal Gopal Gokuldham Group
videos.overview: The spotlight shines bright on Tapu Sena as they prepare to take on the ultimate challenge of cracking the Matki. With the entire family and neighbourhood on edge, can they pull it off?

videos.title: Abdul Ki Kahaani
videos.overview: Abdul discloses the real reason behind selling his shop to the Gokuldham residents. Will they stand by him in this decision?

videos.title: Too Many Customers
videos.overview: Tapu Sena helps Abdul save his shop by winning the Dahi Handi competition and securing the necessary funds. Meanwhile, Jethalal struggles to manage the shop on his own due to the absence of Nattu Kaka and Bagha.

videos.title: Ganpati Decorations
videos.overview: The women of Gokuldham want to take charge of the Ganpati decorations and propose their idea to the colony members.

videos.title: Mahila Mandal's Decoration Planning
videos.overview: The women of Gokuldham are thrilled to welcome Bappa and have taken charge of all the decorations. However, they want to keep their decoration idea a secret from everyone.

videos.title: Decoration Ka Theme Kya Hai?
videos.overview: The men in the colony are eager to know the theme the women have chosen for the Ganpati celebrations, but their wives are tight-lipped about it.

videos.title: Decoration Ka Suspense
videos.overview: All the men try different ways to uncover the secrets and learn the theme of the decoration. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena's rivals are envious that Gokuldham's decoration video went viral and decide to sabotage their next Ganpati celebration.

videos.title: Gokuldham Mein Aaye Pehelwaan
videos.overview: During the Ganapati celebration at Gokuldham Society, Olympic medalist Aman Sehrawat makes a special appearance, accompanied by Asit Modi.

videos.title: Bappa Ke Darshan
videos.overview: Gokuldham colony is abuzz with festive spirit as people throng to visit Bappa and admire the beautiful decorations created by the colony's women. Olympic medalist Aman Sehrawat's special visit adds to the excitement,

videos.title: Devotion Towards Bappa
videos.overview: The actors from Kahan Shuru Kahan Khatam visit Gokuldham, inviting residents to watch their film. Later, the community opens the 'Daan Peti'. What will they find inside?

videos.title: Ikkis Lakh Ka Cheque
videos.overview: Shock and excitement erupt in the colony as members discover a staggering donation cheque tucked away in the 'Daan Peti'.

videos.title: Cheque Ka Kya Karein?
videos.overview: The colony members are shocked, excited, and perplexed about what to do with the enormous donation. They wonder if it's genuine or fake, who the donor is, and whether they should investigate further.

videos.title: Bank Manager Se Mulaqat
videos.overview: All the colony members gather to meet the bank manager and discuss what to do with the cheque. What will the manager say?

videos.title: Ganpati Celebrations Ka Cheque
videos.overview: Bhide, Iyer, and Jethalal are thrilled after receiving a cheque worth twenty-one lakhs for Ganpati celebrations, unaware that it's all part of a setup. What unexpected events will unfold next?

videos.title: Zaroorat Mand Bacche
videos.overview: With the donated money in hand, the colony launches a search for worthy students who need financial support to pursue their educational dreams. Will their efforts lead them to the right children?

videos.title: Young Minds Unite
videos.overview: Gokuldham Society extends an invitation to all prospective candidates to attend the selection process for their scholarship program.

videos.title: Vicky Ki Saajish
videos.overview: The rivals of Tapu Sena are over the moon after convincingly tricking the Gokuldham colony members into thinking they've received a massive donation. The members are already celebrating and have announced scholarships for the kids. But will they catch on before things get out of hand?

videos.title: A Big Shock For Gokuldham
videos.overview: The colony members are shocked and disappointed when they learn that the cheque for the scholarships has been voided and payment has been stopped. What will they do now?

videos.title: Vicky Ki Marzi
videos.overview: The colony members are left stunned and shocked, unsure of how to proceed, after Vicky refuses to make the payment and bluntly tells them that he has changed his mind.

videos.title: Bappa Se Prarthana
videos.overview: Abdul informs the society members that Rita Reporter is arriving in the colony with her cameramen. With Vicky still withholding the funds, Bhide and the other members are left wondering how they will manage to handle the situation.

videos.title: Gokuldham Society Ki Badnaami
videos.overview: The colony members are torn about how to address the scholarship situation, and they're considering being transparent about what really happened. Will they muster the courage to come clean?

videos.title: Paiso Ka Bandobast
videos.overview: The colony members are overjoyed when Tapu Sena reveals that the funds have been secured. But how did they miraculously come up with the money?

videos.title: Sarva Pitru Amavasya
videos.overview: The entire colony comes together to prepare traditional food and make elaborate arrangements for the Sarva Pitru Amavasya ritual, a sacred ceremony to honour and pay respect to beloved ancestors.

videos.title: Discount Dilemma
videos.overview: Jethalal struggles to sell his electronics as online markets and malls, with their enticing discounts, continue to dominate the market. Will he be able to find a solution to overcome these challenges?

videos.title: Gada Electronics Ki Nayi Scheme
videos.overview: Jethalal meets with Nattu Kaka and Bagha to discuss new ideas for increasing sales at Gada Electronics. Will they come up with a plan?"

videos.title: Celebrity At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha eagerly await the arrival of a special celebrity at Gada Electronics. Who is the celebrity?

videos.title: Garba Practice
videos.overview: Gokuldham colony is abuzz with Navratri excitement. As the community comes together to perfect their Garba steps, but will the celebrations unfold smoothly, or will unexpected twists and turns add a dash of drama to the festivities?

videos.title: Bhide Falls Sick
videos.overview: The colony members are excited about Navratri celebrations and decide to start planning the decorations. But with Bhide falling sick suddenly, who will take up the charge?

videos.title: Navratri Decorations
videos.overview: Tapu Sena contacts the mandap decorator, but he refuses the job. Undeterred, they reach out to another decorator. Will they succeed in managing the wedding arrangements without Bhide's guidance?

videos.title: Confronting Danav
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal visits Danav’s home and offers support to his wife. Later, they confront Danav directly. What will be the result of their bold stand?

videos.title: Mahila Mandal Ki Meeting
videos.overview: Decorations for the event in Gokuldham are underway. Meanwhile, the Mahila Mandal calls for an urgent meeting involving all society members. What could be the pressing issue behind this sudden gathering?

videos.title: Dushman Ka Dushman Dost Hota Hain
videos.overview: Bhide attempts to contact other decorators, but they all refuse due to the society's conflict with Danav. Later, Popatlal introduces a new decorator named Raka Tabla. Will he step in to assist the members with the Navratri decorations?

videos.title: Danav Ki Complaint
videos.overview: The ladies of Gokuldham go to the police station to file a complaint against Danav, who beats his wife at home. Will Inspector Pandey be able to help with this situation?

videos.title: Danav Ki Dhamki
videos.overview: Danav dares the Gokuldham colony members to finish the decorations, saying he’ll only help if they apologize. How will the colony members handle this situation?

videos.title: Danav's Revenge
videos.overview: Everyone in Gokuldham is thrilled about the Navratri celebrations, but Danav is determined to take revenge and ruin their festivities. Will he succeed in his plans?

videos.title: Saving Danav's Life
videos.overview: Danav's wife rushes in to inform the colony members that Danav is in danger. What has happened to him, and will the colony members decide to help?

videos.title: Ravan Dahan In Gokuldham
videos.overview: The colony members are excited to get back to their festivities and dance Garba. Will the celebrations continue without any trouble until Raavan Dahan?

videos.title: Japan Ki Special Strawberry
videos.overview: Anjali invites Jethalal and Champaklal over for a strawberry milkshake. Later, Taarak's boss inquires about his Bade Guruji, putting Taarak in a tricky situation.

videos.title: Taarak's Day Off
videos.overview: Taarak is excited to learn that his boss will be on leave for two days, prompting him to plan some quality time with Anjali. Will his plans go smoothly?

videos.title: Boss Se Chutkara
videos.overview: Taarak is pleased to have time off from work due to his boss's absence. However, the other employees are now demanding the same. Will Taarak grant their request?

videos.title: Taarak Ko Ho Rahi Tension
videos.overview: Taarak is anxious, fearing his boss's reaction if it's revealed that the whole office was on break. Could this cost him his job?

videos.title: Bade Guruji Se Mulaqat
videos.overview: Taarak’s boss insists that he organise a meeting with Bade Guruji. Will he manage to make it happen?

videos.title: Bapuji Ko Kaise Manaye?
videos.overview: Taarak worries about how to get Bapuji to play the role of Bade Guruji for his boss. Can he convince him to go along with it?

videos.title: Taarak Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Champaklal is irritated with Jethalal for agreeing to Taarak’s request and decides not to take on the role of Bade Guruji. How will Taarak handle this setback?

videos.title: Bade Guruji Ke Saath Mulaqat
videos.overview: Taarak worries whether Bapuji will make it in time to pose as Bade Guruji for Varun. Will everything go smoothly with their pretend meeting?

videos.title: Guruji's Double Trouble
videos.overview: Taarak and his friends are stumped on how to arrange a meeting between Varun, his boss, and Bade Guruji, especially since Varun is already acquainted with Bapuji. Can they find a fake Bade Guruji in time to pull off the charade?

videos.title: Boss Aur Guruji Ki Meeting
videos.overview: Taarak finally manages to dress up Popatlal as Bade Guruji, preparing him to meet Varun, the boss’s son. Will Taarak’s elaborate plan succeed, or will they get caught?

videos.title: Bade Guruji Ka Parda Faash
videos.overview: Varun and his father seek Bade Guruji's blessings in separate encounters. Will they uncover Taarak's elaborate scheme?

videos.title: Diwali Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: With enthusiasm high, the colony members make grand arrangements for Diwali. But will the festivities go smoothly?

videos.title: Sarees For Mahila Mandal
videos.overview: Champaklal invites the Mahila Mandal to his home and gifts them sarees for Diwali. Meanwhile, the men of Gokuldham gather at Abdul's shop. Later, Bhide makes an announcement about distributing free firecrackers to all society members.

videos.title: Free Patakhe
videos.overview: Tapu Sena suggests a collective purchase of firecrackers for everyone in the colony. But will the colony members be on board with this plan?

videos.title: Allrounder Patakha
videos.overview: Jethalal acquires a super firecracker and can’t wait to show it off to the colony members. Will this firecracker live up to the hype, or will it fizzle out?

videos.title: Patakha Panic
videos.overview: Jethalal’s convinced that Allrounder Patakha is going to flop, and he’s worried about losing everything. Is he overthinking it, or is there something to his fear?

videos.title: Allrounder Patakha's Final Test
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members are thrilled about the Allrounder Patakha and hold a lucky draw to decide who will get to light it. But will it go off with a bang, or turn out to be a dud?

videos.title: Life After Diwali
videos.overview: The excitement of Diwali fades, leaving the colony members feeling empty. As they try to fill the void, they begin to look for new adventures and challenges to take on.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Exercise
videos.overview: Champaklal encourages Jethalal to work out at home. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka devise a plan to attract more customers to the shop.

videos.title: Surprise Trip
videos.overview: Feeling restless in Gokuldham, Tapu Sena decides it’s time for an exciting getaway. Bapuji, noticing their eagerness, hints at the perfect destination where they’re sure to have a blast but keeps the location a secret.

videos.title: Old Is Gold
videos.overview: Bapuji surprises Tapu Sena with a secret trip, building their excitement to a peak. But how will they react when they discover the destination is an old age home?

videos.title: Fun At The Old Age Home
videos.overview: While Tapu Sena and Bapuji bond with the senior citizens at the old age home, Jethalal and his friends grow increasingly worried. Will they be able to find out where they’ve gone?

videos.title: Dairy Strike
videos.overview: The milkmen’s strike leaves the colony struggling to get their basic daily supplies. How will the residents manage without milk?

videos.title: Morning Chai
videos.overview: Gokuldham Colony faces a crisis as the milk supply runs dry, leaving everyone without their beloved morning chai. Later, Bhide struggles to decide whether to repair his fridge or replace it.

videos.title: Bhide's Fridge Repair
videos.overview: Jethalal gets frustrated with Bagha because Bawri keeps visiting the shop repeatedly. Later, Bagha heads to Bhide's house to repair his fridge.

videos.title: Fridge Ka Sauda
videos.overview: Bhide unknowingly strikes a deal to sell his fridge to a scrap dealer for a shockingly low price. Just in time, Jethalal steps in to stop the sale and tries to help Bhide secure a much better offer. Will Jethalal’s intervention save the day?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Liye Sunahara Mauka
videos.overview: After successfully delivering the fridge to the businessman, Jethalal is presented with an enticing offer to acquire more old fridges of the same brand for a generous reward.

videos.title: Cooling King Ka Offer
videos.overview: Jethalal faces difficulty finding old fridges in scrap shops and comes up with an exchange offer to acquire Cooling King brand fridges.

videos.title: Mega Exchange Offer
videos.overview: Jethalal's social media campaign quickly gains traction, attracting a lot of attention. His tempting offer seems too good to be true and other businessmen start to wonder what the catch is.

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Khushi
videos.overview: Jethalal successfully acquires all the fridges and is overjoyed. Later, a businessman arrives at Gada Electronics to finalize the deal. How will this transaction unfold?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Duvidha
videos.overview: Jethalal finds himself in a dilemma with old fridges cluttering his shop just as a new shipment of fridges is about to arrive. How will he handle the situation?

videos.title: Macchar Problem
videos.overview: Baagha struggles with the mosquito problem as he and Nattu Kaka look after the fridges overnight, waiting for them to be transferred.

videos.title: What To Do With The Fridges?
videos.overview: Jethalal is concerned about the fridges lying around in the colony with no sign of anyone coming to collect them. What explanation will the businessman give when Jethalal calls him?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Saath Fraud
videos.overview: Jethalal goes to the police station to file a complaint against the businessman who scammed him. Will Inspector Pandey be able to help him?

videos.title: Dunkiwala Ko Kaise Pakde?
videos.overview: Jethalal and his neighbours are increasingly worried as they struggle to trace Dunkiwala, the businessman who deceived Jethalal. Will they find a way to catch him?

videos.title: Dunkiwala Ke Saath Meeting
videos.overview: Jethalal and his friends arrange a meeting with Dunkiwala, hoping to catch him red-handed. Will their plan succeed?

videos.title: Dunkiwala Ka Fraud
videos.overview: Upon discovering that Babu Bakkal is actually Dunkiwala, Jethalal flees from his men, taking the money with him. Will he get caught?

videos.title: Sodhi's Party Plans
videos.overview: Sodhi is overjoyed about his friend's visit from Punjab for his birthday. Will Roshan give him the green light for a celebration?

videos.title: Paratha Party
videos.overview: Roshan refuses to allow Sodhi to throw a party for his friends visiting from out of town and suggests a paratha party instead.

videos.title: No Party Sharty
videos.overview: Roshan hesitates to give Sodhi permission for his party, but his friends promise he will behave. Will she agree?

videos.title: Harmeet’s Party
videos.overview: Sodhi brings Bhide and Popatlal along for Harmeet’s birthday to ensure he doesn’t drink. But will the two manage to resist temptation themselves?

videos.title: Cheers Or Not?
videos.overview: Harmeet tries to trick Sodhi into drinking, but Popatlal and Bhide make sure to keep him in check. Will Harmeet succeed in getting Sodhi tipsy during his birthday celebrations?

videos.title: Sodhi Ki Party-Sharty
videos.overview: Popatlal and Bhide manage a drunken Sodhi, while Roshan anxiously waits at home. Will Sodhi be allowed into the house?

videos.title: Bhide Seeks Jethalal's Help
videos.overview: Bhide and Popatlal turn to Jethalal for help in managing a drunken Sodhi. Just as Jethalal is about to leave home, Champaklal catches him. Will this land Jethalal in trouble?

videos.title: Taarak Ka Idea
videos.overview: The men of Gokuldham rally together to help Bhide and Popatlal manage a drunken Sodhi. They turn to Taarak, hoping he can come up with a plan to get Sodhi safely back to Gokuldham. What solution will Taarak devise?

videos.title: Anjali Ki Dosti
videos.overview: Anjali learns the truth about how the men of the colony lied to Roshan Bhabhi to save Sodhi after his party-sharty. Will she expose their lies?

videos.title: Sodhi Confesses
videos.overview: Anjali’s plan succeeds, and Sodhi finally admits to his wife about his party-sharty and how the men of the colony made up an excuse to protect him. How will she respond?

videos.title: Permission To Party
videos.overview: Jethalal grows increasingly worried about his son's future now that he’s grown up. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena seeks Bhide’s permission to let Sonu attend a late-night party.

videos.title: Baccho Ka Bhavishya
videos.overview: Bhide and the others grow anxious about their children's future and upcoming marriage proposals. Later, Bhide becomes particularly concerned when he finds Sonu's phone switched off.

videos.title: Sonu Runs Late
videos.overview: Bhide is on edge, worried that Sonu and Tapu Sena haven't returned from the party. He decides to take matters into his own hands and heads out to check on them.

videos.title: Sonu Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Bhide’s concern for Sonu grows as he struggles with his distrust of Tapu and his desire to find her a suitable match quickly. How will he handle the pressure of having a growing daughter?

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Umr
videos.overview: Bhide is concerned about Sonu’s friendship with Tapu, fearing it might blossom into love. How will he come to terms with the fact that his daughter is now grown up and capable of making her own decisions?

videos.title: Bhide Ki Jaldbaazi
videos.overview: Worried about Sonu and Tapu's growing friendship, Bhide decides to speed up his search for a groom for Sonu. Meanwhile, Bapuji starts looking for a bride for Tapu.

videos.title: Suitable Groom For Sonu
videos.overview: Bhide calls in an acquaintance to help arrange Sonu’s marriage. How will she react when she finds out?

videos.title: Shaadi Pressure
videos.overview: Jethalal and Champaklal attempt to persuade Tappu to consider marriage, but he firmly refuses. Meanwhile, Sonu faces similar pressure from her parents. How will the duo manage to decline their elders' expectations?

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Darr
videos.overview: As their families begin the search for suitable life partners, Sonu and Tapu find themselves in a state of panic. Desperate to avoid arranged marriages, will they be able to come up with a plan?

videos.title: Tapu's Wedding Woes
videos.overview: Tapu is growing increasingly anxious as the pressure to get married mounts, but he's running out of creative excuses to dodge the issue. Will he find a clever way to wriggle out of it?

videos.title: Tapu And Sonu Hire An Actor
videos.overview: Tapu and Sonu come up with a plan to hire an actor to help them avoid getting married. But will their plan work?

videos.title: Mission Shaadi Atkao
videos.overview: Tapu and Sonu convince the actor to help them in this situation. Will their plan work out?

videos.title: Chotelal Ki Bhavishyavaani
videos.overview: Chotelal, disguised as an astrologer, advises Bhide to stop worrying about Sonu's marriage now, in an attempt to help Sonu escape the situation. Will Bhide be convinced?

videos.title: Popatlal's Suspense
videos.overview: Popatlal keeps the Gokuldham men in suspense about his plans. Meanwhile, a father and son visit Gada Electronics to purchase a phone.

videos.title: Rahsyamai Meeting
videos.overview: Everyone is eager about Popatlal's huge announcement that will either shake or break their world.

videos.title: Popatlal's Huge Announcement
videos.overview: As restlessness grows, Popatlal gears up to reveal his much-awaited announcement in the clubhouse.

videos.title: Sabki Bhavishyavaani
videos.overview: Popatlal uses artificial intelligence to predict everyone's future and reads them out one by one. What surprises and revelations await them?

videos.title: Bapuji's Future
videos.overview: While Popatlal eagerly shares everyone’s future, he hesitates when it comes to Bapuji. What could he be hiding?

videos.title: Gokuldham New Year Celebration
videos.overview: In Gokuldham, everyone gets ready to welcome the New Year with elaborate celebrations and great enthusiasm.

videos.title: Secret Surprise
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members ring in the New Year with great enthusiasm and excitement. Meanwhile, each of them secretly prepares unique balloon surprises for the celebration.

videos.title: Ek Nayi Shuruaat
videos.overview: Everyone in Gokuldham Colony celebrates and welcomes the New Year with great excitement and festive spirit.

videos.title: Bapuji Ki Udaan
videos.overview: Bapuji gets the opportunity to release the balloon to kick-start the New Year, but things take an unexpected turn when he ends up floating away with the balloons. Will the others manage to bring him down in time?

videos.title: Bapuji's Balloon Adventure
videos.overview: Bapuji drifts across the city, carried by balloons, as the colony members race to catch up and figure out how to bring him back down. Will they manage to rescue him?

videos.title: Bapuji Ko Kaise Utaare?
videos.overview: The colony members panic as they struggle to figure out how to bring Bapuji down. With Inspector Pandey stepping in, can they find a way?

videos.title: Bapuji Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: As Bapuji floats further away, the colony members lose sight of him. How will they manage to find him and get him down safely?

videos.title: Maa Ka Abhaas
videos.overview: Sunder's mother senses that Champaklal might leave the country, while the Gokuldham members work to figure out the situation. Meanwhile, Inspector Pandey receives orders to locate Champaklal urgently.

videos.title: Pakistani Jasoos
videos.overview: As Bapuji floats towards Pakistan, fishermen spot him and mistakenly think he's a Pakistani spy, alerting the authorities. Will they uncover the truth?

videos.title: Bapuji in Trouble
videos.overview: Bapuji is apprehended by the Pakistani army, who mistake him for an Indian spy. What actions will they take against him?

videos.title: Bapuji Pakde Gaye
videos.overview: Bapuji gets captured by Pakistani soldiers and interrogated. What will Bapuji say to escape this situation?

videos.title: Bapuji's Bluff
videos.overview: After being caught by Pakistani soldiers, Bapuji convinces them he’s one of their spies. Will they see through his bluff or believe his story?

videos.title: Bapuji's Rescue
videos.overview: Bapuji finds himself in a tight spot as the Pakistani soldiers see through his bluff. Can he devise a plan to save himself and the fishermen?

videos.title: Champaklal Is Safe
videos.overview: Champaklal contacts Jethalal via video call to let him know he is safe in Kutch. Will he make it back to Gokuldham without any trouble?

videos.title: Champaklal Returns Home
videos.overview: As Champaklal returns to Gokuldham, he shares the unbelievable tale of how he was swept away and captured by Pakistani soldiers. How will the residents react to his extraordinary adventure?

videos.title: AI Ki Bhavishyavaani
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members find themselves both anxious and excited about the AI predictions. Will they come true, or are they just a hoax?

videos.title: Jethalal Ko Aaya Sapna
videos.overview: Jethalal dreams that his business is booming, but Bapuji wakes him up. Will his dream turn into reality the next day?

videos.title: Jethalal Out Of Stock
videos.overview: Jethalal discovers that his storehouse is out of electronics stock. What's preventing him from restocking his appliances?

videos.title: Dhanda Bandh
videos.overview: Jethalal is in a state of panic as the company denies him the essential stock for his electronics store. What could be the reason behind this sudden boycott?

videos.title: Ramsang Se Panga
videos.overview: Jethalal's business is on the line as Ramsang cuts off his stock supply. Will he be able to find a solution?

videos.title: Surprise Visit
videos.overview: Jethalal is in for a shock when he discovers that a complaint has been lodged against him, leading to his stock being blocked. A surprise inspection of his store is now scheduled, which will seal his fate.

videos.title: Shutter Bandh
videos.overview: Jethalal faces a crisis when he gets locked out of his shop on the day of a surprise inspection. Will he find a solution?

videos.title: Venukutti's Arrival
videos.overview: Jethalal hatches an elaborate plan to welcome Venu Kutti. He borrows Sodhi’s car, to keep him distracted. Will his scheme unfold as planned?

videos.title: Nakli Venukutti
videos.overview: Bagha disguises himself as a driver to pick up Mr. Venukutti, while Nattu Kaka poses as him to fool the real driver. Will their plan succeed?

videos.title: Bagha Tries His Best
videos.overview: Bagha does everything he can to keep Mr. Venukutti occupied while Jethalal rushes to open the shop’s shutters. Can he buy enough time?

videos.title: Cutter And Shutter
videos.overview: Jethalal waits at the entrance of his shop along with Bawri and the locksmith while Bagha is on his way with Mr Venkutti. How will he enter the shop?

videos.title: Bagha Loses Venukutti
videos.overview: Venukutti gives Bagha the slip and makes his way to Jethalal’s shop. Will Jethalal manage to open the shutter before it’s too late?

videos.title: Venukutti Questions Jethalal
videos.overview: Mr. Venukutti bombards Jethalal with questions and complaints. Can Jethalal handle the tough interrogation?

videos.title: Bapuji's Trip
videos.overview: Bapuji is eager to go on a trip with his friends, but Jethalal is hesitant to let him go alone. Will he find a way to join in?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Pol Pakdi Gayi
videos.overview: Champaklal discovers that Jethalal is faking his illness. Later, his friends arrive to take him along. Can Jethalal stop him?

videos.title: Lunch Invitation For Jethalal
videos.overview: Tapu and Sonu fight it out over one point in a badminton match. Later, Jethalal gets an invitation for lunch from Babita and Taarak. Whose house will he go to?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Duvidha
videos.overview: Taarak suggests a way for Jethalal to enjoy meals at both his home and Babita's house. Will Jethalal be able to pull it off?

videos.title: Jethalal Ka Jhoot Pakda Gaya
videos.overview: Jethalal, already full from pretending to eat at Babita’s house, is caught off guard when Anjali arrives. How will he manage the situation?

videos.title: Special Day Ki Special Baat
videos.overview: Tapu informs Bhide that he has something special to share with Sonu on this special day, leaving Bhide anxious. What could it be?

videos.title: Sakharam Par Kabootar Ke Daane
videos.overview: To improve his chances of getting married, Popatlal starts feeding pigeons by placing grains on Bhide’s Sakharam. Will Bhide tolerate this?

videos.title: Bluetooth Baba Ka Interview
videos.overview: Popatlal is given the task of interviewing Bluetooth Baba. How will the conversation unfold?

videos.title: Bluetooth Baba Ka Prediction
videos.overview: Popatlal panics as he struggles to find a rickshaw. Will Bluetooth Baba’s prediction come true?

videos.title: Bhoot Ka Darr
videos.overview: Fear spreads through the colony as residents believe a ghost is lurking among them. Is there truth to their fears or just a misunderstanding?

videos.title: Champaklal Ka Darr
videos.overview: Champaklal is startled by a shadow he believes to be a ghost, while Sodhi, Popatlal, and Bhide try to reassure him. Is it really a ghost?

videos.title: Bhoothnath In Gokuldham
videos.overview: The society members grow anxious after Popatlal insists he saw someone inside Mr. Verma's house. Who could it be?

videos.title: Society Rules For Bhoothnath
videos.overview: Bhide approaches Bhootnath to explain the society's rules. Meanwhile, Taarak questions Jethalal about Tapu's marriage.

videos.title: Champaklal Aur Raja Mastana Ka Aamna Saamna
videos.overview: During his morning walk, Champaklal’s friends propose a potential match for Tapu. Later, Raja Mastnana calls Tapu. What trouble awaits him?

videos.title: Sonu Ke Liye Ladka
videos.overview: Joshi Kaka visits Bhide with a marriage proposal for Sonu. How will Bhide respond?

videos.title: Tapu Aur Sonu Ki Majboori
videos.overview: Bhide discovers that Tapu and Sonu tricked him and Champaklal with Raja Mastana’s help. Later, he takes Raja Mastana’s number from Abdul. How will Tapu and Sonu handle the situation?

videos.title: Bhide Meets Raja Mastana
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi dress up to meet Raja Mastana. What surprises await Tapu and Sonu?

videos.title: Bhide Ka Surprise
videos.overview: Bhide invites Raja Mastana to Gokuldham in front of Sonu and Tapu. Later, he hints to Champaklal about a surprise in store. What could Bhide be planning?

videos.title: Raja Mastana's Prediction
videos.overview: Raja Mastana arrives at Gokuldham Society as part of Bhide's plan, leaving Tapu and Sonu stunned. He makes a prediction about their marriage. How will Tapu and Sonu escape this situation?

videos.title: Tapu And Sonu Get Reprimanded
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi are disappointed with Sonu and scold her. Distressed, she calls Tapu for help. How will they resolve the situation?

videos.title: Kar Bhala To Hoga Bhala
videos.overview: Joshi Kaka presents Sonu with potential matches, but she turns them all down. Meanwhile, Kanji Kaka does the same for Tapu. How will Tapu and Sonu handle this situation?

videos.title: Sonu And Tapu's Grooming Day
videos.overview: As Madhavi and Sonu head to the parlour, the Mahila Mandal catches them. Later, Bhide informs Champaklal that the ladkewale are coming to see Sonu.

videos.title: Sonu Aur Tapu Ka Dukh
videos.overview: Sonu feels emotional about leaving the society after her marriage. Later, she and Tapu meet and express their sadness together.

videos.title: Sonu Ki Mangni
videos.overview: Sonu has a troubling dream that the groom's family has approved of her. Panicked, she calls Tapu for help. How will Tapu and Sonu handle this situation?

videos.title: Bhaag Ke Shaadi
videos.overview: Tapu suggests that Sonu elope and marry. He seeks Tapu Sena's help. Will their plan work?

videos.title: Bhide Ki Googly
videos.overview: Tapu and his Sena come together to carry out their plan, but obstacles arise. Later, as Sonu attempts to leave the house, she finds Bhide blocking her path. How will she handle the situation?

videos.title: Tapu Consoles Sonu
videos.overview: Bhide discovers that Sonu has lied to him. Meanwhile, Tapu comforts Sonu as she feels guilty for deceiving her father. Later, Bhide informs Jethalal about Tapu and Sonu’s sudden disappearance. What will happen next?

videos.title: Bhide And Champaklal Realise Their Mistake
videos.overview: The residents of Gokuldham search for Tapu Sena at Nehru Ground but find no sign of them. Meanwhile, Tapu and Sonu purchase varmala garlands.

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Pavitra Bandhan
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members search for Tapu and Sonu, while Tapu comforts Sonu, assuring her about their decision. But what are they really planning?

videos.title: Bhide Files A Complaint
videos.overview: Bhide files a complaint against Tapu at the police station. Meanwhile, Tapu and Sonu invite the society members to come home. Have they really gotten married?

videos.title: Varmala Ki Katha
videos.overview: As Jethalal and Bhide enter the society with Inspector Pandey, they are stopped by the Mahila Mandal. Later, Tapu and Sonu finally reveal the truth to everyone.

videos.title: Tapu Aur Sonu Ka Interrogation
videos.overview: Tapu and Sonu confess that they are not married and reveal the whole truth behind their decision to run away from the society.

videos.title: Sanskari Aur Samajhdar
videos.overview: Tapu and Sonu reveal the truth, but Inspector Pandey remains suspicious. Their story is confirmed when Dia and Raj's parents arrive at Jethalal's house.

videos.title: Gokuldham Ki Holi
videos.overview: Gokuldham Society celebrates Holika Dahan with great enthusiasm, followed by joyful Holi festivities.

videos.title: Taarak Ke Liye Mithai
videos.overview: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak, but Taarak refuses to eat them because of Anjali. Later, Bhide plays a prank on Popatlal.

videos.title: Popatlal Creates A Scene
videos.overview: Popatlal causes a commotion in the society over earth sacks dumped in the compound. Later, Bhide calls Bhoothnath to scold him for the mess.

videos.title: Verma Ji Ka Ghar
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal goes for their daily vegetable shopping. Later, they visit Verma Ji’s newly renovated flat, but their visit takes an unexpected turn when a sudden siren startles everyone awake.

videos.title: Verma Ji Ke Ghar Ka Siren
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members grow frustrated with the alarm at Verma Ji's house and find a way to turn it off. Later, the Mahila Mandal admits to attempting to enter the house without permission.

videos.title: Hyderabad Ka Order
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka are delighted to see customers arriving early at Gada Electronics. Later, Jethalal receives a call from Hussain in Hyderabad regarding his order.

videos.title: Meeting Ka Din
videos.overview: Jethalal is eager for his meeting with Hussain, but a series of delays keep him from leaving for the office. Will he make it on time?

videos.title: Jethalal Gets A Lift
videos.overview: Hussain assures Bagha that he will arrive on time, while Jethalal faces multiple delays on his way to the shop. Later, he meets a man named Mahesh who offers him a lift. Will he make it on time?

videos.title: Jethalal Gets Stuck In The Car
videos.overview: Jethalal finds himself in trouble when his co-passenger suddenly flees, leaving him stuck in the car. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka anxiously await his arrival. Will he reach on time?

videos.title: Jethalal Runs Late
videos.overview: Jethalal finally manages to convince the driver to drop him at his shop, but he's running out of time. Will he miss out on the business deal?

videos.title: Kya Deal Hogi Pakki?
videos.overview: Jethalal worries that he might lose the deal due to his delay. However, the person responsible for all the commotion arrives at Gada Electronics. Will he admit his mistake?

videos.title: Sawal-Jawab Ka Khel
videos.overview: The Gokuldham men enjoy a question-and-answer game over soda. Later, Bhide is startled when he feels that Sakharam has started talking.

videos.title: Bhide Ke Ghar Ke Bahar Goni
videos.overview: Roshan discovers a suspicious sack outside Madhavi and Bhide's house and shares her concerns with the Mahila Mandal. Is this the start of a new problem?

videos.title: Goni Mein Kya Hai?
videos.overview: The police arrive at Gokuldham Society after Popatlal discovers a mysterious gunny sack outside Bhide’s house. What secrets lie hidden inside?

videos.title: Kathal Season
videos.overview: Excitement spreads through the colony as Bhide distributes jackfruit to everyone, a gift from his uncle’s farm. However, the women find themselves puzzled over how to cook it.

videos.title: Gudi Padwa In Gokuldham
videos.overview: The Bhides take the initiative to prepare a variety of jackfruit dishes for Gudi Padwa, adding to the festive spirit as all of Gokuldham Colony comes together to celebrate the auspicious day.

videos.title: Naya Saal Nayi Shuruat
videos.overview: As the new year begins, the residents of Gokuldham Colony are in high spirits, ready to embrace new beginnings. What surprises and adventures await them in the coming year?

videos.title: Jethalal Ko Hua Profit
videos.overview: Jethalal is thrilled as his sales surpass last year’s numbers, prompting Natu Kaka and Bagha to request a salary increment. However, his joy turns to worry when he returns home and finds Bapuji missing.

videos.title: Champaklal Has Tears In His eyes
videos.overview: Champaklal scolds Jethalal for delaying the door repair. Later, at the soda shop, Taarak shares a sher with everyone. Later, Jethalal finds Champaklal crying, but what’s the reason behind his tears?

videos.title: Locked Inside
videos.overview: Bapuji plays a heartfelt tune on his harmonica in memory of his old friend and gets ready to go meet him. But just as he's about to leave, he realises the main door is locked from the outside. Will he be able to get out?

videos.title: Ghar Ki Chaabi
videos.overview: With the door locked from outside, Jethalal, Tapu, and Bapuji try everything to get out of the house. But nothing seems to work. Will they manage to escape?

videos.title: Tala Kaise Tode?
videos.overview: Jethalal and his family are still locked inside, and despite everyone's efforts, no one can figure out a way to get them out. Will they be rescued in time?

videos.title: Mannu Se Mulaqat
videos.overview: After being trapped inside the house, Bapuji finally gets out and rushes to meet his childhood friend before he leaves for treatment in America. Will he reach in time?

videos.title: Bapuji’s Race Against Time
videos.overview: Bapuji is on his way to meet his old friend Mannu before he leaves for America, but a blocked road forces them to take a longer route. Will he still be able to make it on time?

videos.title: Champaklal Meets His Friend
videos.overview: Goli, Gogi, and Pinku try to protect Iyer's car, while Tapu returns with Champaklal after introducing him to his friend. Meanwhile, Jethalal learns that Champaklal has met his friend and is on his way back.

videos.title: Tala Kisne Maara?
videos.overview: Jethalal remains trapped inside his apartment, struggling to find a way out. The mystery deepens as he wonders who could have locked the door in the first place.

videos.title: Gogi's Dream Bike
videos.overview: With stars in his eyes and his heart set on his dream bike, Gogi turns to his father, Sodhi, hoping he'll make his wish come true. Will this dream ride become a reality?

videos.title: Cricket Ka Bhoot
videos.overview: Cricket fever takes over the neighbourhood as Tapu Sena gets ready to enjoy the big match. Gogi and Tapu make things more exciting with a pizza bet on their favourite teams. Who will win the bragging rights?

videos.title: Rocky's Surprise
videos.overview: Tapu Sena heads to their favourite pizza place for a fun evening, but Goli surprises them with news about their childhood friend Rocky. What surprise does Rocky have in store for him?

videos.title: Raato Raat Ameeri
videos.overview: Gogi gets tempted when Rocky introduces him to fantasy cricket with promises of quick money. With his dream bike in sight, will Gogi give in?

videos.title: Gogi Opens A Bank Account
videos.overview: Gogi visits the bank to open a new account when Popatlal unexpectedly finds his Aadhar card there. Sensing something suspicious, Popatlal immediately calls Sodhi. Will Gogi get caught?

videos.title: Gogi Ko Hua Munafa
videos.overview: Gogi is thrilled after earning money through a fantasy cricket app. But will this excitement turn into an obsession?

videos.title: Gogi Ki Nayi Bike
videos.overview: Gogi is over the moon after winning big on the fantasy cricket app and finally getting his dream bike. But with success coming so easily, will he be able to stop himself before it turns into an obsession?

videos.title: Gogi Needs Money
videos.overview: As the cricket season nears its end, Gogi feels the pressure to go big and cash in on one last opportunity. But with no money in hand, can he find a way to fund his dream?

videos.title: Gogi Risks It All
videos.overview: Gogi is caught between excitement and anxiety after putting in all his money on the fantasy app. With everything riding on this one game, will he walk away with his dream or face a tough reality?

videos.title: Gogi Needs More Money
videos.overview: Gogi needs more money to supplement his income and make up for his losses on the fantasy app. However, Tapu gives him a phone instead of cash. How will Tapu deal with this situation in his web of lies?

videos.title: Gogi Ka Online Course
videos.overview: Gogi finds a way to talk to Sonu and asks her for money. Later, he approaches Pinku with the same request. Will Gogi manage to recover his money?

videos.title: Gogi's Web Of Lies
videos.overview: Desperate to win big, Gogi lies to Popatlal and borrows ten thousand rupees. With mounting debts and tangled lies, will Gogi be able to escape the trouble he has created for himself?

videos.title: Gogi Ko Hua Loss
videos.overview: Gogi is stressed as he can't make the profit he needs to pay back his loans. With pressure building from all sides, will he find a way out?

videos.title: Gogi In Big Trouble
videos.overview: After suffering a major loss on the fantasy app, Gogi finds himself drowning in debt. Will he come clean or dig himself deeper into trouble?

videos.title: Gogi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Gogi goes missing, leaving his family and neighbours shocked as they realise he borrowed money from all of them using different excuses. Will they track him down and confront him?

videos.title: Gogi Ki Talash
videos.overview: Tapu Sena, Popatlal, and Sodhi search high and low for Gogi, who has vanished along with the money. Their hunt leads them to Rocky's parents. Where is Gogi?

videos.title: Sodhi's Vow
videos.overview: Rita Reporter arrives at the society to broadcast the news, hoping it reaches Gogi. Hearing this, Sodhi vows not to eat or drink until Gogi returns. Will their efforts lead to Gogi's return?

videos.title: Finding Gogi
videos.overview: Everyone is worried because Gogi is nowhere to be found, and Tapu Sena is going wild trying to locate him. Will they find him safe and sound?

videos.title: Gogi Comes Clean
videos.overview: Gogi gathers his friends and family to confess everything about why he took money from them. Will they understand his reasons or be too hurt to forgive him?

videos.title: Bhide Pe Aarop
