videos.overview: As Bhide prepares for a day out with his wife, Popatlal unexpectedly calls for a meeting and accuses him of something serious. What has triggered Popatlal's anger this time?

videos.title: Bhide Ke Khilaaf Saboot
videos.overview: With the entire colony watching, Popatlal urges Bhide to open a sealed box he claims contains proof of wrongdoing. Will Bhide be able to defend himself?

videos.title: Defective Samaan
videos.overview: Babita confronts Jethalal after getting an electric shock from a faulty appliance she bought from him. As more complaints start pouring in, Jethalal is left scrambling to understand what's causing the issue.

videos.title: Gokuldham Members Ko Laga Shock
videos.overview: The Gokuldham residents panic after an electric shock incident and rush to turn off the main switch, only to realize the keys are missing. With no other option, they call Bhide for help.

videos.title: Meter Box Ki Chaabi Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: The entire colony gathers to play table tennis while waiting for Bhide to return with the keys. Will he have them so the electricity can finally be restored?

videos.title: Bhide Ki Galti
videos.overview: Abdul comes out and informs everyone that he doesn't have the keys and that the electrician has them. This angers the colony members, who blame Bhide for the mishap. Will Bhide be able to find a solution?

videos.title: Bhootnaath Kidhar Hai?
videos.overview: The colony members are relieved to have electricity restored after a stressful period. However, Bhide and Popatlal remain worried, as Bhootnath has not responded or provided any update on the renovation.

videos.title: Sonu's Special Dinner
videos.overview: Sonu prepares a special dinner for Bhide and invites all her friends to join. Later, Bhide learns that a new family will soon be moving into Gokuldham Colony. Who could they be?

videos.title: Waiting For The New Family
videos.overview: All the colony members are excited about the new family moving in, but there's also a hint of concern about whether they'll get along. Who will their new neighbours be?

videos.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Swagat
videos.overview: The society eagerly prepares to welcome a new member. However, later, Bhoothnath arrives with shocking news that changes everything.

videos.title: Nakli Customer
videos.overview: Bapuji and Tapu urge Jethalal to bring Daya back from Gujarat. Meanwhile, Baawri surprises everyone by bringing customers to the shop and serving breakfast to Baagha. Will the customers make big purchases?

videos.title: Himalaya Trip
videos.overview: Jethalal breathes a sigh of relief when he learns there is no complaint against him. Instead, the association is planning a trip to the Himalayas. How will Jethalal react to this unexpected news?

videos.title: Trip Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: As Jethalal begins planning for his Himalayan trip, several colony members show interest in joining him. Meanwhile, he starts preparing Bapuji to manage the shop in his absence. Will everything fall into place?

videos.title: Paiso Ki Baarish
videos.overview: Investment fever grips Gokuldham Society as everyone looks for smart ways to grow their money. Later, Taarak is added to an exclusive investment group claiming to have top analysts. Will he be tempted to join in?

videos.title: Taarak Runs Late
videos.overview: Taarak is thrilled by the promising investment group, especially after spotting some well-known names. But in the excitement, he loses track of time and gets late for work. Will he make it on time and share the opportunity with his boss?

videos.title: Taarak Invests Money
videos.overview: Taarak advises his boss to invest, making an investment himself as well. Later, Jethalal turns to Taarak for guidance on the same opportunity. But is it all too good to be true or just a scam in disguise?

videos.title: Gokuldham Colony Invests Money
videos.overview: After hearing Taarak, everyone in Gokuldham Colony invests in the app. But will this investment bring them gains or is it all just a scam?

videos.title: Investment Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Everyone in the colony is excited about their new investment, but Bapuji advises Jethalal to wait until the profits actually reach his account. What will Jethalal discover when he finally tries to withdraw the money?

videos.title: Investment Meeting
videos.overview: The colony members get excited about earning big and gear up for a major investment meeting at night. With high hopes and big dreams, will everything go as planned or will there be a twist?

videos.title: Bumper Munafa Fund
videos.overview: Excitement runs high in the colony as everyone invests heavily after a successful meeting, dreaming of massive returns within a year. But is this golden opportunity too good to be true?

videos.title: Investment Ki Excitement
videos.overview: The colony is buzzing with excitement as the moment arrives to check the returns on their big investment. Everyone is sure they've struck gold, but will the outcome match their expectations?

videos.title: Paiso Ki Baarish Group Mein Error
videos.overview: After spotting an error on the website and in the group, panic spreads among the society members - and even Taarak's boss grows anxious. With no other option, they turn to Inspector Pandey for help.

videos.title: Gokuldham Mein Fraud
videos.overview: Panic sets in across the colony as the residents realise they've fallen victim to a massive fraud. All their investments are gone. How will they cope with this shock and find a way forward?

videos.title: Cyber Dhokha
videos.overview: The colony is gripped with panic after discovering their entire investment has vanished. With the cyber crime unit offering no certainty of justice, can they find a way to recover their lost money?

videos.title: Police Ne Di Good News
videos.overview: As panic takes over the society, the police deliver surprising news that the matter has been resolved. How will the members react to this?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Chamatkar
videos.overview: Popatlal surprises everyone as he reveals how he cracked the cyber fraud case with his sharp thinking and courage.

videos.title: Popatlal In Dhumtara
videos.overview: With the scammers' location finally known, Popatlal gears up in disguise to take them down. Will he be able to break open the fraud ring?

videos.title: Gokuldham Wasiyo Ke Liye Seekh
videos.overview: Popatlal emerges as a hero after exposing the scam and assuring everyone their money will be returned. Later, the society members apologize to Taarak.

videos.title: Popatlal Ko Mila Award
videos.overview: While the colony celebrates Popatlal receiving a prestigious government award, Taarak's boss finds himself in trouble when a guest complains about paranormal activity in his bungalow.

videos.title: Taarak's Leave Application
videos.overview: Taarak asks his boss for a leave, but the boss says he needs time to decide. With strange happenings in his haunted house, will the boss grant the leave?

videos.title: Boss Se Mulaqat
videos.overview: Taarak is invited to his boss's home for more than just a visit. A strange mystery has taken over the house, and his boss needs help. With his guest in fear, will Taarak step into this eerie situation?

videos.title: Bungalow Mein Picnic
videos.overview: Taarak is asked by his boss to stay at the bungalow for three days without coming back early. While Taarak doesn't know the real reason, his boss hopes to uncover a ghostly mystery. But the colony members want to come too. Will the boss allow it?

videos.title: Picnic Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: The colony is thrilled about a three-day picnic at Taarak's boss' bungalow. But will it be all fun and games, or will something spooky turn the trip upside down?

videos.title: Gokuldham Waalo Ki Picnic
videos.overview: Tapu Sena looks forward to the picnic as the rest of Gokuldham packs their bags. Will this getaway bring new memories for everyone?

videos.title: Bus Mein Masti
videos.overview: With bags packed and spirits high, the colony sets off for their bungalow picnic. But what twists will their road trip take?

videos.title: Bhoot Bangle Mein Picnic
videos.overview: All the colony members finally arrive at the bungalow, excited for three days of fun and relaxation. But will their getaway turn spooky, just as Taarak's boss had suspected?

videos.title: Masti Ka Mood On
videos.overview: The colony members settle into the bungalow and begin their picnic as they start to relax. But just as they get comfortable, will something spooky disrupt their fun?

videos.title: Chakori Se Mulaqat
videos.overview: While everyone is busy having fun at the bungalow, Popatlal strays into the jungle and runs into a mysterious woman named Chakori. Who is she and why is she there?

videos.title: Raat Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: As the colony members enjoy their time at the bungalow, Chakori waits patiently for night to fall. Will she end up spooking everyone once darkness sets in?

videos.title: Bhide Ka Darr
videos.overview: Bhide is terrified after spotting Chakori on the terrace. Later, while everyone relaxes by the pool, he sees a shadow again. Will anyone believe what he saw?

videos.title: Popatlal And Chakori's Friendship
videos.overview: Popatlal is drawn to Chakori and keeps going back to the well, brushing off everyone's concerns. Will his stubbornness cost him dearly?

videos.title: Last Day In The Bungalow
videos.overview: As everyone enjoys games on their last day at the bungalow, they warn Popatlal to stay away from the well. But will he ignore them once again and go to meet Chakori one last time?

videos.title: Bangle Mein Party Sharty
videos.overview: It's the final night at the bungalow and the men are all set to party. But with Chakori lurking nearby and Popatlal hoping for a last meeting, will the night turn from fun to fear?

videos.title: Chakori Ke Saamne Bhide
videos.overview: As the men wrap up their party session and head to bed, Bhide unexpectedly comes face to face with Chakori. Alone and startled, what will the mysterious spirit do to him?

videos.title: Bhootiya Raat
videos.overview: Bhide spends a spooky night with Chakori, but when he shares his experience, no one believes him and blames it on the effects of the party. Will Chakori make another move?

videos.title: Popatlal's Plan To Meet Chakori
videos.overview: On the final day of the trip, Popatlal eagerly plans to propose to Chakori. But will he get to meet her, or will there be a twist in his path?

videos.title: Chakori Se Hua Pyaar
videos.overview: Popatlal has completely fallen for Chakori and is eager to express his feelings to her. But how will his friends react when they finally come face to face with Chakori and learn about his love?

videos.title: Pyaar Mein Lattu Popatlal
videos.overview: Popatlal is deeply in love with Chakori and feels hurt when Bhide calls her a "Bhootni," causing Chakori to leave in anger. Will Bhide be able to explain his spooky encounter and make the others believe him?

videos.title: Bhide's Spooky Night
videos.overview: Popatlal is desperate to ask Chakori for forgiveness and make amends. Meanwhile, Bhide tries to explain his spooky night with Chakori to everyone. Will they believe his side of the story?

videos.title: Toota Popatlal Ka Dil
videos.overview: When the caretaker finally confirms that Chakori is a ghost, Popatlal is left stunned and heartbroken. Will he be able to accept this chilling reality?

videos.title: Bangle Mein Fase Gokuldham Wale
videos.overview: The colony members decide to leave after learning about the ghost and the spooky events. But will they actually manage to escape?

videos.title: Gokuldham Residents Get Stuck
videos.overview: The bus meant to pick up the Gokuldham residents doesn't arrive as Chakori had it stopped. Anjali takes charge and calls Taarak's boss. Will they find a way out of the bungalow?

videos.title: Chakori Ka Saamna
videos.overview: As the colony members get stuck inside the bungalow, Chakori begins to spook them with her antics. How will they handle this eerie night?

videos.title: Chakori Ki Chetavni
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members face Chakori, who terrifies them with a strong warning to leave. Will they be able to make it out safely?

videos.title: Bhootni Ke Saath Shaadi
videos.overview: Popatlal lands in deep trouble when Chakori forces him to marry her. How will he escape this situation?

videos.title: Chakori Ki Asliyat
videos.overview: Chakori traps Popatlal and forces him into marriage, leaving the colony members worried. Will they save him before it's too late?

videos.title: Chakori Ka Khel Khatam
videos.overview: Chakori finally admits she is not a ghost, leaving everyone stunned. What shocking secret will she reveal next?

videos.title: The Real Culprit
videos.overview: Taarak's boss apologises to the Gokuldham members for all the trouble. Later, Popatlal exposes the real mastermind behind Chakori's secret.

videos.title: Jethalal Returns From His Trip
videos.overview: Jethalal returns from his Himalayan trip and plans to surprise the Gokuldham residents who are having fun at the bungalow.

videos.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: The colony feels lively as repairs finish, and everyone eagerly waits for a new family to move in. But will this new beginning bring joy or unexpected challenges for them?

videos.title: Bawri Bani Customer
videos.overview: Jethalal gets irritated when Bawri comes to the shop as a customer looking to buy a toaster. Will Jethalal sell her the toaster?

videos.title: Payment Mein Gadbadi
videos.overview: Jethalal finds himself in a financial crunch as delayed payments prevent him from restocking electronics. Can he arrange the funds in time?

videos.title: Pachchis Lakh Ki Galti
videos.overview: Jethalal is stunned after learning he transferred 25 lakhs to the wrong person. Can he recover the amount before it's too late?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Atke Hue Payments
videos.overview: Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha split the contacts among themselves and decide to follow up on the pending payments. Will Jethalal be able to find a solution to recover the dues and pay it ahead?

videos.title: Tension Mein Jethalal
videos.overview: Jethalal receives a warning that he'll be blacklisted if his dues aren't cleared soon. With mounting pressure, can he find a way out in time?

videos.title: Asli Parivaar
videos.overview: Champaklal senses Jethalal's worries and confronts him about it. Later, the entire Gokuldham Colony comes together to support him. Will Jethalal be able to pay off Toni Company now?

videos.title: Paiso Ka Bandobast
videos.overview: With blacklisting looming, Bawri becomes Jethalal's unlikely saviour by helping him arrange the much-needed funds. How will Jethalal react to this?

videos.title: Jethalal Wants His Money Back
videos.overview: Jethalal is desperate to get back the money he mistakenly transferred, but the man who owes him keeps dodging him. Will Jethalal manage to retrieve it?

videos.title: Jethalal Mila Wakeel Se
videos.overview: Frustrated after repeated failures to recover his money, Jethalal finally consults a lawyer. Will the legal route give him the breakthrough he needs?

videos.title: Jethalal Feels Helpless
videos.overview: Jethalal fears his case could drag on for years, while Taarak is stressed by his boss's constant calls. Will Jethalal find a way to recover his money?

videos.title: Celebrating 17 Years Of Endless Laughter
videos.overview: It's celebration time in Gokuldham as Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah completes 17 delightful years. Amidst the joy, Jethalal finds himself cornered when Bapuji begins probing about the money. Will he dodge the question or confess?

videos.title: Paiso Ki Firauti
videos.overview: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about recovering the money, but later tells the truth to his friends. Will they come up with a plan to help him get it back?

videos.title: Mission Vasooli
videos.overview: Jethalal and his friends take matters into their own hands and show up disguised as goons to recover the lost money. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Nekchand Ko Mili Dhamki
videos.overview: In a desperate attempt to recover his money, Jethalal and his friends disguise themselves as local goons and confront Nekchand at his house. Will their dramatic plan finally pay off?

videos.title: Musibat Mein Jethalal And Friends
videos.overview: Jethalal and his friends' risky act of dressing up as goons takes a wild turn when Inspector Pandey unexpectedly lands up at Nekchand's house. Can they wriggle their way out of this mess?

videos.title: Champaklal Aur Tapu Ki Koshish
videos.overview: Nekchand firmly tells his wife that he has no intention of returning Jethalal's money. Meanwhile, Champaklal and Tapu decide to confront Nekchand together. Will they be able to make him change his mind?

videos.title: Tapu Ka Naya Idea
videos.overview: Tapu and Bapuji return disappointed after failing to get the money back from Nekchand. But Tapu isn't ready to give up just yet. Will his new idea finally turn things around?

videos.title: Trapping Nekchand
videos.overview: To get back at Nekchand, Babita and Iyer pretend to be real estate agents offering a golden deal. Will Nekchand fall for the bait or outsmart them once again?

videos.title: Jaal Mein Fasa Nekchand
videos.overview: Babita and Iyer's plan works, and Nekchand shows interest in the property. However, he wants to visit it immediately. Will Babita and Iyer manage to arrange it in time?

videos.title: Popatlal Bana Pyarelal
videos.overview: Popatlal panics when his wig, crucial to his Pyarelal disguise, goes missing just before meeting Nekchand. Will he be able to manage without getting caught?

videos.title: Token Ke Liye Taiyyar Nekchand
videos.overview: After much convincing and clever acting, Nekchand finally agrees to pay the token. Will the plan go through as expected?

videos.title: Nekchand Aaya Gokuldham
videos.overview: The Gokuldham residents prepare all the documents to present to Nekchand. But when he arrives, will he hand over the token money or will a new problem arise?

videos.title: Nekchand Ko Mila Sabak
videos.overview: Nekchand's greed backfires as the Gokuldham residents manage to extract the money from him. What will his reaction be?

videos.title: Nekchand Ko Lautaye Paise
videos.overview: Bapuji's sudden decision to return the money to Nekchand leaves the entire society in shock. The members cannot understand why he would make such a choice. Will they question him?

videos.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: Excitement fills the colony as Verma Ji tells Bhide about a new family moving in. Will the neighbours welcome them warmly or face unexpected surprises?

videos.title: Bhootnath Ka Badla
videos.overview: Bhootnath takes away the flat keys and says the new family cannot enter until his bills are paid. Will he change his mind and return the keys?

videos.title: Kab Aayenge Naye Padosi?
videos.overview: Bhide and the colony members are excited to welcome the new family and have prepared for their arrival. But as the wait gets longer, everyone wonders when they will finally reach the colony.

videos.title: Naye Parivar Ka Tempo
videos.overview: Bhide has to step out for work but fears that the new family might arrive in his absence. Just then, an unknown tempo enters Gokuldham. How will Bhide handle the situation?

videos.title: Naye Parivaar Ka Swagat
videos.overview: The colony members prepare to welcome the new family, unaware that two tricksters are plotting to steal the tempo filled with their belongings. Will the plan get exposed?

videos.title: Gokuldham's Newest Members
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members cannot believe their eyes as camels walk into their neighbourhood. The new family arrives in style, leaving everyone curious and surprised about their grand entry.

videos.title: Meet The Binjolas
videos.overview: The society gives a warm welcome to Ratan, Rupa and their family, but the big question remains. Will they blend into the colony life with ease or will trouble make its way to their new beginning?

videos.title: Tempo Ki Chori
videos.overview: As the new family settles into the colony, they are shocked to learn that their tempo filled with belongings has gone missing. How will the family handle this unexpected crisis?

videos.title: Pandey Ji To The Rescue
videos.overview: With panic spreading in the colony after the missing tempo, the society members call upon Inspector Pandey. Will he be able to crack the case and bring relief to everyone?

videos.title: Bhide Is Blamed
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey arrives in Gokuldham to investigate the missing tempo, but the driver shifts the blame onto Bhide. Will Inspector Pandey uncover the real culprit?

videos.title: Bhide Se Poochtach
videos.overview: The new family cannot step into their home because their tempo is missing, and as the situation turns tense, Inspector Pandey begins questioning Bhide and Madhvi to find out what really happened.

videos.title: Tempo Ki Khoj
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey joins hands with the colony members to trace the missing tempo. But will their search finally lead them to a solid clue?

videos.title: Ek Tempo Do Number
videos.overview: The colony joins Inspector Pandey to track down the missing tempo. Excitement turns into shock when the tempo they find isn't the right one. Now, with time slipping away, will they be able to locate their belongings?

videos.title: Tempo Chor Faraar
videos.overview: The thieves go on the run after the media exposes the stolen tempo. Now the pressure is on as the colony and Inspector Pandey try to catch them before they disappear.

videos.title: Tempo Chor Ka Mila Pata
videos.overview: The colony members rejoice when they hear that the tempo thieves have taken the vehicle to Sodhi's garage for repairs. But the big question remains, will they finally be able to catch them this time?

videos.title: Sodhi Ka Smart Mechanic
videos.overview: When the colony members reach Sodhi's garage, they are shocked to see the mechanic tied up while the thieves are nowhere to be seen. How will they track down the culprits now?

videos.title: Choro Ka Peecha
videos.overview: The thieves manage to trick the colony members and escape once again. Now Inspector Pandey and the Gokuldham residents join forces for the chase. But will they be fast enough to catch them this time?

videos.title: Last Chance For The Binjolas
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey and the Gokuldham members corner the thieves from all directions, leaving no room for escape. Will the Binjolas reclaim what was stolen from them?

videos.title: Tapu Ne Lagaya Brilliant Idea
videos.overview: Tapu comes up with a smart idea to trace the thieves, and the colony pins all their hopes on him. Will this plan finally work or will the culprits escape yet again?

videos.title: Tempo Aane Ki Khushi
videos.overview: The pressure mounts on Inspector Pandey as the tempo thieves bluff him and escape. Later, he surprises everyone by bringing the tempo back to the society. How did Inspector Pandey manage to catch the thieves?

videos.title: Warm Welcome To The Binjolas
videos.overview: With the tempo recovered and belongings restored, the new family finally settles in. The Gokuldham members gather together to give them a heartfelt welcome, marking a fresh start in the colony.

videos.title: Ganesh Utsav Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: As the Binjolas settle into the society, Bhide and the others begin planning for Ganesh Utsav while Tapu Sena takes charge of the preparations. What new adventure will this celebration bring?

videos.title: New Family's Request
videos.overview: The new family begins their journey in Gokuldham colony and on Ganesh Utsav they make a heartfelt request to Bhide. Will the colony members come together to make it happen?

videos.title: Gokuldham Ke Bappa
videos.overview: Gokuldham Colony comes alive with festive decorations and joy as the society prepares to welcome Bappa. Later, Tapu Sena steps in and lays down a set of rules before everyone.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ke Niyam
videos.overview: The colony members warmly embrace the new rules set by Tapu Sena and begin putting them into practice. Later, the Binjola kids lay down a condition before anyone can relish the prasad. What could it be?

videos.title: Bachho Ki Zidd
videos.overview: The Binjola kids refuse to let anyone eat the prasad until Bappa is offered his share first. As their demand starts getting out of hand, how will the colony members handle the situation?

videos.title: Ratan Aur Rupa Ki Badhti Pareshani
videos.overview: Tensions rise as devotees begin complaining about not receiving the prasad. Later, Bhide is called in to resolve the matter. How will Gokuldham Society handle this situation?

videos.title: Champaklal Ki Koshish
videos.overview: Champaklal tries to convince the children to eat and drop their stubbornness. But just then, another problem arises. How will the society handle it?

videos.title: Tapu Ka Idea
videos.overview: The colony members eagerly wait for Tapu's idea to unfold so they can begin the Rangarang Program. During the aarti, the plan is set into motion. But will it be enough to convince the kids?

videos.title: Bachho Ki Aastha
videos.overview: Veer and Bansri are deeply heartbroken after learning what the colony members have done. As the society leaves everything in Bappa's hands, how will the children be convinced?

videos.title: Bappa Meets The Kids
videos.overview: Moved by the devotion of Veer and Bansri, Lord Ganesh himself appears before them and assures them that he has accepted their laddoos. Later, the children gather everyone in the society compound.

videos.title: Prayers And Prasad
videos.overview: All the members offer their prayers and prasad before Bappa. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena takes on the task of distributing the prasad to those whose names are on the list.

videos.title: Rangaram Karyakaram
videos.overview: As the Rangarang program begins, the members offer a heartfelt Ganesh Vandana in different languages and celebrate the event with joy.

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ki Performance
videos.overview: Taarak recites a poetry and after the elders, it is now time for the Tapu Sena to perform. Will everyone enjoy their act?

videos.title: Surprise Birthday Plan For Pinku
videos.overview: Tapu Sena puts together a surprise birthday plan for Pinku, but Iyer walks in unexpectedly. Will their surprise still work out as planned?

videos.title: Pinku Ka Birthday
videos.overview: Tapu Sena informs Bhide and the society members about Pinku's surprise birthday. As everyone gathers at the clubhouse, will Pinku arrive to be surprised?

videos.title: Kaha Hai Pinku?
videos.overview: The society members gather in the clubhouse and celebrate while waiting for Pinku. Just then, Gogi reveals that Pinku is not at home. Where could he be?

videos.title: Veer Aur Bansri Ke Tuition Classes
videos.overview: Tapu Sena learns the traditional steps of Garba, while Veer and Bansri head to Bhide's house for tuition. Will the class go smoothly?

videos.title: Sonu's New Wall Paint
videos.overview: Sonu scrapes the wall paint while cleaning before her friend's visit. How will Bhide react, and will he agree to get it repainted?

videos.title: Bhide Seeks Jethalal's Help
videos.overview: Disguised as a customer, a man tries to steal from Jethalal's shop but Bagha catches him. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal for help in buying wall paints.

videos.title: Bhide Ka Confidence
videos.overview: Bhide confidently assures Madhvi and Sonu that he will paint Sonu's room himself. But how will it actually turn out?

videos.title: Bhide Looks For A Painter
videos.overview: Madhvi and Sonu clean up the mess made by Bhide and ask him to give up on painting Sonu's room himself. Later, Bhide starts looking for a painter.

videos.title: Painter Arrives At Bhide's House
videos.overview: A Lucknowi painter arrives at Bhide's house to paint Sonu's room. Will he be of help or bring more trouble for the Bhide family?

videos.title: Naya Painter
videos.overview: Bhide hires a new painter for Sonu's room, but the painter dozes off before starting the work. How will Bhide get the room painted?

videos.title: Room Painting Ki Tension
videos.overview: Tapu Sena decides to help paint Sonu's room while Sonu considers cancelling her plan of calling her friend home. Later, Madhvi comes up with a solution. What is it?

videos.title: Bhide Family Ki Khushi
videos.overview: As Sonu's room gets painted with Asian Paints, Bhide and Madhvi decide to give their entire house a fresh new look. While the painting is underway, the Bhide family enjoys some much-needed relaxation time.

videos.title: Gada Electronics Ki Nayi Scheme
videos.overview: Bagha and Nattu Kaka excitedly wait to show Jethalal the new banner outside the shop. But will Jethalal appreciate their effort or end up scolding them instead?

videos.title: Garba Ki Taiyyari
videos.overview: Jethalal and the others enjoy practising garba in the shop, while the Mahila Mandal excitedly plans the upcoming Navratri celebrations. What surprises and fun moments await the Gokuldham residents this festive season?

videos.title: Roopa Aur Ratan Ka Surprise
videos.overview: Ratan and Roopa go missing on the first day of Navratri, leaving everyone in the society worried and curious. Just as the celebration begins to feel incomplete, they arrive with a big surprise that leaves everyone stunned. What could it be?

videos.title: Garba With A Twist
videos.overview: Tapu Sena and the other members decorate the clubhouse beautifully for the Garba celebrations. As everyone gathers to play, who will steal the spotlight on the dance floor?

videos.title: Garba Competition
videos.overview: The Garba competition heats up as the members showcase their best moves and festive spirit. Who will emerge as the star performer?

videos.title: Garba Ki Takkar
videos.overview: The Garba competition continues in full swing as everyone showcases their best moves. Later, the winners are honored with a beautiful winning garland.

videos.title: Taarak Gets Scolded
videos.overview: Anjali scolds Taarak for eating outside food while she has prepared a healthy salad for him at home. How will Taarak manage to get out of this tricky situation?

videos.title: Taarak Ka Badhta Weight
videos.overview: Anjali takes Dr. Hathi's advice to help Taarak reduce his weight. Later, the men of Gokuldham discuss Taarak's diet and fitness plan in their own amusing way as they try to come up with a plan to convince Anjali.

videos.title: Taarak Ka Khaana
videos.overview: Taarak and his friends brainstorm ways to escape his healthy tiffin. Later, Jethalal deals with an unusual customer at his shop.

videos.title: Taarak Ki Peedha
videos.overview: As Taarak gets ready to enjoy the delicious food sent by Jethalal, Anjali suddenly arrives at his office. Will Taarak get caught or manage to escape the situation?

videos.title: Sunday Funday For Taarak
videos.overview: All the men of the colony come together to secretly make Sunday a fun day for Taarak by getting him all his favourite food behind Anjali's back. Will their plan succeed?

videos.title: Mission Masaledaar
videos.overview: While Anjali visits Ratan and Roopa's house to prepare diet food, Jethalal and the others continue their Mission Masaledaar to help Taarak. Will their plan succeed?

videos.title: Anjali Catches Hold Of Taarak
videos.overview: Bhide tries to distract Anjali so that Taarak's food can be delivered. But just then, Anjali walks in while the delivery is taking place. Will Mission Masaledaar succeed or end in trouble?

videos.title: Punishment For Taarak And Friends
videos.overview: Taarak tries to win Anjali's forgiveness with a heartfelt poem. Later, Anjali agrees to stay but sets a condition to punish Taarak and his friends. What will her punishment be?

videos.title: Veer And Bansri Ki Shararat
videos.overview: Veer and Bansri get scolded for bursting crackers in the society compound. Later, the members of Gokuldham society gear up to celebrate the festival of lights with great joy and excitement.

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Ghar Ki Laxmi
videos.overview: A woman named Rambha arrives at Gokuldham Society to meet Popatlal. Could she finally be the girl of Popatlal's dreams?

videos.title: Laddoo Ka Box
videos.overview: Babita and Iyer give a box of laddoos to the Bhides, the same one that has been secretly circling around the society. When Bhide passes it on to the Sodhi family, will the laddoo box finally find its rightful owner again?

videos.title: One Box Across The Society
videos.overview: To track down his laddoo box, Popatlal first asks Taarak and then the other members continue questioning each other in the society. Will he discover that his box has been passed around the entire neighbourhood?

videos.title: Popatlal Ka Jadoo
videos.overview: Everyone gathers in the clubhouse, hoping the laddoo box will finally be found. Later, Popatlal performs a magic trick that leaves the members stunned. How will they react to this unexpected surprise?

videos.title: Binjola Parivaar Ki Meeting
videos.overview: On Babita's request, Iyer offers to drop Jethalal to the office, but his car refuses to start. Later, the entire Binjola family gathers for an important discussion. What big matter are they about to reveal?

videos.title: Scooter Ka Naamkaran
videos.overview: The Binjolas invite Batuk Maharaj to help them name their new scooter. With everyone pitching in ideas, will they finally settle on the perfect name?

videos.title: Feku Gada
videos.overview: Champaklal's friends tease him for not donating to the old-age home. Feeling upset, he later talks to Tapu about it. How will Champaklal handle the situation?

videos.title: Vridhashram Ka Cheque
videos.overview: Jethalal deals with a new set of customers at his shop, while Taarak reminds him about handing over the cheque to the old age home. Will Jethalal finally complete the task this time, or will fresh hurdles come his way again?

videos.title: Struggle To Get A Cheque
videos.overview: Jethalal visits the bank to request a new cheque book and later sits down to prepare the cheque. But is another hurdle waiting to stop him this time?

videos.title: Receipt Kaha Hai?
videos.overview: Jethalal loses the receipt for a payment and panics, knowing he already told Bapuji it was done. Will he find a way out of this mess?

videos.title: Finding The Receipt
videos.overview: After losing the receipt, Jethalal hides from Champaklal in the society and tries to contact the auto driver, hoping he might have left it there. Will Jethalal be able to find the missing receipt?

videos.title: Jethalal Aur Taarak Ka Struggle
videos.overview: Jethalal pins his hopes on Iyer to find the missing receipt, while Champaklal keeps calling to ask about it. Later, he calls Bagha and Nattu Kaka but none of them respond. Will he find the receipt?

videos.title: The Lost Receipt
videos.overview: Jethalal rushes to his shop to search for the missing receipt but ends up having to pay a fine along the way. With Champaklal calling him repeatedly, how will Jethalal explain the situation about the lost receipt?

videos.title: Nakli Receipt
videos.overview: Tapu comes up with a plan to help Jethalal by creating a fake receipt and asks him to show it to Champaklal. But will Champaklal see through their plan?

videos.title: Jethalal Ki Chori Pakdi Gayi
videos.overview: Nattu Kaka and Bagha arrive just in time to hand over another fake receipt to Champaklal, exposing Jethalal and Tapu's lie. How will Jethalal face Champaklal's anger now?

videos.title: Champaklal Ne Sunai Saza
videos.overview: Champaklal decides to punish Jethalal and Tapu by announcing that he's leaving for Bhachau. Later, Rupa arrives with food for the Gada family.

videos.title: Tapu Aur Goli Ka Zabardast Challenge
videos.overview: While Tapu Sena enjoys a game of cricket, Veer and Bansri provoke Goli against Tapu, leading him to challenge Tapu. Who will emerge victorious?

videos.title: Mahila Mandal Plays Cricket
videos.overview: Bhide and Goli collide, causing Tapu's catch to be dropped and the challenge to be lost. Later, the Mahila Mandal decides to join in and play cricket.

videos.title: Bhide Ka Gussa
videos.overview: Madhavi and Babita accidentally break the glass of their own house while playing cricket, leaving everyone worried about Bhide's reaction. Meanwhile, Bhide learns about the incident and assumes Tapu is behind it. How will the misunderstanding unfold?

videos.title: Bhide Fights With Jethalal
videos.overview: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight regarding Tapu and the broken glass, and only Inspector Pandey can control the chaos. Will they resolve the case or confuse Pandey even more?

videos.title: Bhide And Jethalal Present Their Sides
videos.overview: Bhide and Iyer put their side of the story before Inspector Pandey, and Jethalal explains his as well. Soon after, the Mahila Mandal arrives at the police station. Will Madhavi and Babita admit what really happened?

videos.title: Iyer And Bhide Apologise
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal finally admit that they were the ones who broke the window glass, clearing Tapu of all blame. With the truth out, Bhide and Iyer are left embarrassed and now must find a sincere way to apologise to Jethalal.

videos.title: Popatlal Runs After Bhide
videos.overview: Bhide grows tense as he struggles to find someone to fix the broken glass. Later, Popatlal snaps at him and chases him around the society. What caused his outburst?

videos.title: Abdul Ka Surprise
videos.overview: Bhide gives Abdul a lesson on saving water. Later, at the shop, Abdul tells everyone he has a surprise waiting for them. What could it be?

videos.title: Abdul Ki Cycle
videos.overview: Abdul celebrates with everyone in the society as he completes 500 days with his cycle. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call to interview a high profile criminal who is about to be released from jail.

videos.title: Chunnilal Ki Cycle
videos.overview: Popatlal meets Chunnilal Talatode outside the jail to take his interview. Later, Chunnilal enquires about his lucky cycle which happens to be with Abdul. How will this turn out?

videos.title: Planning To Bring The Cycle
videos.overview: Chunnilal tries to buy the cycle from Abdul but flees the moment he spots Popatlal. Later, he hatches a plan to sneak into Gokuldham. Will he manage to reclaim his lucky cycle?

videos.title: Anmol Cycle Anmol Daam
videos.overview: Chunnilal's men offer Abdul an unusually high price for his cycle, raising suspicion. With Abdul refusing to sell, how will they try to take it now?

videos.title: Gadhe Ke Nishaan Waali Cycle
videos.overview: The society members can't stop discussing the huge offer Abdul received for his cycle. Later, they call Babu Chipke to inspect it. What will he discover?

videos.title: Cycle Ka Raaz
videos.overview: Babu Chipke assures everyone in Gokuldham that the cycle is nothing extraordinary. Still, the members grow curious and try to uncover its secret, while Chunnilal thinks of a way to snatch it.

videos.title: Cycle Ki Kundli
videos.overview: Ratan tells a story while everyone keeps wondering what's really special about the cycle. Later, Roshan suggests getting it checked by her uncle. What will they discover about the cycle now?

videos.title: Rustom Ghantiwala Ka Inspection
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members head out to meet Rustom to uncover the truth about the cycle. Meanwhile, Chunnilal makes his plan to reclaim it. What happens when their paths collide?

videos.title: Cycle Se Emotional Attachment
videos.overview: While Champaklal raises a solid point about the cycle, Chunnilal Talatode arrives in Gokuldham disguised as Dinesh Ghoda. What is he plotting now?

videos.title: Popatlal Ki Condition
videos.overview: Just as Chunnilal is about to take the cycle out of the society he runs into Popatlal. Popatlal lays down a condition before he will allow Chunnilal to take it. What will Chunnilal do?

videos.title: Protecting The Cycle
videos.overview: Suspicion around the cycle keeps growing in the society, and everyone tries to protect it. Meanwhile, Chunnilal comes up with a new plan to steal it. What happens next?

videos.title: Cycle Ki Chori
videos.overview: Chunnilal finally puts his plan into motion and heads to Gokuldham Colony to steal the cycle. Will the society members be able to save it in time?

videos.title: Abdul Ki Cycle Hui Chori
videos.overview: Chunnilal manages to steal the cycle, leaving Bhide and Abdul stunned. How will they get it back now?

videos.title: Tapu Sena Ki Smartness
videos.overview: Using their quick thinking, Tapu Sena swaps Abdul's cycle, leaving Chunnilal annoyed when he realises he stole the wrong one. Later, while trying to remove the mark from the cycle, they uncover something unexpected. What could it be?

videos.title: Sone Ki Cycle
videos.overview: The society members are stunned to discover that the cycle is made of gold. Will Chunnilal come up with yet another plan to steal it?

videos.title: Abdul Bana Crorepati
videos.overview: Abdul and the society celebrate his newfound fortune after discovering the gold cycle. While everyone enjoys taking a ride, Chunnilal hatches a plan to slip into Gokuldham and reclaim the cycle.

videos.title: Chunnilal Barges Into Gokuldham
videos.overview: Chunnilal storms into Gokuldham with his men and tries to take the cycle at gunpoint. How will the society deal with this threat?

videos.title: Abdul Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Chunnilal and his men kidnap Abdul and demand the gold cycle in exchange. Will the Gokuldham members give up the cycle to save him?

videos.title: Abdul Held Hostage
videos.overview: Gokuldham members come together to plan Abdul's rescue in exchange for the cycle, while Abdul remains held at a remote spot. How will they manage to bring him back safely?

videos.title: Rescuing Abdul
videos.overview: Gokuldham members head out with the cycle to rescue Abdul at the spot Chunnilal mentioned, while the rest of the society anxiously waits back home. What unfolds next?

videos.title: Chunnilal Ka Foolproof Plan
videos.overview: Chunnilal's men trick the Gokuldham members, blindfold them, and take them to an isolated location. Meanwhile, the others pray for their safety. Will the Gokuldham members outsmart Chunnilal and his gang?

videos.title: Abdul Aur Cycle Ki Adla Badli
videos.overview: Chunnilal gets the cycle and the Gokuldham members get Abdul. Before they can escape, they trick the gang. Will they manage to get away with the cycle?

videos.title: Gokuldham Ka Teamwork
videos.overview: Gokuldham celebrates Abdul's return, but curiosity grows over how Chunnilal got the gold cycle. What new secret will come to light?

videos.title: Popatlal Ko Lagi Thand
videos.overview: Abdul, Ratan and Dr Hathi discuss putting the gold cycle behind them. Later, Sodhi plays a prank on Popatlal when he complains of feeling cold.

videos.title: Importance Of Exercising
videos.overview: The Gokuldham men tease Popatlal for feeling cold. Later, Champaklal insists on taking Jethalal out for exercise. Will Jethalal agree?

videos.title: Zumba Session For Champaklal And Friends
videos.overview: Champaklal and his friends enjoy a Zumba session at the park. Meanwhile, Jethalal waits for Tapu and Champaklal to return as he needs to leave for the office. Later, one of Champaklal's friends arrives at the house and finds it locked.

videos.title: Waiting For Champaklal
videos.overview: Jethalal scolds Bagha and Nattu Kaka for calling him to work early, while Tapu keeps Nanji Kaka entertained at home as they wait for Champaklal. But where has Champaklal gone?

videos.title: Searching For Champaklal
videos.overview: Tapu Sena sets out to search for Champaklal and later informs Bhide and Popatlal. Will they be able to find him?

videos.title: Champaklal Hue Gayab
videos.overview: The search for Champaklal continues as the Gokuldham members circulate his photo and ask around about his whereabouts. Where has Champaklal gone?

videos.title: Champaklal Chadhe Pedh Par
videos.overview: Champaklal climbs a tree to help a child retrieve his kite but gets stuck. How will Tapu Sena and the others bring him down safely?

videos.title: Champaklal Ko Neeche Laane Ki Koshish
videos.overview: The entire society gathers at the park to support Champaklal and bring him food, while Tapu and Gogi look for a way to help him get down. How will they manage it?

videos.title: Bagha To The Rescue
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members devise a plan to bring Champaklal down and turn to Bagha for help. Will he find a solution?

videos.title: Snake Attack
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members bring ladders and tie them together to help Champaklal get down, but he spots a snake on the tree. How will he come down now?

videos.title: Bapuji Ko Kaise Bachaye?
videos.overview: Trapped in a tree, Bapuji faces fresh danger as a snake slithers towards him. Can the colony members rescue him in time?

videos.title: The Snake Charmer
videos.overview: Abdul calls a snake charmer to rescue Champaklal by catching the snake. But will this solution create more problems instead?

videos.title: Dadaji Ko Neeche Utaro Mission
videos.overview: Tapu calls the Dahi Handi team to help bring Champaklal down from the tree. Will this plan work?

videos.title: Another Trouble For Champaklal
videos.overview: Inspector Pandey suspects Champaklal was attempting suicide, creating another problem for him. Later, Nanji Kaka arrives to meet Champaklal. Will he learn about the tree incident?

videos.title: Yaadon Ka Pitara
videos.overview: Champaklal reminisces about his younger days with Tapu and Jethalal and recalls legendary actor Dharmendra. Later, the other members also share their memories of the late actor Dharmendra.

videos.title: Dharamaji Ki Yaadon Ki Baarat
videos.overview: In memory of the late actor Dharmendra, the Gokuldham colony celebrates New Year's Eve, joined by Sanket Gokhale.

videos.title: Quiz Show On Dharam Ji
videos.overview: The program continues with the society members dressing up as Dharmendra ji from his iconic films. Later, they come together to play a quiz based on Dharam ji and his memorable career.

videos.title: Dance And Masti Dharam Ji Style
videos.overview: The Dharam Ji celebration continues in Gokuldham as the members share interesting facts and trivia about the legendary actor, while also dancing and singing his famous songs.

videos.title: Dharam Ji Fever Continues
videos.overview: The Dharam Ji fever continues in Gokuldham as the members showcase their dancing skills. Which member will shine?

videos.title: Yaadon Ki Baraat Manaye Saath Saath
videos.overview: Tapu and Sonu steal the spotlight with their performance, followed by Taarak's heartfelt words on the legendary stardom and grace of the late actor Dharmendra.

videos.title: Naye Saal Ka Suvichaar
videos.overview: Veer and Bansari pull off a prank by writing a cryptic thought for the day and challenging everyone to decode it. Will they be able to figure it out?

videos.title: Bagha And Nattu Kaka Ki Party-Sharty
videos.overview: On the first day of the new year, Jethalal reaches his shop and finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka asleep outside the godown in an inebriated state. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha explain this situation?

videos.title: Jethalal Ke Saal Ka Pehla Din
videos.overview: Jethalal's tension spikes when Bawri turns up at the shop on the very first day of the year. Later, the new area head of Topo Mobile visits Gada Electronics with a fresh offer and scheme. How will Jethalal make the most of it?

videos.title: Topo Mobile Ki Scheme
videos.overview: Jethalal invites all the Gokuldham members to his shop to avail the scheme offered by Topo Mobiles. As everyone promises to arrive on time, will Jethalal end up facing new troubles?

videos.title: Topo Mobile Kaha Hain?
videos.overview: With renewed positivity, Jethalal heads to his shop determined to sell 50 mobile phones within two hours, but the Topo Mobile parcel is yet to arrive. Will Jethalal achieve his target?

videos.title: Topo Mobile Crisis
videos.overview: It's almost 11 am and the Topo Mobile stock has still not arrived at Gada Electronics. As chaos builds up outside the shop, how will Jethalal and his team manage the Topo Mobile crisis?

videos.title: Chaos At Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Jethalal shares his worries with the Gokuldham residents as customers continue to wait outside the shop. Later, Inspector Pandey arrives looking to buy a Topo Mobile as well. How will Jethalal manage to meet all these demands?

videos.title: Fifty Mobiles In Two Hours
videos.overview: As customers continue to pour in for Topo Mobile and time keeps slipping away, will Jethalal manage to sell 50 mobile phones within two hours?

videos.title: Topo Ka Khilona
videos.overview: As everyone begins unboxing their phones, they realise they've been given toy phones instead of real ones. Just as Jethalal celebrates his win, how will the furious customers react?

videos.title: Gada Electronics Hai Hai
videos.overview: As the crowd tries to break into Gada Electronics, Jethalal pulls the shutter down to save himself. With Inspector Pandey ready to arrest him, how will Jethalal prove his innocence?

videos.title: Kati Patang
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members chase after a kite and reminisce about their childhood memories of flying kites. Later, Rupa and the kids decide to go to Jaipur for the Patang Utsav. Will they be able to make the trip?

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Aaya Rishta
videos.overview: As Rupa decides to go to Jaipur, her maasi brings a rishta for Popatlal, revealing that Babli has set a challenge: she will marry whoever manages to cut her kite. Will Popatlal finally find his bride?

videos.title: Patang King Pohche Jaipur
videos.overview: The Gokuldham men are thrilled about Popatlal's trip to Jaipur, yet they doubt whether he will be able to cut Babli's kite. Later, Popatlal brings out his special kite, only for Veer and Bansri to tear it. How will he compete now?

videos.title: Exploring The Pink City
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members explore Jaipur as Popatlal heads out to buy a kite for his big challenge. Meanwhile, the rest of the Gokuldham men eagerly await the day of the contest.

videos.title: Popatlal Hua Taiyaar
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members enjoy a lively evening in Jaipur. Later, Popatlal gears up for his much awaited challenge with Babli.

videos.title: Patang Ka Muqabla
videos.overview: As Babli arrives for the challenge, Popatlal steps forward to meet her and the competition begins. Will Popatlal emerge victorious?

videos.title: Patang Kati Shaadi Ghati
videos.overview: As Babli continues to cut everyone's kites, Popatlal waits for 4 pm to enter the competition. Will he manage to cut Babli's kite?

videos.title: Babli Vs Popatlal
videos.overview: The competition between Babli and Popatlal intensifies as both contestants try to cut each other's kites. Who will win the contest?

videos.title: Republic Day Program Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Bhide is stopped by Inspector Pandey while returning home. Later, he grows anxious about the arrangements for the Republic Day program.

videos.title: Sundar Arrives in Gokuldham
videos.overview: Sundar travels all the way from the USA and stays back for the Republic Day program. Later, the members prepare enthusiastically for the celebrations.

videos.title: Republic Day Ka Vishesh Karyakram
videos.overview: Bhide takes on the responsibility of anchoring the Republic Day program and shares facts about India through a quiz round. How will the members perform in the game?

videos.title: Raajya Aur Unki Vishesh Baatein
videos.overview: The Gokuldham members pick chits and share interesting facts about different states. As the competition heats up, who will win the round?

videos.title: Desh Ki Baatein
videos.overview: The competition continues as they keep learning about various states. Who will emerge victorious?

videos.title: Punishment Or Pass?
videos.overview: The members continue discussing various states and their key facts. Who will answer correctly within the time limit, and who will face the punishment?

videos.title: Har Dil Mei Hindustan
videos.overview: As Popatlal waits for his chance to punish Bhide, Bhide gives the correct answer. Later, all the members come together for a dance to celebrate the country.

videos.title: Suvichaar Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Bhide struggles to write the thought for the day as Veer, Bansri, and Sodhi try to help him. Later, a couple arrives at Gada Electronics. Will they make a purchase or land Jethalal in trouble?

videos.title: Topo Company Ki Dealership
videos.overview: Jethalal grows anxious when the email confirming his dealership fails to arrive, even as news of the deal spreads everywhere. Will he be able to finally secure the dealership?

videos.title: Big Day For Jethalal
videos.overview: Excitement runs high as Jethalal prepares for a crucial meeting to finalise his authorised dealership. With everyone rooting for him, will he succeed?

videos.title: Deal Pakki
videos.overview: Jethalal is on cloud nine as he finally receives the papers confirming his dealership. But with his luck, will the deal go through smoothly or will new hurdles stand in the way?

videos.title: Bawri Ke Motichoor Laddoo
videos.overview: As Jethalal, Nattu Kaka, and Bagha celebrate securing the Topo Mobile dealership, Bawri arrives with sweets for them. What will happen once they eat them?

videos.title: Neend Mein Dooba Gada Electronics
videos.overview: Everyone at Gada Electronics struggles to stay awake after eating the laddoos just as customers walk in to shop. Later, they try eating chillies to fight the drowsiness. Will their plan succeed?

videos.title: Dukaan Mein Party Sharty
videos.overview: Jethalal waits for Babita's friend to arrive and shop while struggling to stay awake. Later, when she finally comes, she spots an alcohol bottle in Jethalal's hands. How will this misunderstanding be resolved?

videos.title: Taarak Asks For Half Day
videos.overview: Taarak tries to take leave from work to help Jethalal. Meanwhile, Champaklal wants to go to Gada Electronics to congratulate him. What will happen when he sees Jethalal in that condition?

videos.title: Stalling Champaklal's Visit
videos.overview: Anjali and Babita do everything they can to stall Champaklal's visit to Jethalal's shop. Later, Taarak turns to Bhide for help. Will they manage to keep Champaklal from reaching Gada Electronics?

videos.title: Race Against Time For Taarak
videos.overview: As Taarak struggles to find a rickshaw, Champaklal and Bhide head toward Gada Electronics. In this race against time, can Taarak get there and help Jethalal before Champaklal arrives?

videos.title: Sodhi Comes To Rescue
videos.overview: Taarak takes a U-turn after receiving a call from his boss, while Bhide does everything he can to delay Champaklal's visit. Later, Taarak turns to Sodhi for help. How will he come to Jethalal's rescue?

videos.title: Laddoo Ka Asar
videos.overview: Taarak reaches the shop and finds Ratan and Sodhi lying there in an inebriated state. Later, Dr Hathi, Popatlal, and Taarak also end up eating the laddoos. What will happen when Champaklal arrives?

videos.title: Pankaj Takes Advantage
videos.overview: Champaklal reaches the shop and finds all the men lying there, with an alcohol bottle nearby, making him assume they are drunk. Later, Pankaj, Jethalal's competitor, arrives and tries to take advantage of the situation.

videos.title: Dukaan Mein Party Sharty
videos.overview: Pankaj approaches the police and Sara from Topo Mobile, accusing Jethalal of throwing a party inside his shop. As everyone is found passed out, will Jethalal face consequences?

videos.title: Bawri Clarifies The Situation
videos.overview: Bawri rushes into the shop and reveals the truth about the sleep inducing laddoo mix up. Later, Inspector Pandey conducts a breath analyser test. Will they be found guilty?

videos.title: Alcohol Bottle Goes Missing
videos.overview: Another wave of confusion hits when the alcohol bottle goes missing, and the Mahila Mandal suspects the men have hidden it deliberately. Where could the bottle have disappeared to?

videos.title: Gokuldham Mein Neend Gayab
videos.overview: After the sleeping laddoo incident, the Gokuldham men struggle to fall asleep at night. How will they deal with this new problem?

videos.title: Night Walk For Gokuldham Men
videos.overview: Unable to sleep, the Gokuldham men head out for a late night walk. Soon, they find themselves caught in a misunderstanding with a woman. How will they clear up this fresh confusion?

videos.title: Taarak's Poem For Anjali
videos.overview: Veer and Bansri gear up with their water guns to attack Ratan and Rupa. Later, Taarak's poem ends up upsetting Anjali. How will he make things right?

videos.title: Popatlal Meets Chutki Baba
videos.overview: Ratan introduces Popatlal to Chutki Baba, claiming he can help solve his marriage woes. What will happen when Popatlal finally meets Chutki Baba?

videos.title: Chutki Baba Ka Upaay
videos.overview: Chutki Baba gives Popatlal a special remedy, promising it will help him find a bride soon. As Holika Dahan draws near, will Popatlal manage to complete the ritual in time?

videos.title: Popatlal Loses The Ring
videos.overview: Popatlal is devastated after losing the ring given to him by Chutki Baba, which he believes will finally lead him to his life partner. Will the Gokuldham members help him recover it?

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Liye Kavitayein
videos.overview: After Popatlal completes his ritual, the Gokuldham members gather to celebrate Holika Dahan with poems, games, and laughter. How will this Holika Dahan turn out for Popatlal?

videos.title: Jethalal And Babita's Face Off
videos.overview: Jethalal and Babita get into a playful Holi challenge where Jethalal must find Babita within an hour while she hides. Will Jethalal win the challenge, or will he have to face Iyer's punishment?

videos.title: Holi Ka Mahayudh
videos.overview: As Holi celebrations begin, Jethalal and Babita kick off their challenge. Will Team Jethalal manage to find Babita and win the game?

videos.title: Team Jethalal Begin Their Search
videos.overview: Team Jethalal spreads out across the colony to search for Babita. As the hunt intensifies, will they manage to find her, or will Jethalal lose the challenge?

videos.title: Search For Babita Intensifies
videos.overview: Team Jethalal intensively searches for Babita across their respective houses, while Iyer helps her stay hidden so she cannot be caught. With time running out, will Babita finally be found?

videos.title: Searching The Clubhouse For Babita
videos.overview: Team Jethalal reaches the clubhouse, convinced that Babita is hiding there. Later, their search leads them to the terrace. Will Team Jethalal finally catch Babita there?

videos.title: Holi Challenge Ka Winner
videos.overview: With just 12 minutes left, Jethalal instructs his team to search the temple, the garden, and the society entrance. Is he about to lose the challenge, or will he turn the game around and win?

videos.title: Iyer Punishes Jethalal
videos.overview: Iyer comes up with a very strict punishment for Jethalal, leaving him dejected. Will Iyer soften his stance, or will Jethalal have to bear the consequences?

videos.title: Bhide Reprimands Jethalal
videos.overview: Tapu accidentally spills colour on Bhide, prompting Bhide to gather everyone in the society compound. Later, Tapu comes up with a plan to promote the rhymes and poems they've created for kids.

videos.title: Bhide Ki Khushkhabri
videos.overview: Bhide returns home with the happy news of buying a gold jewellery set for Sonu. Later, they head to the jewellery shop. Will they run into any trouble there?

videos.title: Bhallas Come To Bhide's House
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi bring the Bhallas home to buy the gold set. Later, Bhide arranges the cash to give the Bhallas. Will Bhide fall into a trap?

videos.title: Gold Jewellery Set For Sonu
videos.overview: Just when the Bhallas are about to leave without giving them the gold set, Popatlal arrives with the remaining money and helps Bhide. Later, Bhide shows the gold jewellery to everyone.

videos.title: Bhide Guards The Golden Jewellery Set
videos.overview: After verifying the golden jewellery set is authentic, Bhide takes extra precautions to protect it overnight before placing it in the bank locker the next day. Will his caution bring unexpected trouble?

videos.title: Bhallas Get Caught
videos.overview: Bhide is taken by the police along with the gold jewellery after the Bhallas are caught. Later, the police and the Bhallas go missing. How will the Bhides deal with this fraud?

videos.title: Bhides Plead Infront Of Inspector Pandey
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi are taken to the police station. As they narrate the entire incident to Inspector Pandey, will they be found guilty or innocent?

videos.title: Gokuldham Members Crack The Case
videos.overview: Bhide and Madhavi request Inspector Pandey to help them find the real culprit. Before he can help them, the Gokuldham men enter the police station with the Bhallas and the fake policemen. Will Bhide and Madhavi be found innocent?

videos.title: Catching The Thieves
videos.overview: The Gokuldham men chase the thieves and narrate the entire incident to Inspector Pandey. Later, Bhide and Madhavi get a new gold set for Sonu.

videos.title: Champaklal Ke Liye Gift
videos.overview: Popatlal gets a joke book as a present for Champaklal. Meanwhile, Bhide asks a question to the kids in his tuition class. Will they be able to answer it correctly?

videos.title: Ram Navami Ka Celebration
videos.overview: Veer and Bansri come up with a plan to celebrate Ram Navami differently this year. What is their plan?

videos.title: Rupa And Ratan's Contribution
videos.overview: With Rupa and Ratan's help, Tapu Sena decorates the entire society for Ram Navami as everyone celebrates with joy and happiness.

videos.title: Quiz On Shri Ram
videos.overview: The Gokuldham residents play a quiz on Shri Ram and learn about his great deeds.

videos.title: Sureele Bhajan
videos.overview: The quiz continues with some of the Gokuldham residents answering correctly and others getting it wrong, followed by a group of children singing bhajans in praise of Shri Ram.

videos.title: Society Ke Rules And Regulations
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal asks Bhide for the terrace keys, but he denies the request and Popatlal interferes. How will this issue be resolved?

videos.title: Tapu Sena To The Rescue
videos.overview: Tapu Sena has taken on the responsibility of cleaning the terrace, making it ready for the Mahila Mandal. Will they finish it in time?

videos.title: Popatlal Ke Jacket Ka Daag
videos.overview: Bhide, Madhavi and Popatlal are ready to leave with Sodhi, but a stain on Popatlal's jacket causes a delay. How will this be resolved?

videos.title: Popatlal Phisal Gaya
videos.overview: While trying to change his clothes in a hurry, Popatlal falls to the ground and gets hurt. How will he make it to the samaroh?

videos.title: Bhide Ka Tyaag Patra
videos.overview: Popatlal lashes out at Bhide, making him decide to resign from his post as the society secretary. How will the other Gokuldham residents react to this?

videos.title: Taarak's Advice
videos.overview: Taarak tries to convince Bhide not to resign from his post as society secretary. Will Bhide listen to his advice?

videos.title: Bhide Aur Popatlal Ka Aamna Saamna
videos.overview: The entire society gathers as Bhide is ready to resign. Will the members be able to resolve the conflict between Popatlal and Bhide?

videos.title: Bhide's Resignation
videos.overview: Popatlal firmly puts forth his arguments against Bhide. Will Bhide finally resign from his post as the society secretary?

videos.title: Popatlal Apologises To Bhide
videos.overview: The society members come together to convince Bhide not to resign, while Popatlal finally apologises for his mistake. What decision will Bhide take now?

videos.title: Jethalal Tries To Find A Contractor
videos.overview: After Jethalal promises to find a contractor for the society's repair work, he struggles to arrange one. Will he be able to live up to his promise?

videos.title: Society Maintenance
videos.overview: The society members celebrate the completion of the terrace work while other repairs are still pending, and Bhide asks everyone to arrange additional funds.

videos.title: Sapne Ki Baat Cheet
videos.overview: Jethalal and Taarak get into a conversation about dreams, while Rupa excitedly shows off the new jewellery she has bought.

videos.title: Rupa Ki Royal Angoothi
videos.overview: Rupa and Ratan begin planning their shop's anniversary celebration, and Rupa decides to prepare Mawa Kachori for the occasion, sharing the news with the other members.

videos.title: Shop Anniversary Ki Taiyaariyan
videos.overview: Ratan begins the preparations for the shop's anniversary celebration, while Rupa gets busy making fresh Mawa Kachori for the special day. How will their anniversary celebration turn out?

videos.title: Anniversary Day For Rupa And Ratan's Shop
videos.overview: Rupa and Ratan get ready to celebrate their shop's anniversary and seek blessings from Champaklal.

videos.title: Mahila Mandal's Shopping Spree
videos.overview: The Mahila Mandal of Gokul Dham Society are heading out to shop at Rupa and Ratan's store, gearing up for a fun-filled spree together. What delights will they find?

videos.title: A Saree Shopping Moment
videos.overview: Along with the Mahila Mandal, Popatlal also reaches the saree shop and buys six sarees, as Rupa and Ratan's store creates excitement, with Bavri and Bagha joining the shopping fun.

videos.title: The Hunt For Rupa’s Royal Ring
videos.overview: When Rupa realises her family's royal ring is missing, she turns to the Gokuldham members for help in the search. Will they be able to find it?

videos.title: Rupa’s Missing Ring
videos.overview: While the Gokuldham members continue searching for Rupa's royal ring, she realises it must have slipped off while she was preparing kachoris. Will they manage to find it?

videos.title: Chacha Ji’s Ring Trouble
videos.overview: Chaos unfolds in Gokuldham when a ring gets stuck in Chacha Ji's stomach and everyone pitches in to help.

videos.title: Chacha Ji's Medical Emergency
